```tsx
import { CaseDecidedParams, MEASURES, ORDER_DRAFTS, ORDER_GROUND_LABELS, SOURCE_LABELS, type CaseView, type StaffMe, type StaffOverview } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ORDER_NOTICE } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { complete, correctable, decisionParamsOf, newDraft, reinstatable, reinstateDraft, reinstateGroundOf, withReinstateGround } from "../src/compose";
import { DECISION_KINDS, messageFor, ORDER_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { ComposerView, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { AuthoritiesLines } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { bothTimes, dateTime } from "../src/ui";
import { decision, item, NO_STANDING, postCase } from "./case-fixtures";

/**
 * A case that holds an order's measure (3f design, section 8.6, Task 3), server-rendered: the order's item with its
 * source and its order's link, the decision "Order" with "Disabled for an order" and whether it is withheld from its
 * author, [case.preserved], [case.own] and [case.heldToo] on the page and in the confirmation, "Reinstate" greyed for a
 * moderator and live for an admin, the reinstatement's fixed reason and preview, and the params its key confirms; and
 * Home's [home.unverified].
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-16T09:30:00.000Z");
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const ORDER = "1c2d3e4f-5a6b-4c7d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f";
const ORDER_DECISION = "2d3e4f5a-6b7c-4d8e-9fa0-1b2c3d4e5f6a";
const ORDER_ITEM = "3e4f5a6b-7c8d-4e9f-a0b1-2c3d4e5f6a7b";
const UNTIL = "2026-11-27T09:00:00.000Z";

/** A post case under a removal order: its item from the authority, answered at once, and the order decision in force. */
function orderCase(overrides: Partial<CaseView> = {}): CaseView {
  const base = postCase();
  return {
    ...base,
    items: [
      item({
        id: ORDER_ITEM,
        seq: 3,
        outcome: "restricted_legal",
        answeredBy: ORDER_DECISION,
        source: { kind: "authority", label: SOURCE_LABELS.authority, accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null, named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false },
        orderId: ORDER,
        explanation: null,
        markable: false,
      }),
    ],
    decisions: [
      decision({
        id: ORDER_DECISION,
        kind: "order",
        source: "order",
        ground: "illegal",
        ruleId: null,
        facts: null,
        reason: null,
        actions: [{ id: "4f5a6b7c-8d9e-4fa0-b1c2-3d4e5f6a7b8c", kind: "disable_by_order", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: null, ...NO_STANDING, orderId: ORDER, withholdAuthor: true }],
      }),
    ],
    preserved: true,
    noticeHeld: { until: UNTIL },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const base: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
  shownImage: null,
  busy: null,
  notice: null,
  error: null,
  note: "",
  reveal: null,
  onOpenCase: noop,
  onShowImage: noop,
  onShowClearly: noop,
  onHideImage: noop,
  onImageError: noop,
  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,
  onRevealClose: noop,
};

function composeFor(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"]): NonNullable<CaseScreenViewProps["compose"]> {
  return {
    role,
    draft: newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role),
    now: NOW,
    busy: false,
    error: null,
    textErrors: {},
    declining: null,
    onChange: noop,
    onTextBlur: noop,
    onSeal: noop,
    onConfirm: noop,
    onDeclineOpen: noop,
    onDeclineChange: noop,
    onDeclineSave: noop,
    onDeclineClose: noop,
    onCancelCorrection: noop,
    onCorrect: noop,
    onReview: noop,
    onAnswer: noop,
    onWithdraw: noop,
    onWithdrawMarks: noop,
    onReinstate: noop,
  };
}

const page = (view: CaseView, extra: Partial<CaseScreenViewProps> = {}) => html(<CaseScreenView {...base} caseId={caseId(view.id)} view={view} {...extra} />);

describe("a case that holds an order's measure (8.6)", () => {
  test("the item: the authority's order as its source, a link to the order, no reveal and no mark; the decision Order, its measure in force and withheld from its author", () => {
    const view = orderCase();
    const out = page(view, { onOpenOrder: noop });
    expect(text(out)).toContain(`Source: ${SOURCE_LABELS.authority}`);
    expect(out).toContain(`href="/orders/${ORDER}"`);
    expect(text(out)).toContain("an authority's order");
    expect(text(out)).not.toContain("Reveal who sent this");
    expect(out).toContain(`<strong>${DECISION_KINDS.order}</strong>`);
    expect(text(out)).toContain(`${MEASURES.disable_by_order.label}: in force; ${ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.withheld}`);
    const shown = orderCase({ decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, withholdAuthor: false }] }] });
    expect(text(page(shown))).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.shown);
  });

  test("[case.preserved], [case.own] and [case.heldToo] on the page, the hold's end printed, or none recorded", () => {
    const out = text(page(orderCase()));
    expect(out).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.preserved);
    expect(out).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.own);
    expect(out).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.heldToo(dateTime(UNTIL)));
    expect(text(page(orderCase({ noticeHeld: { until: null } })))).toContain("at a time that is not recorded yet");
    const plain = text(page(orderCase({ preserved: false, noticeHeld: null, decisions: [] })));
    expect(plain).not.toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.preserved);
    expect(plain).not.toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.own);
    expect(plain).not.toContain("must not be told");
  });

  test("Reinstate beside the measure: greyed for a moderator with admin_required's words, live for an admin; no Correct this decision", () => {
    const view = orderCase();
    const moderator = page(view, { compose: composeFor(view, MODERATOR) });
    expect(moderator).toMatch(/<button type="button" disabled="">Reinstate<[/]button>/);
    expect(text(moderator)).toContain(messageFor("admin_required"));
    const admin = page(view, { compose: composeFor(view, ADMIN) });
    expect(admin).toMatch(/<button type="button">Reinstate<[/]button>/);
    expect(correctable(view, view.decisions[0]!, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    // A lifted measure offers nothing.
    expect(reinstatable({ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, inForce: false }] })).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the reinstatement: a ground chosen, its fixed reason shown and never a field, the notice's paragraphs as the preview, [case.heldToo] and [reinstate.fake] in the confirmation", () => {
    const view = orderCase();
    const opened = reinstateDraft(caseId(view.id), view, view.decisions[0]!, ADMIN);
    expect(reinstateGroundOf(opened)).toBeNull();
    expect(complete(view, opened)).toBe(false);
    const draft = withReinstateGround(opened, "not_authentic");
    expect(draft.written.review_reason).toBe(ORDER_DRAFTS.reinstate.not_authentic);
    expect(complete(view, draft)).toBe(true);
    const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role: ADMIN, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
    const out = html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
    const read = text(out);
    for (const ground of ["withdrawn", "annulled", "scrutiny", "not_authentic", "wrong_item"] as const) expect(read).toContain(ORDER_GROUND_LABELS[ground]);
    expect(read).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.reinstateWhat);
    expect(read).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.reinstateFake);
    expect(read).toContain(ORDER_NOTICE.reinstated.ground.not_authentic);
    expect(read).toContain(ORDER_NOTICE.lifted);
    expect(read).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.heldToo(dateTime(UNTIL)));
    expect(read).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.reinstateButton);
    expect(out).not.toContain("<textarea");
    // Without a hold, no [reinstate.fake] and no [case.heldToo].
    const told = text(html(<ComposerView {...props} view={orderCase({ noticeHeld: null })} />));
    expect(told).not.toContain(ORDER_WORDS.caseOrder.reinstateFake);
    expect(told).not.toContain("must not be told");
  });

  test("the params the key confirms: a correction that reverses the order decision whole, its one action signing the ground, the reason's digest", () => {
    const view = orderCase();
    const draft = withReinstateGround(reinstateDraft(caseId(view.id), view, view.decisions[0]!, ADMIN), "withdrawn");
    const params = decisionParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: "ab".repeat(32), facts: null, reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null });
    expect(params).toMatchObject({
      kind: "correction",
      reviewsDecisionId: ORDER_DECISION,
      outcome: "reversed",
      actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", mediaId: null, orderGround: "withdrawn" }],
      reasonDigest: "bb".repeat(32),
      factsDigest: null,
    });
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.safeParse(params).success).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("Home's [home.unverified] (8.2)", () => {
  const overview = (ordersUnverified: StaffOverview["ordersUnverified"]) =>
    ({
      contact: { open: 0, oldestAt: null, dueAt: null },
      alerts: { channel: "ok", since: null },
      ordersUnverified,
    }) as unknown as StaffOverview;

  test("the count, and each order a link built from its checked id; nothing when none", () => {
    const out = html(<AuthoritiesLines overview={overview({ total: 2, items: [{ orderId: ORDER, effectAt: UNTIL }, { orderId: ORDER.toUpperCase(), effectAt: UNTIL }] })} now={NOW.getTime()} onOpenOrder={noop} />);
    expect(text(out)).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.homeUnverified(2));
    expect(text(out)).toContain(`Given effect at ${bothTimes(UNTIL)}`);
    expect(out.match(/href="[^"]+"/g)).toEqual([`href="/orders/${ORDER}"`]);
    expect(html(<AuthoritiesLines overview={overview({ total: 0, items: [] })} now={NOW.getTime()} />)).toBe("");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-effect.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { CaseView, ORDER_RULES, SOURCE_LABELS, type CaseDecidedParams, type OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { authorCases } from "../../src/moderation/author";
import { readCase } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, imagePost, madeUpConfirmation, moderationDeps, newTestStaff, removeFixtures, report, aPost, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, effectParams, effectWith, orderForTest, removeOrderAlerts, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * "Disable for an order" (3f design, sections 6.3 and 7.6; invariants 5, 6, 8 and 27). One key touch gives effect to up
 * to ten items: one intake of the kind order, one order decision a post with its one disable_by_order, each item's
 * intake item answered, the posts disabled for everyone, the items' disabling and preservation, the events, and one audit
 * row order_effected that names every decision under its item. An unverified DSA Article 9 order is given effect only by
 * an admin who signs urgent; signed facts that differ from the order, and an item that is not the order's, are
 * order_changed; an item already given effect is refused. Every test runs in a transaction that is rolled back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: giving effect to an order", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** The effect's refusal as its code, or the view. */
  async function effect(tx: DbTx, by: TestStaff, view: OrderView, params: Record<string, unknown> = effectParams(view)): Promise<OrderView | string> {
    try {
      return await effectWith(tx, by, view.id, params);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ModerationError) return err.code;
      throw err;
    }
  }
  const asView = (outcome: OrderView | string): OrderView => {
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`refused: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome;
  };
  const decisionsOf = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string) =>
    tx.execute<{ id: string; kind: string; source: string; outcome: string; ground: string; category: string; category_keyword: string | null; informed: boolean; told_now: boolean; author_mail: string; needs_admin: boolean; through_seq: number }>(sql`
      select d.id, d.kind::text as kind, d.source::text as source, d.outcome::text as outcome, d.ground::text as ground, d.category, d.category_keyword,
             d.informed_at is not null as informed, d.informed_at = d.decided_at as told_now, d.author_mail::text as author_mail, d.needs_admin, d.through_seq
        from public.decisions d join public.legal_order_items i on i.id = d.order_item_id where i.order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by i.position`);

  test("two posts with one key: one intake of the kind order, one decision a post with its one measure, the posts disabled for everyone, the items' disabling and preservation, the events and one audit row; told at once without Section C", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 2);
      const b = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId, b.postId] });
      const done = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      expect(done.state).toBe("given_effect");
      expect(done.items.map((item) => [item.inForce, item.disabledAt !== null, item.noEffect])).toEqual([
        [true, true, null],
        [true, true, null],
      ]);
      // Six calendar months and a day from the disabling, the form of order_preserve_until.
      for (const item of done.items) {
        const months = new Date(item.disabledAt!);
        months.setUTCMonth(months.getUTCMonth() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths);
        months.setUTCDate(months.getUTCDate() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMarginDays);
        expect(Date.parse(item.preserveUntil!)).toBe(months.getTime());
      }
      const posts = await tx.execute<{ state: string; level: string }>(sql`select state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level from public.posts where id in (${a.postId}::uuid, ${b.postId}::uuid)`);
      expect(posts.map((p) => [p.state, p.level])).toEqual([
        ["disabled", "disabled"],
        ["disabled", "disabled"],
      ]);
      // The images keep their own state: no reader serves an image of a disabled post, whatever its state.
      const images = await tx.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state::text as state from public.post_media where post_id = ${a.postId}::uuid`);
      expect(images.map((i) => i.state)).toEqual(["visible", "visible"]);
      const decisions = await decisionsOf(tx, order.id);
      expect(decisions.map((d) => [d.kind, d.source, d.outcome, d.ground, d.category, d.category_keyword, d.told_now, d.author_mail, d.needs_admin, d.through_seq])).toEqual([
        ["order", "order", "restricted", "illegal", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", true, "pending", false, 0],
        ["order", "order", "restricted", "illegal", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", true, "pending", false, 0],
      ]);
      const intakes = await tx.execute<{ kind: string; channel: string; receipt: string; outcome: string; outcome_mail: string; lane: number }>(sql`
        select n.kind::text as kind, n.channel::text as channel, n.receipt::text as receipt, i.outcome::text as outcome, i.outcome_mail::text as outcome_mail, i.lane
          from public.legal_order_items o join public.intake_items i on i.id = o.intake_item_id join public.intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id
         where o.order_id = ${order.id}::uuid order by o.position`);
      expect(intakes.map((i) => [i.kind, i.channel, i.receipt, i.outcome, i.outcome_mail, i.lane])).toEqual([
        ["order", "authority", "none", "restricted_legal", "none", 0],
        ["order", "authority", "none", "restricted_legal", "none", 0],
      ]);
      // The cases the effect opened are closed by their only item's answer.
      const cases = await tx.execute<{ closed: boolean; equal: boolean }>(sql`
        select c.closed_at is not null as closed, c.answered_seq = c.intake_seq as equal from public.cases c where c.target_type = 'post' and c.target_id in (${a.postId}::uuid, ${b.postId}::uuid)`);
      expect(cases.map((c) => [c.closed, c.equal])).toEqual([
        [true, true],
        [true, true],
      ]);
      expect(done.events.filter((e) => e.kind === "effect_given").map((e) => [e.via, e.by !== null])).toEqual([
        ["console", true],
        ["console", true],
      ]);
      const [audit] = await tx.execute<{ action: string; target_id: string; metadata: { decisionIds: Record<string, string>; params: { items: unknown[] } } }>(
        sql`select action, target_id, metadata from public.audit_log order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
      );
      expect([audit!.action, audit!.target_id]).toEqual(["order_effected", order.id]);
      expect(Object.values(audit!.metadata.decisionIds).sort()).toEqual(decisions.map((d) => d.id).sort());
      expect(audit!.metadata.params.items).toHaveLength(2);
    });
  });

  test("with Section C the notices are held: no informed_at and no mail; the post is disabled whatever the request said", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId], sectionC: true });
      asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      const [d] = await decisionsOf(tx, order.id);
      expect([d!.informed, d!.author_mail]).toEqual([false, "none"]);
      // A DSA Article 9 order whose author must not be told withholds by force: disabled, and held.
      const b = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const dsa = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [b.postId], sectionC: true });
      const verified = asView(await effect(tx, admin, dsa, { ...effectParams(dsa), urgent: true }));
      expect(verified.items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);
      const [level] = await tx.execute<{ level: string }>(sql`select moderation_level::text as level from public.posts where id = ${b.postId}::uuid`);
      expect(level!.level).toBe("disabled");
      const [held] = await decisionsOf(tx, dsa.id);
      expect([held!.informed, held!.author_mail]).toEqual([false, "none"]);
    });
  });

  test("a DSA Article 9 order is verified before effect: refused for a moderator and for an admin without urgent; an admin's urgent effect needs an admin; urgent on a removal order is refused", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {

      expect(await effect(tx, moderator, dsa)).toBe("order_not_verified");
      expect(await effect(tx, moderator, dsa, { ...effectParams(dsa), urgent: true })).toBe("order_not_verified");
      expect(await effect(tx, admin, dsa)).toBe("order_not_verified");
      const urgent = asView(await effect(tx, admin, dsa, { ...effectParams(dsa), urgent: true }));
      expect(urgent.items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);
      // Not withheld from its author: removed, told at once, and nothing preserved.
      expect(urgent.items[0]!.preserveUntil).toBeNull();
      const [post] = await tx.execute<{ level: string }>(sql`select moderation_level::text as level from public.posts where id = ${a.postId}::uuid`);
      expect(post!.level).toBe("removed");
      const [d] = await decisionsOf(tx, dsa.id);
      expect([d!.category, d!.category_keyword, d!.told_now, d!.author_mail, d!.needs_admin]).toEqual(["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE", null, true, "pending", true]);
    });
  });

  test("a verified DSA order is given effect by any staff member, and urgent signed for it is refused", async () => {

      await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {

        expect(asView(await effect(tx, moderator, verified)).items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);

      await removeOrders(w.migrateDb, [verified.id]);
      await removeOrderAlerts(w.migrateDb, started);
      await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [b.authorId]);
    }
  });

  test("signed facts that differ from the order, and an item that is not the order's, are order_changed; an item in force is not given effect twice", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const b = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId] });
      const other = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [b.postId] });
      expect(await effect(tx, moderator, order, { ...effectParams(order), reference: "something else" })).toBe("order_changed");
      expect(await effect(tx, moderator, order, { ...effectParams(order), items: effectParams(other).items })).toBe("order_changed");
      asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      expect(await effect(tx, moderator, order, { ...effectParams(order, { itemIds: [order.items[0]!.id] }) })).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
  });

  test("an order answers only its own item: a report on the same post stays open with its lane, and the case stays open", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {

      const reported = await report(tx, aPost(a.postId), "rule");
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId] });
      asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      const items = await tx.execute<{ kind: string; answered: boolean }>(sql`
        select n.kind::text as kind, i.answered_by is not null as answered from public.intake_items i join public.intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id
         where i.case_id = ${reported.caseId}::uuid order by i.seq`);
      expect(items.map((i) => [i.kind, i.answered])).toEqual([
        ["user", false],
        ["order", true],
      ]);
      const [kase] = await tx.execute<{ closed: boolean; lane: number; answered_seq: number }>(sql`select closed_at is not null as closed, lane, answered_seq from public.cases where id = ${reported.caseId}::uuid`);
      expect([kase!.closed, kase!.answered_seq]).toEqual([false, 0]);
    });
  });

  test("the staff case page of an order's case reads as the contracts' CaseView: the authority's item with its order, Order with its measure withheld from its author, the level disabled, the post preserved; the author's row says disabled or removed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {

      const done = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      const caseId = done.items[0]!.caseId!;
      const { session } = madeUpConfirmation(moderator, caseId, {} as CaseDecidedParams);
      const read = await readCase(moderationDeps(tx), session, caseId);
      // The console parses the answer with the contracts: an order's item, decision and history are among what it takes.
      expect(CaseView.safeParse(read).success).toBe(true);
      const item = read.items.find((each) => each.source.kind === "authority")!;
      expect([item.source.label, item.orderId, item.outcome]).toEqual([SOURCE_LABELS.authority, order.id, "restricted_legal"]);
      const decision = read.decisions.find((each) => each.kind === "order")!;
      expect(decision.actions.map((a) => [a.kind, a.inForce, a.orderId, a.withholdAuthor])).toEqual([["disable_by_order", true, order.id, true]]);
      expect(read.target.type === "post" ? read.target.level : null).toBe("disabled");
      expect(read.preserved).toBe(true);
      expect(read.snapshots.every((s) => s.withheld)).toBe(true);
      expect(read.noticeHeld).toBeNull();
      expect(read.history.some((entry) => entry.intakeKind === "order")).toBe(true);
      expect(read.history.some((entry) => entry.decisionKind === "order")).toBe(true);
      expect((await authorCases({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db }, p.authorId)).decisions.map((row) => row.order)).toEqual(["disabled"]);
      // A DSA order that does not withhold removes the post from everyone but its author: the row says so.
      const q = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const dsa = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [q.postId], withholdFromAuthor: false });
      await effectWith(tx, admin, dsa.id, { ...effectParams(dsa), urgent: true });
      expect((await authorCases({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db }, q.authorId)).decisions.map((row) => row.order)).toEqual(["removed"]);
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-keep.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createMediaRepo } from "../../src/media/repo";
import { caseSnapshots } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { createSocialRepo } from "../../src/social/repo";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, decideIn, imagePost, newTestStaff, removeFixtures, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, ageOrderForTest, effectParams, effectWith, orderForTest } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 120_000 });

/**
 * What is preserved stays (3f design, sections 6.3, 7.10 and 7.11; invariant 11, Task 3's part: keeping; the end is Task
 * 4's). A post a removal order disabled is preserved: post_preserved holds, frozen_for's fourth arm makes it frozen, so
 * gate K keeps its image rows against every delete, the purge's included, and gate E its snapshots; the author's own
 * deletion is refused, while the purge tombstones it; the staff case page reads no text of it, while snapshot_withheld
 * answers what it answered before. A reinstatement ends the preservation, and a disabling after it counts six months
 * anew. Every test runs in a transaction that is rolled back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: what an order's preservation keeps", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  const flag = async (tx: DbTx, expression: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => (await tx.execute<{ v: boolean }>(sql`select ${expression} as v`))[0]!.v;

  test("a preserved post is frozen: its image rows survive every delete, its author's own deletion is refused, the purge tombstones it and keeps the rest; the staff case page reads no text of it", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
      const done = await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
      const caseId = done.items[0]!.caseId!;
      expect(await flag(tx, sql`public.post_preserved(${p.postId}::uuid)`)).toBe(true);
      expect(await flag(tx, sql`public.post_frozen(${p.postId}::uuid)`)).toBe(true);
      // Gate K: a delete of the post's image rows deletes nothing.
      const deleted = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`delete from public.post_media where post_id = ${p.postId}::uuid returning id`);
      expect(deleted).toEqual([]);
      // The author's own deletion: refused by the database for the API role (and the route answers not_found).
      const social = createSocialRepo(tx as unknown as Db);
      expect(await social.deletePost(p.postId, p.authorId, new Date())).toBe(false);
      // The staff case page: no text of the preserved post; the author's predicate answers as before.
      const snapshots = await caseSnapshots(tx, caseId);
      expect(snapshots.every((s) => s.withheld)).toBe(true);
      expect(await flag(tx, sql`(select bool_or(public.snapshot_withheld(s.id)) from public.evidence_snapshots s where s.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid)`)).toBe(false);
      // The purge: the profile first, then the tombstones, which the guard lets through; the image rows stay.
      await social.purgeProfile(p.authorId, new Date(), async (inner) => {
        await createMediaRepo(inner as unknown as Db).purgeOwner(inner, p.authorId);
      });
      const [post] = await tx.execute<{ state: string; level: string }>(sql`select state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level from public.posts where id = ${p.postId}::uuid`);
      expect([post!.state, post!.level]).toEqual(["deleted_by_author", "disabled"]);
      expect((await tx.execute(sql`select id from public.post_media where post_id = ${p.postId}::uuid`)).length).toBe(2);
    });
  });

  test("a DSA order preserves nothing, and freezes nothing", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [p.postId], withholdFromAuthor: false });
      await effectWith(tx, admin, order.id, { ...effectParams(order), urgent: true });
      expect(await flag(tx, sql`public.post_preserved(${p.postId}::uuid)`)).toBe(false);
      expect(await flag(tx, sql`public.post_frozen(${p.postId}::uuid)`)).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  test("a reinstatement ends the preservation; a disabling after it counts six months and a day from itself, never from the first", async () => {
    // As the migrator, who alone moves an order's times back (ageOrderForTest); the flows run as they do for the API.
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
      const first = await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
      await decideIn(tx, admin, first.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: first.items[0]!.decisionId!, outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", orderGround: "annulled" }] });
      expect(await flag(tx, sql`public.post_preserved(${p.postId}::uuid)`)).toBe(false);
      // A hundred days later a court restores the order, and the post is disabled again.
      await ageOrderForTest(tx, order.id, 100 * 24 * 60);
      const again = await effectWith(tx, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order, { itemIds: [order.items[0]!.id] }));
      const item = again.items[0]!;
      expect(item.inForce).toBe(true);
      expect(item.preserveEndedAt).toBeNull();
      expect(item.reinstatedAt).toBeNull();
      // disabled_at keeps the first disabling, which Annex II and the clock read.
      expect(Date.parse(item.disabledAt!)).toBeLessThan(Date.now() - 99 * 86_400_000);
      const expected = new Date();
      expected.setUTCMonth(expected.getUTCMonth() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths);
      expected.setUTCDate(expected.getUTCDate() + ORDER_RULES.preserveMarginDays);
      expect(Math.abs(Date.parse(item.preserveUntil!) - expected.getTime())).toBeLessThan(10 * 60_000);
      expect(await flag(tx, sql`public.post_preserved(${p.postId}::uuid)`)).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-ledger.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES, type OrderEffectedParams, type OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../../src/staff";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { addItems, effectRows, orderView } from "../../src/moderation/orders";
import { insertOrderDecision, setItemIntake } from "../../src/moderation/orders-repo";
import { appendConfirmedAudit } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import {
  CHANNEL_TABLES,
  aPost,
  act,
  decideIn,
  hex64,
  imagePost,
  moderationDeps,
  newPostRow,
  newTestStaff,
  newestSnapshot,
  raised,
  removeFixtures,
  report,
  rowCounts,
  staffProfile,
  type TestStaff,
} from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, effectParams, effectWith, orderConfig, orderForTest, sessionOf } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 300_000 });

/**
 * The ledger of an order (3f design, section 6.3; invariants 5, 6, 7 and 9, LAB C and D on the built code). Nothing
 * enters the ledger without a key: each of LAB D's refusals at commit leaves nothing behind, and one audit row covers at
 * most ten decisions. An order waives exactly three checks (recusal, staff_target and the decision caps) and has a cap
 * of its own; its reinstatement is an admin's. The level is derived whatever the order of arrival. korbat's appeal does
 * not apply to an order decision. The author's own deletion of a disabled post is refused by the database too. Every
 * test runs in a transaction that is rolled back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the ledger of an order", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let moderator: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    moderator = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "admin");
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, moderator);
    await staffProfile(w.apiDb, admin);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    await removeFixtures(w.migrateDb, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  const asView = (outcome: OrderView | string): OrderView => {
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`refused: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome;
  };
  async function effect(tx: DbTx, by: TestStaff, view: OrderView, params: Record<string, unknown> = effectParams(view)): Promise<OrderView | string> {
    try {
      return await effectWith(tx, by, view.id, params);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof ModerationError) return err.code;
      throw err;
    }
  }
  const confirmedParts = (staff: TestStaff) => ({
    keyId: staff.keyId,
    staffSession: randomUUID(),
    actionHash: hex64(),
    stepUp: { authenticatorData: "AAAA", clientDataJSON: "BBBB", signature: "CCCC" },
    requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}`,
    expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 10 * 60_000),
  });

  /**
   * The effect's rows with an audit row the test chooses, and decision_holds run at once: answers the refusal's code, or
   * null when the decisions stand. The savepoint goes either way, so nothing is left behind.
   */
  async function rawEffect(
    tx: DbTx,
    staff: TestStaff,
    view: OrderView,
    audit: { action?: "order_effected" | "case_decided"; plain?: boolean; params?: (p: OrderEffectedParams) => Record<string, unknown>; decisionIds?: (ids: Record<string, string>) => Record<string, string>; targetId?: string },
    params: OrderEffectedParams = effectParams(view),
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    try {
      await tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
        const ids = await effectRows(moderationDeps(sp, { config: orderConfig() }), sp, staff.id, params);
        const metadata = { params: audit.params ? audit.params(params) : params, decisionIds: audit.decisionIds ? audit.decisionIds(ids) : ids };
        if (audit.plain) await appendAuditRow(sp, { actorId: staff.id, action: "order_effected", targetType: "order", targetId: audit.targetId ?? view.id, requestId: null, metadata });
        else await appendConfirmedAudit(sp, { actorId: staff.id, action: audit.action ?? "order_effected", targetType: "order", targetId: audit.targetId ?? view.id, metadata, ...confirmedParts(staff) });
        await sp.execute(sql`set constraints public.decisions_check, public.decision_actions_recheck immediate`);
        throw new Error("held");
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Error && err.message === "held") return null;
      return raised(err)?.message ?? String(err);
    }
    return null;
  }

  test("LAB D: each refusal at commit, and one audit row covers at most ten decisions", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const posts: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 11; i++) posts.push((await imagePost(tx, 0)).postId);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: posts.slice(0, 10) });
      const counted = async () => (await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.decisions where order_item_id is not null`))[0]!.n;
      const start = await counted();
      // The plain row: no confirmation.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { plain: true })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // case_decided in the place of order_effected.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { action: "case_decided" })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // Another order as the target, and a forged reference in the params.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { targetId: randomUUID() })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { params: (p) => ({ ...p, reference: "forged" }) })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // An item the row does not name, and a decision the row names under another item.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { decisionIds: (ids) => Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(ids).slice(1)) })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(
        await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, {
          decisionIds: (ids) => {
            const [a, b] = Object.keys(ids);
            return { ...ids, [a!]: ids[b!]!, [b!]: ids[a!]! };
          },
        }),
      ).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // "Must not be told" signed with the post shown to its author equals no row.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, { params: (p) => ({ ...p, sectionC: true }) })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      // Ten decisions under one row stand.
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, order, {})).toBeNull();
      expect(await counted()).toBe(start);
      // An eleventh is refused: at most items_per_action under one row.
      await addItems(moderationDeps(tx, { config: orderConfig() }), sessionOf(moderator), order.id, { links: [`${orderConfig().APP_ORIGIN}/post/${posts[10]}`] }, { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
      const eleven = (await orderView(moderationDeps(tx, { config: orderConfig() }), order.id, sessionOf(moderator)))!;
      const all = eleven.items.map((item) => ({ itemId: item.id, postId: item.postId! })).sort((a, b) => (a.postId < b.postId ? -1 : 1));
      expect(all).toHaveLength(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction + 1);
      expect(await rawEffect(tx, moderator, eleven, {}, { ...effectParams(eleven), items: all })).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(await counted()).toBe(start);
    });
  });

  test("a second measure on an order decision is refused", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
      const second = await tx
        .transaction(async (sp) => {
          const ids = await effectRows(moderationDeps(sp, { config: orderConfig() }), sp, moderator.id, effectParams(order));
          await sp.execute(sql`insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind) values (${Object.values(ids)[0]!}::uuid, 'remove')`);
        })
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message ?? null,
        );
      expect(second).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
  });

  test("an order waives recusal, staff_target and the decision caps, and has a cap of its own", async () => {
    // The decision caps at zero, as the migrator sets them (staff.js limits), and back after.
    const [limits] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ per_hour: number; per_day: number }>(sql`select decisions_per_hour as per_hour, decisions_per_day as per_day from public.moderation_limits where id = 1`);
    try {
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.moderation_limits set decisions_per_hour = 0, decisions_per_day = 0 where id = 1`);
      await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
        // The moderator's own post: a party to it and a staff member, and still given effect by the moderator.
        const own = await newPostRow(tx, moderator.id);
        const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [own] });
        expect(asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order)).items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);
        // The order's cap: decisionsPerDay order decisions of one account in 24 hours, the next refused.
        let given = 1;
        while (given < ORDER_RULES.decisionsPerDay) {
          const batch: string[] = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction, ORDER_RULES.decisionsPerDay - given); i++) batch.push((await imagePost(tx, 0)).postId);
          const next = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { posts: batch });
          asView(await effect(tx, moderator, next));
          given += batch.length;
        }
        const last = await orderForTest(tx, admin, { posts: [(await imagePost(tx, 0)).postId] });
        expect(await effect(tx, moderator, last)).toBe("order_cap");
        // Another staff member goes on.
        expect(asView(await effect(tx, admin, last)).items[0]!.inForce).toBe(true);
      });
    } finally {
      await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.moderation_limits set decisions_per_hour = ${limits!.per_hour}, decisions_per_day = ${limits!.per_day} where id = 1`);
    }
  });

  test("the reinstatement is an admin's, asks no recusal, and lifts the measure; the level is derived in either order of arrival (LAB C)", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      // Removed under a rule, then disabled: disabled; reinstated: removed again, since the rule's removal stands.
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const reported = await report(tx, aPost(a.postId), "rule");
      await decideIn(tx, moderator, reported.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId] });
      const done = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      const level = async (postId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ level: string; state: string }>(sql`select moderation_level::text as level, state::text as state from public.posts where id = ${postId}::uuid`))[0]!;
      expect(await level(a.postId)).toEqual({ level: "disabled", state: "disabled" });
      const decisionId = done.items[0]!.decisionId!;
      const caseId = done.items[0]!.caseId!;
      const reinstate = { kind: "correction" as const, reviewsDecisionId: decisionId, outcome: "reversed" as const, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order" as const, orderGround: "withdrawn" as const }] };
      await expect(decideIn(tx, moderator, caseId, reinstate)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "admin_required" });
      await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, reinstate);
      expect(await level(a.postId)).toEqual({ level: "removed", state: "removed" });
      const [item] = await tx.execute<{ reinstated: boolean; ended: boolean }>(sql`select reinstated_at is not null as reinstated, preserve_ended_at is not null as ended from public.legal_order_items where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
      expect([item!.reinstated, item!.ended]).toEqual([true, true]);
      // Disabled first, then removed under a rule: the removal changes nothing now; reinstated, the removal stands.
      const b = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const second = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [b.postId] });
      const first = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, second));
      const rule = await report(tx, aPost(b.postId), "rule");
      const removal = await decideIn(tx, moderator, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
      const [noEffect] = await tx.execute<{ no_effect: string | null }>(sql`select no_effect from public.decision_actions where decision_id = ${removal}::uuid and kind = 'remove'`);
      expect(noEffect!.no_effect).toBe("already");
      expect(await level(b.postId)).toEqual({ level: "disabled", state: "disabled" });
      // The admin is the author of a third post: recusal is asked neither of the effect nor of the reinstatement.
      await decideIn(tx, admin, first.items[0]!.caseId!, { ...reinstate, reviewsDecisionId: first.items[0]!.decisionId! });
      expect(await level(b.postId)).toEqual({ level: "removed", state: "removed" });
      const own = await newPostRow(tx, admin.id);
      const ownOrder = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [own] });
      const ownDone = asView(await effect(tx, moderator, ownOrder));
      await decideIn(tx, admin, ownDone.items[0]!.caseId!, { ...reinstate, reviewsDecisionId: ownDone.items[0]!.decisionId!, actions: [{ kind: "reinstate_by_order", orderGround: "wrong_item" }] });
      expect(await level(own)).toEqual({ level: "visible", state: "visible" });
    });
  });

  test("korbat's appeal does not apply: not_appealable; the decision is final when taken", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [a.postId], withholdFromAuthor: false });
      const done = asView(await effect(tx, admin, order, { ...effectParams(order), urgent: true }));
      const decisionId = done.items[0]!.decisionId!;
      const appeal = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into public.appeals (decision_id, appellant_account_id) values (${decisionId}::uuid, ${a.authorId}::uuid)`))
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message ?? null,
        );
      expect(appeal).toBe("not_appealable");
      const [final] = await tx.execute<{ same: boolean }>(sql`select public.decision_final_at(d.id) = d.decided_at as same from public.decisions d where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
      expect(final!.same).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  test("the author's own deletion of a disabled post is refused by the database; an item's intake item pointed at a reporter's item is refused", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const a = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const order = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [a.postId] });
      asView(await effect(tx, moderator, order));
      const deleted = await tx
        .transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update public.posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', deleted_at = now(), body = '' where id = ${a.postId}::uuid`))
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.code ?? null,
        );
      expect(deleted).toBe("42501");
      // A reporter's unanswered item of the same case named as the order item's intake item: refused.
      const b = await imagePost(tx, 0);
      const reported = await report(tx, aPost(b.postId), "rule");
      const other = await orderForTest(tx, moderator, { posts: [b.postId] });
      const [item] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.intake_items where case_id = ${reported.caseId}::uuid`);
      const snapshot = await newestSnapshot(tx, reported.caseId);
      const [kase] = await tx.execute<{ v: number }>(sql`select state_version as v from public.cases where id = ${reported.caseId}::uuid`);
      const pointed = await tx
        .transaction(async (sp) => {
          await setItemIntake(sp, other.items[0]!.id, item!.id);
          await insertOrderDecision(sp, {
            id: randomUUID(),
            caseId: reported.caseId,
            itemId: other.items[0]!.id,
            stateVersion: kase!.v,
            rulesVersion: 3,
            redressVersion: 3,
            category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY",
            keyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT",
            snapshotId: snapshot.id,
            snapshotDigest: snapshot.digest,
            decidedBy: moderator.id,
          });
        })
        .then(
          () => null,
          (err: unknown) => raised(err)?.message ?? null,
        );
      expect(pointed).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/orders-notice.test.ts`

```ts
import { setTimeout as sleep } from "node:timers/promises";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES, type OrderView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { ORDER_NOTICE, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { STAFF_USAGE, runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { MemoryJobLock } from "../../src/lib/jobs";
import { dispatchRound } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { authorCases, authorDecisionView, authorFacts, exportedDecisions } from "../../src/moderation/author";
import { ModerationError } from "../../src/moderation/context";
import { decisionStatement, mailTemplateOf } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { orderNoticeOf } from "../../src/moderation/statement-repo";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, aPost, act, ground, imagePost, intake, removeDecided, removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, outboxSince } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, effectForTest, effectParams, orderForTest, removeOrderAlerts } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

/**
 * The author's notice of an order (3f design, sections 6.3, 7.7 step 3, 7.10 and 9.2; invariants 3, 4's commands and
 * alert, and 28). With Section C the notice is held: nothing reaches the author, and a decision of korbat's own about
 * the post taken during the hold is held with it, while its reporter is answered as always. order_notices_release()
 * tells nothing before the hold's end and everything at it, stamping clock_timestamp(); a correction that holds the
 * order decision's row makes the release wait for it. The authority's words recorded after the author was told make the
 * notice's mail owed again, as order_notice_added. The hold's commands extend, end and move a hold, and the daily
 * hold_ending warns before any release. The effects commit with real keys; the last test removes what they made.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the author's notice of an order", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const people: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();
  let appOrigin: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    appOrigin = loadConfig().APP_ORIGIN;
    w = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(w.apiDb);
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
  }, 90_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeDecided(world.migrateDb, posts, [moderator.id, admin.id]);
    await removeOrderAlerts(world.migrateDb, started);
    // alert_steps(), which the last test runs, also writes its daily test push.
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test' and created_at >= ${started.toISOString()}::timestamptz`);
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, people);
    await world.close({ keepStaff: true });
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A post of a new author, kept for the cleanup. */
  async function post(images = 0) {
    const made = await imagePost(w.apiDb, images);
    posts.push(made.postId);
    people.push(made.authorId);
    return made;
  }
  async function effect(view: OrderView): Promise<OrderView> {
    const outcome = await effectForTest(world, moderator, view.id, effectParams(view));
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the effect was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome;
  }
  const release = async () => (await w.apiDb.execute<{ told: number }>(sql`select public.order_notices_release() as told`))[0]!.told;
  const told = async (decisionId: string) =>
    (await w.apiDb.execute<{ informed: boolean; mail: string; informed_at: string | null }>(
      sql`select informed_at is not null as informed, author_mail::text as mail, to_char(informed_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as informed_at from public.decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
    ))[0]!;
  const env = () => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin });
  async function cli(args: string[], input?: string) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env(), { log: (line) => lines.push(line), error: (line) => lines.push(line) }, async () => Buffer.from(input ?? "", "utf8"));
    return { code, text: lines.join(" ") };
  }

  test("a held notice tells nobody, on any path; a decision of korbat's own about the post is held with it and its reporter answered; the release tells both at the hold's end and not before", async () => {
    const p = await post(1);
    const reporter = await newProfile(w.apiDb);
    people.push(reporter.id);
    const reported = await intake(w.apiDb, ground.rule(reporter.id), aPost(p.postId));
    const caseId = reported.items[0]!.caseId!;
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
    const done = await effect(order);
    const decisionId = done.items[0]!.decisionId!;
    expect(await told(decisionId)).toMatchObject({ informed: false, mail: "none" });
    // During the hold a removal under a rule: recorded, held, and its reporter's item answered.
    const removal = await world.decideAs(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    if (typeof removal === "string") throw new Error(removal);
    expect(await told(removal.decisionId)).toMatchObject({ informed: false, mail: "none" });
    const [item] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ answered: boolean }>(sql`select answered_by is not null as answered from public.intake_items where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid and reporter_account_id = ${reporter.id}::uuid`);
    expect(item!.answered).toBe(true);
    // Nothing on the author's side: no row, no screen, no chip, no export entry.
    const deps = { apiDb: w.apiDb };
    expect((await authorCases(deps, p.authorId)).decisions).toEqual([]);
    await expect(authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, decisionId)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
    await expect(authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, removal.decisionId)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
    expect((await authorFacts(deps, p.authorId, [p.postId])).size).toBe(0);
    expect(await exportedDecisions(deps, p.authorId)).toEqual([]);
    // The API role cannot write a decision's informed_at.
    const refused = await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update public.decisions set informed_at = now() where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`).then(
      () => "written",
      () => "refused",
    );
    expect(refused).toBe("refused");
    // Before the end, nothing is told; an end a moment ahead, and at it everything is.
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => 2) where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    const [end] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ until: string }>(sql`select to_char(public.order_hold_until(${order.id}::uuid) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as until`);
    await sleep(2_200);
    expect(await release()).toBe(2);
    const order_told = await told(decisionId);
    expect(order_told).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
    // Never before the end: the stamp is the clock's at the release.
    expect(Date.parse(order_told.informed_at!)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(Date.parse(end!.until));
    expect(await told(removal.decisionId)).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
    const [event] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid and kind = 'notice_released' and via = 'system'`);
    expect(event!.n).toBe(1);
    // Now the author reads both, and the notice says that it was held until now.
    expect((await authorCases(deps, p.authorId)).decisions.map((d) => [d.kind, d.order ?? null])).toEqual([
      ["final", null],
      ["order", "disabled"],
    ]);
    const view = await authorDecisionView(deps, p.authorId, decisionId);
    expect(view.content).toBeNull();
    expect(view.appealUntil).toBeNull();
    expect(view.order).toMatchObject({ held: true, kind: "tco_removal", withholdAuthor: true });
    expect(statementParagraphs(view, { texts: view.orderTexts ?? null }).join(" ")).toContain("korbat was not allowed to tell you until now.");
    // The chip: a disabled post has none (its level is disabled, which no list shows).
    expect((await authorFacts(deps, p.authorId, [p.postId])).size).toBe(0);
    // A second release tells nothing more.
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
  });

  test("the release waits for a transaction that holds an untold order decision's row, and then tells it", async () => {
    const p = await post();
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
    const done = await effect(order);
    const decisionId = done.items[0]!.decisionId!;
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_ended_at = now(), hold_end_reason = 'released_by_authority' where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    let finished = false;
    let releasing: Promise<number> | null = null;
    await w.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      // What a correction of the order decision takes first.
      await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid for share`);
      releasing = release().then((n) => {
        finished = true;
        return n;
      });
      await sleep(500);
      expect(finished).toBe(false);
    });
    expect(await releasing!).toBe(1);
    expect(await told(decisionId)).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
  });

  test("the authority's words recorded after the author was told make the notice's mail owed again, as order_notice_added, with the record's time; on a held notice nothing is mailed and the release's time counts", async () => {
    const p = await post();
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
    const done = await effect(order);
    const decisionId = done.items[0]!.decisionId!;
    // The first mail went (no address takes one here): what the dispatch round records.
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.decisions set author_mail = 'sent', author_mail_at = now() where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
    const recorded = await cli(["order-texts", order.id, "--reasons"], "Les motifs de l'autorite.");
    expect(recorded.code).toBe(0);
    expect(recorded.text).toContain("1 authors are sent an email that the notice has grown");
    expect(await told(decisionId)).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
    const found = (await decisionStatement(w.apiDb, decisionId))!;
    expect(mailTemplateOf(found.statement, [], found.decision.authorMailAt !== null).template).toBe("order_notice_added");
    const notice = (await orderNoticeOf(w.apiDb, decisionId, "DE"))!;
    const [event] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select to_char(max(at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as at from public.legal_order_events where order_id = ${order.id}::uuid and kind = 'texts_recorded'`);
    expect([notice.texts.reasons, notice.texts.textsAt]).toEqual(["Les motifs de l'autorite.", event!.at]);
    // A held notice: the record changes no mail, and at the release the author holds the words from the release.
    const q = await post();
    const held = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [q.postId], sectionC: true });
    const heldDone = await effect(held);
    const heldDecision = heldDone.items[0]!.decisionId!;
    const quiet = await cli(["order-texts", held.id, "--reasons"], "Reasons.");
    expect(quiet.text).toContain("The notice is held: it will show the text once it is released");
    expect(await told(heldDecision)).toMatchObject({ informed: false, mail: "none" });
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-end", held.id, "--reason", "released_by_authority", "--how", "the authority's letter"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect(await release()).toBe(1);
    const afterRelease = (await orderNoticeOf(w.apiDb, heldDecision, "DE"))!;
    expect(afterRelease.texts.textsAt).toBe(afterRelease.facts.informedAt);
    expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.apiDb, heldDecision))!.statement, { texts: afterRelease.texts }).join(" ")).not.toContain("korbat added the authority's words");
  });

  test("the hold's commands: one extension of 42 days, refused a second time and after the release; a DSA order's end is the authority's, and with none nothing is released; ending a hold tells at the next round", async () => {
    const p = await post();
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
    const done = await effect(order);
    const until = async (id: string) => (await w.apiDb.execute<{ until: string | null }>(sql`select public.order_hold_until(${id}::uuid)::text as until`))[0]!.until;
    const first = await until(order.id);
    const extended = await cli(["order-hold-extend", order.id, "--received", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "the authority's reasoned decision"]);
    expect(extended.code).toBe(0);
    const [days] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ days: number }>(sql`select extract(day from public.order_hold_until(${order.id}::uuid) - ${first}::timestamptz)::int as days`);
    expect(days!.days).toBe(ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays);
    const again = await cli(["order-hold-extend", order.id, "--received", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "again"]);
    expect([again.code, again.text]).toEqual([1, expect.stringContaining("already extended once")]);
    // Ended as korbat's own mistake is refused while the first period of an extended hold runs; another reason ends it.
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-end", order.id, "--reason", "not_ordered", "--how", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-end", order.id, "--reason", "annulled", "--how", "the court's ruling"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect(await release()).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(await told(done.items[0]!.decisionId!)).toMatchObject({ informed: true });
    const late = await cli(["order-hold-extend", order.id, "--received", new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--how", "late"]);
    expect([late.code, late.text]).toEqual([1, expect.stringContaining("already released")]);
    // A DSA order whose author must not be told, given effect as urgent by an admin: no end until the authority names one.
    const d = await post();
    const dsa = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, admin, { kind: "dsa_art9", posts: [d.postId], sectionC: true });
    const urgent = await effectForTest(world, admin, dsa.id, { ...effectParams(dsa), urgent: true });
    if (typeof urgent === "string") throw new Error(urgent);
    expect(await until(dsa.id)).toBe("infinity");
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-extend", dsa.id, "--received", new Date().toISOString(), "--how", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    const named = await cli(["order-hold-until", dsa.id, new Date(Date.now() + 90 * 86_400_000).toISOString(), "--basis", "the order's sentence 3", "--how", "read in the order"]);
    expect(named.code).toBe(0);
    expect(named.text).toContain("held until");
    expect(await release()).toBe(0);
    // An end in the past changes nothing without --release.
    const past = await cli(["order-hold-until", dsa.id, new Date(Date.now() - 60_000).toISOString(), "--basis", "b", "--how", "h"]);
    expect([past.code, past.text]).toEqual([1, expect.stringContaining("give --release")]);
  });

  test("the dispatch round releases what a hold no longer keeps before its statements, with one audit row order_notices_released by the system", async () => {
    const p = await post();
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
    const done = await effect(order);
    expect((await cli(["order-hold-end", order.id, "--reason", "not_authentic", "--how", "the register has no such authority"])).code).toBe(0);
    const report = await dispatchRound(world.moderation.deps, new MemoryJobLock());
    expect(report.noticesReleased).toBe(1);
    const [audit] = await w.apiDb.execute<{ actor_id: string; metadata: { count: number } }>(
      sql`select actor_id, metadata from public.audit_log where action = 'order_notices_released' order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    expect([audit!.actor_id, audit!.metadata.count]).toEqual([SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, 1]);
    // The statement's step tried its mail in the same round; no address takes one here, so it stays owed, and is not
    // given up for the weeks it was held: a mail is owed from its telling.
    expect(await told(done.items[0]!.decisionId!)).toMatchObject({ informed: true, mail: "pending" });
    const notice = (await orderNoticeOf(w.apiDb, done.items[0]!.decisionId!, "DE"))!;
    expect([notice.facts.held, notice.facts.holdEndReason]).toEqual([true, "not_authentic"]);
  });

  test("hold_ending warns every staff account daily in the last days before a hold's end, and not before", async () => {
    const p = await post();
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId], sectionC: true });
    await effect(order);
    const since = new Date();
    // The other held notices of this file end later than the warning's days; this one ends sooner.
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = now() + make_interval(days => ${ORDER_RULES.holdWarningDays + 3}) where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'hold_ending'`);
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
    const none = await outboxSince(world.migrateDb, "hold_ending", since);
    await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = now() + make_interval(days => 2) where id = ${order.id}::uuid`);
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
    const warned = await outboxSince(world.migrateDb, "hold_ending", since);
    expect(none).toEqual([]);
    expect(warned).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(warned[0]!.facts.count).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect([warned[0]!.priority, warned[0]!.scope]).toEqual([3, "all"]);
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
    expect((await outboxSince(world.migrateDb, "hold_ending", since)).length).toBe(warned.length);
    // The notice's words of the hold do not depend on its own warning.
    expect(ORDER_NOTICE.heldUntilNow.tco_removal("a", "b")).toContain("must not be told");
    expect(STAFF_USAGE).toContain("order-hold-end");
  });
});
```
