```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { and, eq, gt, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { stepUpActionHash } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { auditHead, auditLog, closeDb, createDb, staffKeys, users, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { AUDIT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE, auditVerify, checkAuditRecord, runStaffCommand, type AuditReport } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { CHAIN_VECTORS } from "../staff/chain-vectors";
import { flowHarness } from "./flow-harness";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { TEST_CONSOLE, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount, newStaffKey, rolledBack, withLockTimeout } from "./staff-fixtures";
import { revokeConfirmed, signedIn } from "./staff-step-up";

/**
 * audit-verify (3a design, sections 7 and 12) against the real database: the canonical text in Node against the trigger's
 * in SQL, the chain under concurrent writers, rewrites by the owner detected against kept places, and every staff key's
 * one staff_key_added row. Every test that writes a row audit-verify must refuse does it in a transaction that ends in a
 * rollback and hands that transaction to the verifier's check, so no later suite sees a broken chain.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: audit-verify", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  const actorId = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000";

  /** One ordinary row, as a writer on the API role inserts it: no id, time or chain column supplied. */
  const insertRow = (db: Db | DbTx, action = `probe-${randomUUID()}`) =>
    db.insert(auditLog).values({ actorId, action, targetType: "user", targetId: randomUUID(), metadata: { via: "test" } }).returning();

  const readHead = async (db: Db | DbTx = apiDb) => (await db.select().from(auditHead))[0]!;
  const hashAt = async (seq: number) => (await apiDb.select({ hash: auditLog.hash }).from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, seq)))[0]!.hash;

  /**
   * What the owner can do: chain every row from place `from` again with the database's own text function, as migration
   * 0012's back-fill does, and move the head, so a plain recompute of the chain passes over the changed rows.
   */
  const rechainFrom = (tx: DbTx, from: number) =>
    tx.execute(
      sql.raw(`DO $$
        DECLARE r public.audit_log; prev text;
        BEGIN
          SELECT hash INTO prev FROM public.audit_log WHERE chain_seq = ${from - 1};
          FOR r IN SELECT * FROM public.audit_log WHERE chain_seq >= ${from} ORDER BY chain_seq LOOP
            prev := encode(sha256(convert_to(prev || public.audit_chain_text(r), 'UTF8')), 'hex');
            UPDATE public.audit_log SET prev_hash = (SELECT hash FROM public.audit_log WHERE chain_seq = r.chain_seq - 1), hash = prev WHERE id = r.id;
          END LOOP;
          UPDATE public.audit_head SET hash = prev WHERE id = 1;
        END $$`),
    );

  /** The verifier's own connections, as the command line opens them: one on each role. */
  const ownConnections = () => ({ api: createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 }), auth: createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 1 }) });

  /**
   * What the command line printed, and its exit code, for a run with the given environment changes; with `inherit` false,
   * the run sees `env` alone and nothing of the test environment.
   */
  async function cli(args: string[], env: Record<string, string> = {}, inherit = true) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, inherit ? { ...process.env, ...env } : env, { log: (line) => lines.push(line), error: (line) => lines.push(line) });
    return { code, text: lines.join("\n") };
  }

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    // The migrate role is not part of the API configuration; the test environment carries it.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    // A few committed rows, so the log is never empty whatever order the suites run in.
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) await withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) => insertRow(tx));
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  test("a whole chain passes, with the head, and every kept place it is given", async () => {
    const head = await readHead();
    const connections = ownConnections();
    try {
      const plain = await auditVerify(connections, []);
      expect(plain).toMatchObject({ ok: true, rows: head.seq, head: { seq: head.seq, hash: head.hash }, keptChecked: 0, unanchored: head.seq, problems: [], problemCount: 0 });
      const kept = await auditVerify(connections, [
        { seq: 1, hash: await hashAt(1) },
        { seq: head.seq - 1, hash: await hashAt(head.seq - 1) },
      ]);
      expect(kept).toMatchObject({ ok: true, keptChecked: 2, unanchored: 1, problems: [] });
    } finally {
      await Promise.all([closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
    }
  });

  describe("parity: the canonical text in Node and in SQL", () => {
    test("the vectors' rows, written through the trigger from a session in another time zone and date style, recompute to their stored hashes", async () => {
      // One connection, so the session's settings hold for the transaction below.
      const odd = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 });
      try {

        await odd.execute(sql`set datestyle = 'SQL, DMY'`);
        // Rolled back: the step-up row carries an assertion no stored key made, which audit-verify's step-up checks refuse.
        await rolledBack(odd, async (tx) => {
          const [settings] = await tx.execute<{ tz: string; ds: string }>(sql`select current_setting('TimeZone') as tz, current_setting('DateStyle') as ds`);
          expect(settings).toEqual({ tz: "Asia/Kathmandu", ds: "SQL, DMY" });
          const before = await readHead(tx);
          const written: number[] = [];
          for (const vector of CHAIN_VECTORS) {
            const [row] = await tx.insert(auditLog).values(vector.insert).returning({ id: auditLog.id });
            written.push(row!.id);

          const texts = await tx
            .select({ id: auditLog.id, metadata: sql<string>`${auditLog.metadata}::text`, stepUp: sql<string | null>`${auditLog.stepUp}::text` })
            .from(auditLog)

          // The API role cannot read the staff keys: they come from the auth role's pool, as the command line reads them.
          // Every hash recomputes. Two rows are refused for what they are: the step-up vector, whose assertion no stored
          // key made, and which is the last vector; and the vector that records a decision on a case with no step-up at
          // all, an action that only a staff key's confirmation may leave in the record.
          const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, [], authDb);

          ]);
          expect(report.rows).toBe(before.seq + CHAIN_VECTORS.length);
        });
      } finally {
        await closeDb(odd);
      }
    });
  });

  describe("concurrency", () => {
    test("several sessions insert at once, some inside transactions, while keys are enrolled: every run passes, during and after", async () => {
      const WRITERS = 6;
      const EACH = 10;
      const config = loadConfig();
      // One connection per writer, each with a lock timeout for the whole session.
      const writers = Array.from({ length: WRITERS }, () => createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 1 }));
      const connections = ownConnections();
      const reports: AuditReport[] = [];
      let writing = true;
      try {
        await Promise.all(writers.map((db) => db.execute(sql`set lock_timeout = '10s'`)));
        const verifying = (async () => {
          while (writing) reports.push(await auditVerify(connections, []));
        })();
        await Promise.all([
          ...writers.map(async (db, w) => {
            for (let i = 0; i < EACH; i++) {
              const action = `concurrent-verify-${w}-${i}`;
              if (i % 2 === 0) {
                await insertRow(db, action);
              } else {
                // A transaction that waits a moment before its insert, which is its last statement, as every audit write's.
                await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
                  await tx.execute(sql`select pg_sleep(${Math.random() * 0.01})`);
                  await insertRow(tx, action);
                });
              }
            }
          }),

          (async () => {

        expect(final).toMatchObject({ ok: true, rows: head.seq, head: { seq: head.seq, hash: head.hash }, keysLeftToNextRun: 0, problems: [] });

      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {

        const kept = { seq: last.chainSeq, hash: last.hash };
        await tx.delete(auditLog).where(gt(auditLog.chainSeq, first.chainSeq));
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ seq: first.chainSeq, hash: first.hash }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([]);
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [kept])).problems).toEqual([{ place: kept.seq, message: `the kept place ${kept.seq}:${kept.hash} no longer matches: no row is at that place` }]);
      });
    });

    test("the head: missing, behind the newest row, beyond it, or with another hash", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.delete(auditHead);
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: null, message: "the audit head is missing" }]);
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [first, middle] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ seq: first.chainSeq, hash: first.hash }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: middle.chainSeq, message: `rows lie beyond the head's place ${first.chainSeq}, from place ${middle.chainSeq}` }]);
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, , last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ seq: last.chainSeq + 5 }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: null, message: `the head names place ${last.chainSeq + 5}, but the newest row up to it is at place ${last.chainSeq}` }]);
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, , last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditHead).set({ hash: "e".repeat(64) }).where(eq(auditHead.id, 1));
        expect((await checkAuditRecord(tx, [])).problems).toEqual([{ place: last.chainSeq, message: "the head's hash is not the hash of the row at its place" }]);
      });
    });

    test("a row moved to place 0, or beyond the head, is named", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, middle] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ chainSeq: 0 }).where(eq(auditLog.id, middle.id));
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: 0, message: "its place is not in the chain, which runs from place 1" });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: middle.chainSeq, message: `place ${middle.chainSeq} is missing` });
      });
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const [, middle, last] = await threeRows(tx);
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ chainSeq: last.chainSeq + 10 }).where(eq(auditLog.id, middle.id));
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: last.chainSeq + 10, message: `rows lie beyond the head's place ${last.chainSeq}, from place ${last.chainSeq + 10}` });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: middle.chainSeq, message: `place ${middle.chainSeq} is missing` });
      });
    });

    /**
     * What the owner can do to plant a row the walk by place never reaches: turn the trigger off and drop the unique index
     * on chain_seq (or its NOT NULL), then insert. The planted row is a step-up action's with no confirmation, which a walk
     * that read it would refuse; it repeats the genuine row's prev_hash and hash, so no other row or the head changes.
     */
    const plant = (tx: DbTx, place: number | null, copy: { prevHash: string; hash: string }) =>
      tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, chain_version, chain_seq, prev_hash, hash)
        values (${actorId}::uuid, 'staff_session_revoked', 'staff_session', ${randomUUID()}, '{"params": {}}'::jsonb, 1, ${place}::bigint, ${copy.prevHash}, ${copy.hash})`);

    test("a second row at a place that ends a page of the walk is read and refused", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        // Enough rows that a page of the walk ends at a place, with rows after it.
        const page = AUDIT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE;
        const short = page + 5 - (await readHead(tx)).seq;
        if (short > 0) {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata)
            select ${actorId}::uuid, 'probe-page', 'user', gen_random_uuid()::text, '{"via": "test"}'::jsonb from generate_series(1, ${short})`);
        }
        const [genuine] = await tx.select().from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, page));
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.audit_log disable trigger audit_chain`);
        await tx.execute(sql`drop index public.audit_log_chain_seq_idx`);
        // A plain index in its place, as the owner might leave it: equal places come back oldest row first, so a walk by
        // place alone reads the genuine row and never the second.
        await tx.execute(sql`create index audit_log_chain_seq_plain on public.audit_log (chain_seq)`);
        await plant(tx, page, genuine!);
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: page, message: "another row is already at this place" });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: page, message: "its action, staff_session_revoked, needs a step-up, and it carries none" });
        expect(report.problems).toContainEqual({ place: null, message: "1 row is at a place another row already holds" });
      });
    });

    test("3f: a correction of an order's record under the rule entry or caution carries no step-up and is accepted; one under admin needs it", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const before = (await readHead(tx)).seq;
        for (const rule of ["entry", "caution", "admin"]) {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata)
            values (${actorId}::uuid, 'order_corrected', 'order', ${randomUUID()}, ${JSON.stringify({ rule, changed: [] })}::jsonb)`);
        }
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems.filter((problem) => problem.place !== null && problem.place > before)).toEqual([
          { place: before + 3, message: "its action, order_corrected, needs a step-up, and it carries none" },
        ]);
      });
    });

    test("a row with no place at all is counted and refused", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const head = await readHead(tx);
        const [newest] = await tx.select().from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, head.seq));
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.audit_log disable trigger audit_chain`);
        await tx.execute(sql`alter table public.audit_log alter column chain_seq drop not null`);
        await plant(tx, null, newest!);
        const total = (await tx.select({ n: sql<string>`count(*)::text` }).from(auditLog))[0]!.n;
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(false);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([
          { place: null, message: "1 row of the audit log has no place in the chain" },
          { place: null, message: `the audit log holds ${total} rows, but ${head.seq} were read up to the head and 0 lie beyond it` },
        ]);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("step-up confirmations", () => {
    const harness = () => flowHarness(repo, { console: TEST_CONSOLE });

    /**
     * A staff account with a key enrolled through the flow and three sessions; from the first it revokes the other two,
     * each confirmed with the key through the step-up flow: two genuine step-up rows, committed, as only the flow writes them.
     */
    async function confirmedRevocations() {
      const h = harness();
      const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo);
      const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const enrolled = await enrolKey(h, soft, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id)).token);
      const [a, b, c] = [await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 1), await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 2), await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 3)];
      expect((await revokeConfirmed(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, a.session, b.session.handle, 4)).revoked).toBe(true);
      expect((await revokeConfirmed(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, a.session, c.session.handle, 5)).revoked).toBe(true);
      const rowOf = async (handle: string) => (await apiDb.select().from(auditLog).where(and(eq(auditLog.action, "staff_session_revoked"), eq(auditLog.targetId, handle))))[0]!;
      return { user, keyId: enrolled.key.id, a: a.session, b: b.session, c: c.session, first: await rowOf(b.session.handle), second: await rowOf(c.session.handle) };
    }

    /** The problems a check found, as place and message, each expected to name the step-up check. */
    const stepUpProblems = (report: AuditReport) => report.problems.map((p) => ({ place: p.place, stepUp: /step-up/.test(p.message) }));

    test("genuine confirmations pass: on the command line's own connections, with the console off, and with nothing but the database URLs", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await confirmedRevocations();
      expect(s.first).toMatchObject({ staffSession: s.a.handle, keyId: s.keyId, actorId: s.user.id });
      expect(s.first.stepUp).not.toBeNull();
      const connections = ownConnections();
      try {
        const report = await auditVerify(connections, []);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([]);
        expect(report.ok).toBe(true);
      } finally {
        await Promise.all([closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
      }
      const off = await cli(["audit-verify"], { CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "", CONSOLE_RP_ID: "" });
      expect(off.code, off.text).toBe(0);
      const bare = await cli(["audit-verify"], { DATABASE_URL_API: process.env.DATABASE_URL_API!, DATABASE_URL_AUTH: process.env.DATABASE_URL_AUTH! }, false);
      expect(bare.code, bare.text).toBe(0);
    });

    test("a confirmed row changed by the owner with the chain and the head recomputed fails on its step-up alone: its params, its target, its session, its hash with its params, or its time past the challenge's expiry", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await confirmedRevocations();
      const otherParams = { params: { all: true } };
      const changes: [string, Record<string, unknown>, RegExp][] = [
        ["its params", { metadata: otherParams }, /^its step-up's action hash is not the hash of its action, target and params$/],
        ["its target", { targetId: s.c.handle }, /^its step-up's action hash is not the hash of its action, target and params$/],
        ["its session", { staffSession: s.b.handle }, /^its step-up's challenge was not issued for this action in this session$/],
        [
          "its params and its action hash together",
          { metadata: otherParams, actionHash: await stepUpActionHash({ action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: s.b.handle }, params: otherParams.params }) },
          /^its step-up's challenge was not issued for this action in this session$/,
        ],
        ["its time, past the challenge's expiry", { createdAt: new Date(s.first.createdAt.getTime() + 11 * 60_000) }, /^its step-up's challenge had expired when the row was written$/],
      ];
      for (const [label, change, message] of changes) {
        await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
          await tx.update(auditLog).set(change).where(eq(auditLog.id, s.first.id));
          await rechainFrom(tx, s.first.chainSeq);
          const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
          expect(report.problems, label).toEqual([{ place: s.first.chainSeq, message: expect.stringMatching(message) }]);
        });
      }
      // Nothing of it outlives the rollbacks.
      const connections = ownConnections();
      try {
        expect((await auditVerify(connections, [])).problems).toEqual([]);
      } finally {
        await Promise.all([closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
      }
    });

    test("an assertion moved to another row fails there, on its binding and as a challenge used twice", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await confirmedRevocations();
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        // The first row's assertion, signed by the same key in the same session, on the second row: only the binding of
        // its target, and the challenge's second use, give it away.
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ stepUp: s.first.stepUp }).where(eq(auditLog.id, s.second.id));
        await rechainFrom(tx, s.second.chainSeq);
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([
          { place: s.second.chainSeq, message: "its step-up's challenge was not issued for this action in this session" },
          { place: s.second.chainSeq, message: `its step-up's challenge was already used at place ${s.first.chainSeq}` },
        ]);
      });
    });

    test("a row of a step-up action without a confirmation fails, whatever its actor: a staff account, a demoted one, the system", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await confirmedRevocations();
      const { user: demoted } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo);
      await authDb.update(users).set({ role: "user" }).where(eq(users.id, demoted.id));
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const places: number[] = [];
        for (const actor of [s.user.id, demoted.id, actorId]) {
          const [row] = await tx
            .insert(auditLog)
            .values({ actorId: actor, action: "staff_session_revoked", targetType: "staff_session", targetId: randomUUID(), staffSession: randomUUID(), metadata: { params: {} } })
            .returning({ chainSeq: auditLog.chainSeq });
          places.push(row!.chainSeq);
        }
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual(places.map((place) => ({ place, message: "its action, staff_session_revoked, needs a step-up, and it carries none" })));
      });
    });

    test("a confirmation whose key belongs to another account than the row's actor fails, as one whose key records another origin or relying party ID", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await confirmedRevocations();
      const { user: other } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo);
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ actorId: other.id }).where(eq(auditLog.id, s.first.id));
        await rechainFrom(tx, s.first.chainSeq);
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([{ place: s.first.chainSeq, message: `its step-up's key ${s.keyId} belongs to another account than its actor` }]);
      });
      // The key's recorded origin and relying party ID, which the owner can change too: the confirmation was made for
      // the ones the key was enrolled with, never checked against the console's configuration.
      for (const [label, change, message] of [
        ["origin", { origin: "http://console.example:8090" }, "its step-up's client data is not a webauthn.get from the origin recorded on its key"],
        ["relying party ID", { rpId: "console.example" }, "its step-up's authenticator data does not name the relying party ID recorded on its key"],
      ] as const) {
        await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
          await tx.update(staffKeys).set(change).where(eq(staffKeys.id, s.keyId));
          const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
          expect(report.problems, label).toEqual([
            { place: s.first.chainSeq, message },
            { place: s.second.chainSeq, message },
          ]);
        });
      }
    });

    test("a signature that does not verify with the key's public key fails", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const s = await confirmedRevocations();
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const stepUp = s.first.stepUp as { authenticatorData: string; clientDataJSON: string; signature: string };
        const signature = Buffer.from(stepUp.signature, "base64url");
        signature[signature.length - 1] = signature[signature.length - 1]! ^ 0xff;
        await tx.update(auditLog).set({ stepUp: { ...stepUp, signature: signature.toString("base64url") } }).where(eq(auditLog.id, s.first.id));
        await rechainFrom(tx, s.first.chainSeq);
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([{ place: s.first.chainSeq, message: `its step-up's signature does not verify with the public key of key ${s.keyId}` }]);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("staff keys", () => {
    test("a key without its staff_key_added row fails, naming the key", async () => {
      const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo);
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        // Only the owner can plant one: the auth role cannot insert a key, and add_staff_key writes the row with it.
        const [key] = await tx
          .insert(staffKeys)
          .values({ userId: user.id, credentialId: randomUUID(), publicKey: "cose-key", name: "planted", origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, rpId: "console.localhost" })
          .returning({ id: staffKeys.id });
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, []);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([{ place: null, message: `staff key ${key!.id} has no staff_key_added row` }]);
      });
    });

    test("a key enrolled after the head a run read, before it read the keys, is left to the next run, which checks it", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const connections = ownConnections();
      try {
        // The keys are read on the auth role right after the head; a key enrolled between the two has its staff_key_added
        // row beyond the head this run read, so the run leaves it to the next instead of calling it a problem.
        let enrolled: string | undefined;
        const between = {
          select: (fields: Parameters<Db["select"]>[0]) => ({
            from: (table: typeof staffKeys) => ({
              then: (resolve: (rows: unknown) => unknown, reject: (err: unknown) => unknown) =>
                newStaffKey(authDb, migrateDb, repo)
                  .then((added) => {
                    enrolled = added.key.id;
                    return connections.auth.select(fields!).from(table);
                  })
                  .then(resolve, reject),
            }),
          }),
        } as unknown as Db;
        const report = await auditVerify({ api: connections.api, auth: between }, []);
        expect(enrolled).toBeDefined();
        expect(report).toMatchObject({ ok: true, keysLeftToNextRun: 1, problems: [] });
        // The next run reads a head beyond the key's row, and checks the key.
        const next = await auditVerify(connections, []);
        expect(next).toMatchObject({ ok: true, keysLeftToNextRun: 0, problems: [] });
        expect(next.keysChecked).toBe(report.keysChecked);
      } finally {
        await Promise.all([closeDb(connections.api), closeDb(connections.auth)]);
      }
    });

    test("a key with a second staff_key_added row fails, naming both places", async () => {
      const { key } = await newStaffKey(authDb, migrateDb, repo);
      const [first] = await apiDb.select({ seq: auditLog.chainSeq }).from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.keyId, key.id));
      // The API role can insert any action; a second row claiming the key's addition is refused by audit-verify.
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
        const [second] = await tx.insert(auditLog).values({ actorId, action: "staff_key_added", targetType: "staff_key", targetId: key.id, keyId: key.id }).returning();
        const report = await checkAuditRecord(tx, [], authDb);
        expect(report.problems).toEqual([{ place: null, message: `staff key ${key.id} has 2 staff_key_added rows (places ${first!.seq}, ${second!.chainSeq})` }]);
      });
    });
  });

  describe("the command line", () => {
    test("audit-verify passes the same with the console off and on, and needs nothing of the console's configuration", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const envs: Record<string, string>[] = [{ CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "" }, { CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "", CONSOLE_RP_ID: "" }, { CONSOLE_ORIGIN: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN }];
      for (const env of envs) {
        const run = await cli(["audit-verify", `${head.seq}:${head.hash}`], env);
        expect(run.code, JSON.stringify(env)).toBe(0);
        expect(run.text).toContain(`the chain holds: ${head.seq} rows, from place 1 to the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash}`);
        expect(run.text).toContain("1 kept place checked; 0 rows after the newest kept place are not yet anchored");
      }
    });

    test("audit-verify and audit-head run given the database URLs alone: no secret, no other setting, and a console setting the API refuses changes nothing", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const urls = { DATABASE_URL_API: process.env.DATABASE_URL_API!, DATABASE_URL_AUTH: process.env.DATABASE_URL_AUTH! };
      const envs: Record<string, string>[] = [
        urls,
        // A final slash, which the API's configuration refuses in CONSOLE_ORIGIN.
        { ...urls, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "https://console.example/" },
        // The console on the app's origin, which it refuses too.
        { ...urls, APP_ORIGIN: process.env.APP_ORIGIN!, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: process.env.APP_ORIGIN! },
      ];
      for (const env of envs) {
        const run = await cli(["audit-verify", `${head.seq}:${head.hash}`], env, false);
        expect(run.code, JSON.stringify(Object.keys(env))).toBe(0);
        expect(run.text).toContain(`the chain holds: ${head.seq} rows, from place 1 to the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash}`);
      }
      const headRun = await cli(["audit-head"], { DATABASE_URL_API: urls.DATABASE_URL_API }, false);
      expect(headRun.code).toBe(0);
      expect(headRun.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`^${head.seq}:${head.hash} `));
    });

    test("audit-verify exits 1 and names the place at fault when a kept place does not match", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const run = await cli(["audit-verify", `1:${await hashAt(1)}`, `${head.seq}:${"f".repeat(64)}`]);
      expect(run.code).toBe(1);
      expect(run.text).toContain("audit-verify: FAILED");
      expect(run.text).toContain(`place ${head.seq}: the kept place ${head.seq}:${"f".repeat(64)} no longer matches`);
    });

    test("audit-head prints the newest place, its hash and its time, and they are what audit_head holds", async () => {
      const head = await readHead();
      const [newest] = await apiDb.select().from(auditLog).where(eq(auditLog.chainSeq, head.seq));
      const run = await cli(["audit-head"], { CONSOLE_ORIGIN: "" });
      expect(run.code).toBe(0);
      expect(run.text).toBe(`${head.seq}:${head.hash} ${newest!.createdAt.toISOString()}`);
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";

 * transaction with the 10-second lock timeout, the order's row first, its event via `cli` and its audit row
 * order_recorded last under the system actor, never a text in the audit row but its digest; a refusal is one sentence
 * ending in "nothing changed", exit 1, and writes nothing. order-open writes the console's rows through insertOrder with
 * the receipt it is given, its alert order_opened before its audit row, and refuses without HOME_STATE and APP_ORIGIN. An
 * order is named by its id or as <CC>:<reference>, order_ambiguous when several share it; an instant has its offset.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the order commands", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;

  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const messages: string[] = [];

  let appOrigin: string;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    appOrigin = loadConfig().APP_ORIGIN;
    w = noticesWorld();
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });

    author = await newProfile(w.apiDb);

  afterAll(async () => {

  const env = (extra: Record<string, string> = {}) => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin, ...extra });
  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code; standard input as given. */
  async function cli(args: string[], options: { env?: Record<string, string>; input?: string | Buffer } = {}) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const input = async () => (options.input === undefined ? Buffer.alloc(0) : Buffer.isBuffer(options.input) ? options.input : Buffer.from(options.input, "utf8"));
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, options.env ?? env(), { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, input);

  }
```

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { beforeAll, expect, test } from "vitest";
import type { AppealsReviewedParams, CaseDecidedParams, RuleId } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, AuthForModeration, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../../src/auth";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { verifyStepUp } from "../../src/auth/staff/step-up";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryStore, type RateLimitStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration, type DecideOutcome } from "../../src/moderation";
import { decide, type DecideOptions } from "../../src/moderation/decide";
import { recordIntake } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { flowHarness } from "./flow-harness";
import { act, ageStandingForTest, casesMedia, decisionParams, ground, moderationCounts, newPostRow, noAuthForModeration, removeDecided, reviewParams, timed, uuids, type DecisionInput, type ReviewInput, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { TEST_CONSOLE, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount } from "./staff-fixtures";
import { signedIn, stepUpAssertion } from "./staff-step-up";

/**
 * Decisions that commit (3c design, section 12). A committed decision carries an audit row for good, and audit-verify
 * refuses every case_decided row whose step-up is not a real assertion of its actor's staff key over exactly that action.
 * So a test that commits a decision confirms it as the console does: a staff account with a key enrolled through the
 * enrolment flow on the software authenticator, a staff session opened by the sign-in flow, step-up options for the
 * action, the authenticator's assertion, the auth module's verification, and then the moderation module's decide.
 */

/** A staff account whose key the software authenticator holds, signed in at the test console. */
export interface RealStaff extends TestStaff {
  handle: string;
  soft: SoftAuthenticator;
  credentialId: string;
  session: ActiveStaffSession;
  /** The signature counter the authenticator last reported; each use reports the next. */
  counter: number;
}

export interface DeciderWorld {
  authDb: Db;
  migrateDb: Db;
  /** The moderation module on the API's pool, as the server builds it. */
  moderation: ReturnType<typeof createModeration>;
  /** A new staff account with a profile, a real key and a staff session. */
  staff(role?: "moderator" | "admin"): Promise<RealStaff>;
  /** A verified confirmation of exactly these params, by the member's own key in the member's session. */
  confirm(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed>;
  /** A whole confirmed decision on the case: the params as the console builds them, the confirmation, and decide. */
  decideAs(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input?: DecisionInput, options?: DecideOptions): Promise<DecideOutcome>;
  /** A verified confirmation of exactly this review of the decision, by the member's own key in the member's session. */
  confirmReview(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed>;
  /** A whole confirmed review of the decision's pending appeal: the params as the console builds them, the confirmation, and review. */
  reviewAs(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, input?: ReviewInput): Promise<DecideOutcome>;
  /** 3f: a verified confirmation of an order's action (the effect, an event, a correction), by the member's own key in the member's session. */
  confirmOrder(member: RealStaff, action: "order_effected" | "order_event_recorded" | "order_corrected", orderId: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed>;
  /** Removes the staff profiles this world made (their decisions, findings and texts must be gone by then) and closes its pools. */
  close(options?: { keepStaff?: boolean }): Promise<void>;
}

/** What a test may give the world in place of its own: the auth module's interface (none unless given: every member then throws) and the limit store. */
export interface DeciderOptions {
  auth?: AuthForModeration;
  rateLimitStore?: RateLimitStore;
}

export function deciderWorld(apiDb: Db, options: DeciderOptions = {}): DeciderWorld {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
  // The migrate role issues enrolment links, which only it may; the test environment carries its URL.
  const migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
  const repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
  const h = flowHarness(repo, { console: TEST_CONSOLE });
  // Unless a test hands over the auth module's interface, the module is built without one: what follows a decision's
  // commit (the statement's mail, the staff alerts) then fails there, is logged, and leaves the decision as committed.
  const moderation = createModeration({
    apiDb,
    auth: options.auth ?? noAuthForModeration(),
    social: socialForModeration(apiDb),
    media: casesMedia(apiDb),
    rateLimitStore: options.rateLimitStore ?? new MemoryStore(),
    config,
    logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
  });
  const members: RealStaff[] = [];
  /**
   * The harness's clock stands still unless moved, and a step-up challenge lives ten minutes from it; the audit row is
   * stamped by the database's clock. So the harness's clock is brought to the real time before every flow.
   */
  const sync = () => h.clock.advance(Date.now() - h.clock.ms());

  async function staff(role: "moderator" | "admin" = "moderator"): Promise<RealStaff> {
    sync();
    const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo, role);
    const handle = `st_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: user.id, handle, displayName: "Staff" });
    const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
    const enrolled = await enrolKey(h, soft, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id)).token);
    const { session } = await signedIn(h, soft, enrolled.credentialId, 1);
    const member: RealStaff = { id: user.id, keyId: enrolled.key.id, role, handle, soft, credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, session, counter: 1 };
    members.push(member);
    return member;
  }

  async function confirm(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, params: CaseDecidedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed> {
    sync();
    const request = { action: "case_decided" as const, target: { type: "case" as const, id: caseId }, params };
    const stepUp = await stepUpAssertion(h, member.soft, member.credentialId, member.session, request, { counter: ++member.counter });
    return verifyStepUp(h.deps, member.session, request, stepUp, { ...h.ctx, requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
  }

  async function decideAs(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput = {}, options: DecideOptions = {}): Promise<DecideOutcome> {
    const params = await decisionParams(apiDb, member, caseId, input);
    const confirmed = await confirm(member, caseId, params);
    const ctx = { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` };
    // With allKinds the module's own decide is called below the route, as decideWith does: the routes' list of kinds is lifted.
    const outcome = options.allKinds ? await decide(moderation.deps, member.session, confirmed, ctx, options) : await moderation.forStaff.decide(member.session, confirmed, ctx);
    // What a decision starts after its commit (the statement's mail, the staff alerts) has ended before the test goes on.
    await moderation.settle();
    return outcome;
  }

  async function confirmReview(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, params: AppealsReviewedParams): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed> {
    sync();
    const request = { action: "appeals_reviewed" as const, target: { type: "decision" as const, id: decisionId }, params };
    const stepUp = await stepUpAssertion(h, member.soft, member.credentialId, member.session, request, { counter: ++member.counter });
    return verifyStepUp(h.deps, member.session, request, stepUp, { ...h.ctx, requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
  }

  async function reviewAs(member: RealStaff, decisionId: string, input: ReviewInput = {}): Promise<DecideOutcome> {
    const params = await reviewParams(apiDb, member, decisionId, input);
    const outcome = await moderation.forStaff.review(member.session, await confirmReview(member, decisionId, params), { requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
    // As after a decision: what the review started after its commit has ended before the test goes on.
    await moderation.settle();
    return outcome;
  }

  async function confirmOrder(member: RealStaff, action: "order_effected" | "order_event_recorded" | "order_corrected", orderId: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<StaffStepUpConfirmed> {
    sync();
    const request = { action, target: { type: "order" as const, id: orderId }, params } as Parameters<typeof stepUpAssertion>[4];
    const stepUp = await stepUpAssertion(h, member.soft, member.credentialId, member.session, request, { counter: ++member.counter });
    return verifyStepUp(h.deps, member.session, request, stepUp, { ...h.ctx, requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` });
  }

  async function close(options: { keepStaff?: boolean } = {}): Promise<void> {
    try {
      if (!options.keepStaff && members.length > 0) await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from profiles where id = any(${uuids(members.map((member) => member.id))})`);
    } finally {
      await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
    }
  }

  return { authDb, migrateDb, moderation, staff, confirm, decideAs, confirmReview, reviewAs, confirmOrder, close };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- decideForTest

let world: DeciderWorld | null = null;
let admin: Promise<RealStaff> | null = null;
/** The posts decideForTest decided in this test file. */
const decidedPosts = new Set<string>();
/** The accounts suspendForTest suspended in this test file: their account cases go with closeDecisions. */
const decidedAccounts = new Set<string>();

/** The id of a committed decision, or a failure that says why none committed. */
function decided(outcome: DecideOutcome, what: string): string {
  if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`decideForTest: ${what} was not recorded (${outcome})`);
  return outcome.decisionId;
}

/**
 * Puts a post into a moderation state the only way one comes about: by a real, confirmed decision (3c design, section
 * 12). The suites of posting, timelines, Explore and images used to write posts.state themselves; the posts' guard now
 * refuses that for the API role, and nothing but the ledger of measures moves a post's level.
 *
 * - `withheld`: an admin's own finding under R1 opens a case on the post, and an interim decision withholds it.
 * - `removed`: the same finding, and a final decision removes it, which closes the case.
 * - `visible`: what was done is undone: the post's open case is closed by a final decision that finds no breach, which
 *   ends its interim withhold, and every removal in force is reversed in full by a correction.
 *
 * It takes the API's pool. The staff account, its key and its session are made once for each test file; closeDecisions
 * removes what the decisions left.
 */
export async function decideForTest(apiDb: Db, postId: string, state: "withheld" | "removed" | "visible"): Promise<void> {
  world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
  admin ??= world.staff("admin");
  const [w, staff] = [world, await admin];
  decidedPosts.add(postId);
  if (state === "visible") {
    const [open] = await apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from cases where target_type = 'post' and target_id = ${postId}::uuid and closed_at is null`);
    if (open) decided(await w.decideAs(staff, open.id, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" }), "the closing decision");
    const removals = await apiDb.execute<{ decision_id: string; case_id: string }>(sql`select decision_id, case_id from measures_in_force where post_id = ${postId}::uuid and kind = 'remove'`);
    for (const removal of removals) {
      decided(await w.decideAs(staff, removal.case_id, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal.decision_id, actions: [act("restore")] }), "the correction");
    }
    return;
  }
  const recorded = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, "R1"), live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1 }] });
  const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
  decided(await w.decideAs(staff, caseId, state === "withheld" ? { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] } : { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] }), `the decision that makes the post ${state}`);
}

/**
 * Gives an account `n` strikes the way strikes come about (3e design, section 12): for each, a post the account makes
 * now, an admin's own finding on it under the rule, and a final removal through the decide route's own code, which signs
 * the strike the database computes. Each decision commits, and so is told to the account, before its next post is made,
 * so each post is newer than the newest strike and each removal gives one. Answers the decisions, oldest first; fails when
 * one gave no strike. closeDecisions removes what it committed, as for decideForTest; the account's posts stay.
 */
export async function strikeForTest(apiDb: Db, accountId: string, n: number, rule: RuleId = "R1"): Promise<string[]> {
  world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
  admin ??= world.staff("admin");
  const [w, staff] = [world, await admin];
  const decisions: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    // Made in a statement of its own after the previous decision committed: later than the time that decision was told.
    const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: `a post that breaks ${rule}` });
    decidedPosts.add(postId);
    const recorded = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, rule), live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1 }] });
    const id = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions: [act("remove")] }), "a removal that gives a strike");
    const [struck] = await apiDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from decision_actions where decision_id = ${id}::uuid and kind = 'strike'`);
    if (struck!.n !== 1) throw new Error("strikeForTest: the removal gave no strike");
    decisions.push(id);
  }
  return decisions;
}

/** What suspendForTest made: the suspension's decision and case, and the decision it rests on. */
export interface SuspendedForTest {
  decisionId: string;
  caseId: string;
  basisDecisionId: string;
}

/**
 * Suspends an account the way a suspension comes about (3e design, section 12), through the decide route's own code
 * (moderation.forStaff.decide, with a real confirmation by an admin's key).
 *
 * At once (the default): on the basis `threat`, which it makes first: a post the account makes now, an admin's own
 * finding on it under R5 and a final removal, which gives the strike the database computes. Then an admin's finding under
 * R5 on the account opens its case, and a final decision on it holds `{ kind: "suspend", days, announced: false }`. The
 * suspension starts with that decision, and every write of the account is refused from then on.
 *
 * Announced (Task 4, `announced: true`): the ladder's first step: three strikes (strikeForTest, under R1), an admin's own
 * finding under R1 on the account, and a final decision that holds `{ kind: "suspend", days, announced: true }` (3 days
 * unless said, the first rung). Nothing is restricted: the world's decisions are mailed by no auth module, so the
 * statement's mail stays pending and the suspension has no start until a test records the mail's outcome or ages it.
 * `basisDecisionId` is then the newest strike's decision.
 *
 * closeDecisions removes what it committed, the account's case included; the account's posts and profile stay.
 */
export async function suspendForTest(apiDb: Db, accountId: string, options: { days?: number; announced?: boolean } = {}): Promise<SuspendedForTest> {
  if (options.announced === true) return announceForTest(apiDb, accountId, options.days ?? 3);
  world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
  admin ??= world.staff("admin");
  const [w, staff] = [world, await admin];
  const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: "a post with a direct threat" });
  decidedPosts.add(postId);
  decidedAccounts.add(accountId);
  const finding = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, "R5"), live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1 }] });
  const basisDecisionId = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, finding.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] }), "the R5 removal a suspension at once rests on");
  const [profile] = await apiDb.execute<{ handle: string }>(sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${accountId}::uuid`);
  const onAccount = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, "R5"), live: [{ type: "account", id: accountId, position: 1, namedHandle: profile!.handle }] });
  const caseId = onAccount.items[0]!.caseId!;
  const decisionId = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [timed("suspend", options.days ?? 7, false)] }), "the suspension at once");
  return { decisionId, caseId, basisDecisionId };
}

/** The account case an admin's own finding under the rule opens on the account (or joins, when one is open). */
async function accountCaseForTest(w: DeciderWorld, staff: RealStaff, apiDb: Db, accountId: string, rule: RuleId): Promise<string> {
  const [profile] = await apiDb.execute<{ handle: string }>(sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${accountId}::uuid`);
  const onAccount = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, rule), live: [{ type: "account", id: accountId, position: 1, namedHandle: profile!.handle }] });
  return onAccount.items[0]!.caseId!;
}

/** An announced suspension of the ladder's first step: three strikes under R1, then the measure on the account's case. */
async function announceForTest(apiDb: Db, accountId: string, days: number): Promise<SuspendedForTest> {
  world ??= deciderWorld(apiDb);
  admin ??= world.staff("admin");
  const [w, staff] = [world, await admin];
  const strikes = await strikeForTest(apiDb, accountId, 3, "R1");
  decidedAccounts.add(accountId);
  const caseId = await accountCaseForTest(w, staff, apiDb, accountId, "R1");
  const decisionId = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("suspend", days, true)] }), "the announced suspension");
  return { decisionId, caseId, basisDecisionId: strikes.at(-1)! };
}

/** What terminateForTest made: the termination's decision and case, the suspension for the first threat, and the two R5 decisions it rests on. */
export interface TerminatedForTest {
  decisionId: string;
  caseId: string;
  suspensionId: string;
  /** The R5 decision the earlier suspension rests on, and the newer one about a post made after that suspension. */
  earlierDecisionId: string;
  basisDecisionId: string;
}

/**
 * Terminates an account at once, the only path to a termination at once (3e design, section 12): an R5 decision about a
 * post of the account and a suspension at once on it (suspendForTest), that suspension aged past its end
 * (ageStandingForTest, as the migrator), a post the account makes after it and a second R5 decision on that post, then
 * an admin's own finding under R5 on the account and a final decision that holds `{ kind: "terminate", days: null,
 * announced: false }`, on the basis `threat_repeat`. The account is suspended without end from that decision; it is not
 * taken down before the decision is final for it. closeDecisions removes what it committed; the posts and profile stay.
 */
export async function terminateForTest(apiDb: Db, accountId: string): Promise<TerminatedForTest> {
  const first = await suspendForTest(apiDb, accountId, { days: 7 });
  const [w, staff] = [world!, await admin!];
  // The first suspension ends: its period, and every time of the account's ledger, moved back past its 7 days.
  await ageStandingForTest(w.migrateDb, accountId, "8 days");
  // A second threat, in a post made after the account was told of that suspension.
  const postId = await newPostRow(apiDb, accountId, { createdAt: sql`clock_timestamp()`, body: "a second post with a direct threat" });
  decidedPosts.add(postId);
  const finding = await recordIntake(w.moderation.deps, { ground: ground.finding(staff.id, "R5"), live: [{ type: "post", id: postId, position: 1 }] });
  const basisDecisionId = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, finding.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] }), "the second R5 removal");
  const caseId = await accountCaseForTest(w, staff, apiDb, accountId, "R5");
  const decisionId = decided(await w.decideAs(staff, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [timed("terminate", null, false)] }), "the termination at once");
  return { decisionId, caseId, suspensionId: first.decisionId, earlierDecisionId: first.basisDecisionId, basisDecisionId };
}

/**
 * Removes what decideForTest committed in this test file, if it was used, and closes the pools it opened: the cases of
 * the posts it decided with their items, decisions, measures, texts, snapshots and intakes, and the staff account's
 * profile; the posts' levels are derived again. Two kinds of row stay, and no suite counts either. The audit rows (the
 * staff account's enrolment and sign-in, and one case_decided row for each decision): the audit log is an append-only
 * chain, and audit-verify refuses a record with a row gone. And the staff account's rows in the auth schema (the account,
 * its key, its session and its events), which the auth suites leave for their own accounts too. Calling it again does
 * nothing.
 */
export async function closeDecisions(): Promise<void> {
  const [used, member, posts, accounts] = [world, admin, [...decidedPosts], [...decidedAccounts]];
  world = null;
  admin = null;
  decidedPosts.clear();
  decidedAccounts.clear();
  if (!used) return;
  try {
    const staff = member ? await member.catch(() => null) : null;
    await removeDecided(used.migrateDb, posts, staff ? [staff.id] : [], accounts);
  } finally {
    await used.close({ keepStaff: true });
  }
}

/**
 * Holds a test file that uses decideForTest to leaving no moderation row behind. Called last inside the file's describe,
 * with a getter of its pool: it reads the moderation tables' row counts before the file's first test, and adds the file's
 * last test, which removes what decideForTest committed and expects the counts unchanged. The file's own posts and
 * profiles stay, as they always did.
 */
export function leavesNoModerationRows(db: () => Db): void {
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    before = await moderationCounts(db());
  });
  test("this file left no moderation row behind: what put its posts into their states is removed, and the moderation tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    expect(await moderationCounts(db())).toEqual(before);
  }, 30_000);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Rows for the database tests of the moderation tables (3c design, sections 6.1 and 6.2), written as SQL the way the
 * intake transaction writes them: an insert names only what the API supplies, and the triggers of migrations 0015 and
 * 0016 force the rest. The helpers take a pool or a transaction, so a test chooses the role and whether anything commits.
 * The suites share one database, so a test leaves nothing behind: it runs inside a transaction that is rolled back, or,
 * where a second session must see its rows, it commits them and removes them again with removeFixtures.
 */
export type Runner = Db | DbTx;
export type TargetType = "post" | "account";

export const TC = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";
export const MINORS = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS";
export const SPEECH = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH";

/** 32 random bytes as lower-case hex: a salt, a digest's stand-in or a token's hash. */
export const hex64 = () => randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

/** A public reference as the API makes it: N- and ten base32 characters. */
export function newRef(): string {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
  return `N-${Array.from(randomBytes(10), (byte) => alphabet[byte % 32]).join("")}`;
}

/** Null as SQL, any other value as a parameter. */
const orNull = (value: string | null | undefined, cast: string): SQL => (value === null || value === undefined ? sql`null` : sql`${value}::${sql.raw(cast)}`);

/** Ids as one uuid[] parameter. */
export const uuids = (ids: readonly string[]): SQL => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;

/**
 * A post row straight in the table: these tests need the row, not the flow and its counters. It is dated a month back.
 * The suites share one database, and others read the public Latest timeline from its newest post down and Explore's
 * 48-hour window: a visible post dated now would stand among theirs, and dozens of them push theirs off the first page.
 */
export async function newPostRow(db: Runner, authorId: string, options: { quoteOfId?: string; replyToId?: string; body?: string; createdAt?: SQL } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, quote_of_id, reply_to_id, created_at)
        values (${authorId}::uuid, ${options.body ?? "a post"}, ${orNull(options.quoteOfId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(options.replyToId, "uuid")}, ${options.createdAt ?? sql`now() - interval '30 days'`})
        returning id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/**

 * database takes one, and then attached with one update of post_id, position and alt text, as the media repository's
 * attach does.
 */
export async function newImageRow(db: Runner, ownerId: string, postId: string | null, position = 0): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(

  );
  if (postId) await db.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${postId}::uuid, position = ${position}, alt_text = ${`image ${position + 1}`} where id = ${row!.id}::uuid`);
  return row!.id;
}

    values (${input.kind ?? "user"}::intake_kind, ${input.ref ?? newRef()}, ${orNull(input.lookupHash, "text")}, ${input.channel ?? "signed_in"}::intake_channel,
            ${orNull(input.reporterId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.findingBy, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.contactId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.ruleId, "text")},

            ${orNull(input.namedHandle, "text")}, ${orNull(input.outcome, "item_outcome")}, ${orNull(input.reexaminesItemId, "uuid")}${sql.join(values, sql``)})
```
