import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { SoftAuthenticator, type SoftFlags } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { flowHarness, onboardedUser, type FlowHarness } from "./flow-harness";
import { DEVICE_BOUND, TEST_CONSOLE, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount } from "./staff-fixtures";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { signInKey, staffAssertion } from "./staff-sign-in";

const APP_ORIGIN = "http://localhost:8081";
const NO_UV: SoftFlags = { up: true, uv: false, be: false, bs: false };
const SYNCABLE: SoftFlags = { up: true, uv: true, be: true, bs: false };
const SYNCED: SoftFlags = { up: true, uv: true, be: true, bs: true };
/** BS without BE: no authenticator may report it (WebAuthn L3, section 6.1.3), and the library refuses it with the signature. */
const BACKED_UP_ONLY: SoftFlags = { up: true, uv: true, be: false, bs: true };
/** A time as the staff mails print it, as 1c's mails do: the date and the minute in UTC. */
const mailTime = (at: Date) => `${at.toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ${at.toISOString().slice(11, 16)} UTC`;

/** The AuthError a flow rejects with; anything else fails the test. */
async function failure(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<AuthError> {
  try {
    await promise;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof AuthError) return err;
    throw err;
  }
  throw new Error("expected the flow to reject");
}

/** A response's signature with its last byte changed: the library's check fails, and nothing else about it does. */
function badSignature(response: AuthenticationResponseJSON): AuthenticationResponseJSON {
  const signature = Buffer.from(response.response.signature, "base64url");
  signature[signature.length - 1] = signature[signature.length - 1]! ^ 0xff;
  return { ...response, response: { ...response.response, signature: signature.toString("base64url") } };
}

/**
 * The staff sign-in through the auth module's flows on the real database (3a design, section 7, Sign-in and A counter that
 * goes backwards): the console at http://console.localhost:8090 with the relying party console.localhost beside the app at
 * http://localhost:8081, the software authenticator, and keys enrolled through the enrolment flow.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: staff sign-in", () => {
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;

  beforeAll(() => {
    authDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    // The migrate role reads every row back; the test environment carries its URL.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 4 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const harness = () => flowHarness(repo, { console: TEST_CONSOLE });
  const head = async () => (await migrateDb.select().from(auditHead))[0]!;
  const keyRow = async (id: string) => (await migrateDb.select().from(staffKeys).where(eq(staffKeys.id, id)))[0]!;
  const sessionsOf = (userId: string) => migrateDb.select().from(staffSessions).where(eq(staffSessions.userId, userId)).orderBy(asc(staffSessions.createdAt));
  const staffEvents = (userId: string) =>
    migrateDb
      .select({ type: authEvents.type, metadata: authEvents.metadata, ipHash: authEvents.ipHash })
      .from(authEvents)
      .where(and(eq(authEvents.userId, userId), sql`${authEvents.type}::text in ('staff_sign_in', 'staff_key_counter_regression', 'staff_key_revoked')`))
      .orderBy(asc(authEvents.id));
  const rowsAfter = (seq: number) => migrateDb.select().from(auditLog).where(gt(auditLog.chainSeq, seq)).orderBy(asc(auditLog.chainSeq));

  /** A live staff account with a handle (in the harness's profiles) holding one key enrolled through the flow. */
  async function staffWithKey(h: FlowHarness, name = "Blue key") {
    const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo);
    const handle = `s_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    await h.deps.profiles.create({ id: user.id, handle, displayName: "Staff" });
    const auth = new SoftAuthenticator();
    const enrolled = await enrolKey(h, auth, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id)).token, { name });
    return { user, handle, auth, keyId: enrolled.key.id, credentialId: enrolled.credentialId };
  }

  describe("a sign-in with a live staff key", () => {
    test("the options ask for a discoverable, user-verified credential of the console's relying party with a staff sign-in challenge", async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { options } = await signInOptions(h.deps);
      expect(options.rpId).toBe(TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID);
      expect(options.allowCredentials ?? []).toEqual([]);
      expect(options.userVerification).toBe("required");
      expect(options.timeout).toBe(5 * MINUTE);
      const key = challengeKey(h.deps.config.authHmacKey);
      expect(() => readChallenge(key, options.challenge, "staff_signin", h.clock.now())).not.toThrow();
      // Only a staff sign-in: the app's sign-in, and every other purpose, refuse it.
      expect(() => readChallenge(key, options.challenge, "signin", h.clock.now())).toThrow();
      expect(() => readChallenge(key, options.challenge, "staff_register", h.clock.now())).toThrow();
    });

    test("opens a session with its browser label, records the key's use, writes staff_sign_in and its audit row last in the session's transaction, and mails the owner after the commit", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { user, handle, auth, keyId, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      h.mailer.sent.length = 0;
      const before = await head();
      const now = h.clock.now();
      const { token, me, requestId } = await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 7 });

      // The answer is /me's: the handle, the role, the session's handle and both ends with the seconds left.
      const [session] = await sessionsOf(user.id);
      expect(StaffMe.parse(me)).toEqual({
        handle,
        role: "moderator",
        sessionHandle: session!.handle,
        idleExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + STAFF_IDLE_MS).toISOString(),
        idleSecondsLeft: 15 * 60,
        absoluteExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + STAFF_ABSOLUTE_MS).toISOString(),
        absoluteSecondsLeft: 12 * 60 * 60,
        // 3f Task 2: the server's home state and contact point, unset in this harness's configuration.
        homeState: null,
        contactPoint: null,
      });
      // The token is the cookie's value; only its sha256 is stored. The label is deviceLabel's, never the user agent.
      expect(token).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
      expect(session).toMatchObject({
        id: sha256Hex(token),
        userId: user.id,
        keyId,
        createdAt: now,
        lastUsedAt: now,
        idleExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 15 * MINUTE),
        absoluteExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 12 * HOUR),
        revokedAt: null,
        browser: "Chrome on Windows",
      });
      expect(await keyRow(keyId)).toMatchObject({ counter: 7, lastUsedAt: now, revokedAt: null, suspectAt: null });

      // The event names the key and the session; the audit row the account, the session and the key, with the request's id.
      expect(await staffEvents(user.id)).toEqual([{ type: "staff_sign_in", metadata: { keyId, handle: session!.handle }, ipHash: h.ctx.ipHash }]);
      const written = await rowsAfter(before.seq);
      expect(written).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(written[0]).toMatchObject({
        actorId: user.id,
        action: "staff_sign_in",
        targetType: "staff_session",
        targetId: session!.handle,
        staffSession: session!.handle,
        keyId,
        actionHash: null,
        stepUp: null,
        requestId,
        metadata: {},
      });
      // One transaction: the key's use, the session, the event and the audit row carry one transaction id, the audit row
      // written by its last statement.
      const [rows] = await migrateDb.execute<{ key: string; session: string; event: string; audit: string; keyCmin: string; sessionCmin: string; eventCmin: string; auditCmin: string }>(sql`select
        (select xmin::text from auth.staff_keys where id = ${keyId}) as key,
        (select xmin::text from auth.staff_sessions where user_id = ${user.id}) as session,
        (select xmin::text from auth.auth_events where user_id = ${user.id} and type = 'staff_sign_in') as event,
        (select xmin::text from public.audit_log where id = ${written[0]!.id}) as audit,
        (select cmin::text from auth.staff_keys where id = ${keyId}) as "keyCmin",
        (select cmin::text from auth.staff_sessions where user_id = ${user.id}) as "sessionCmin",
        (select cmin::text from auth.auth_events where user_id = ${user.id} and type = 'staff_sign_in') as "eventCmin",
        (select cmin::text from public.audit_log where id = ${written[0]!.id}) as "auditCmin"`);
      expect(new Set([rows!.key, rows!.session, rows!.event, rows!.audit]).size).toBe(1);
      expect(Number(rows!.auditCmin)).toBeGreaterThan(Math.max(Number(rows!.keyCmin), Number(rows!.sessionCmin), Number(rows!.eventCmin)));

      // The owner learns of every staff session: the key's name, the browser label and the time; no link.
      expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([{ to: user.email, template: "staff_session_started", data: { name: "Blue key", browser: "Chrome on Windows", time: mailTime(now) } }]);
    });

    test("each sign-in is a session of its own, with the label of the browser it came from", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { user, auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 1 });
      h.ctx.userAgent = "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:140.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/140.0";
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 2 });
      h.ctx.userAgent = undefined;
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 3 });
      expect((await sessionsOf(user.id)).map((s) => s.browser)).toEqual(["Chrome on Windows", "Firefox on Linux", "Browser on unknown OS"]);
    });

    test("an authenticator that always reports a zero counter signs in again and again", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { user, auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 0 });
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 0 });
      expect(await sessionsOf(user.id)).toHaveLength(2);
    });
  });

  describe("one answer before the signature", () => {
    test("an unknown key, a revoked key, a demoted or deleted account, and a missing or wrong user handle are all staff_key_invalid, with one message, and write nothing", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const answers: [string, AuthError][] = [];
      const attempt = async (label: string, run: Promise<unknown>) => answers.push([label, await failure(run)]);

      // A credential the authenticator holds but korbat never stored.
      const stranger = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const unknown = stranger.create({ rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge: randomBytes(58).toString("base64url"), origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, userHandle: randomBytes(32), flags: DEVICE_BOUND });
      await attempt("an unknown key", signInKey(h, stranger, unknown.id));

      const revoked = await staffWithKey(h);
      await authDb.update(staffKeys).set({ revokedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(staffKeys.id, revoked.keyId));
      await attempt("a revoked key", signInKey(h, revoked.auth, revoked.credentialId));

      const demoted = await staffWithKey(h);
      await authDb.update(users).set({ role: "user" }).where(eq(users.id, demoted.user.id));
      await attempt("a demoted account", signInKey(h, demoted.auth, demoted.credentialId));

      const deleted = await staffWithKey(h);
      await authDb.update(users).set({ deletedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(users.id, deleted.user.id));
      await attempt("a deleted account", signInKey(h, deleted.auth, deleted.credentialId));

      const live = await staffWithKey(h);
      await attempt("no user handle", signInKey(h, live.auth, live.credentialId, { userHandle: null }));
      await attempt("a random user handle", signInKey(h, live.auth, live.credentialId, { userHandle: randomBytes(32) }));
      const other = await staffWithKey(h);
      const otherHandle = (await repo.findUserById(other.user.id))!.webauthnUserId!;
      await attempt("another account's user handle", signInKey(h, live.auth, live.credentialId, { userHandle: otherHandle }));

      for (const [label, err] of answers) {
        expect([label, err.code, err.status, err.message]).toEqual([label, "staff_key_invalid", 401, answers[0]![1].message]);
      }
      for (const account of [revoked, demoted, deleted, live]) {
        expect(await sessionsOf(account.user.id)).toEqual([]);
        expect((await keyRow(account.keyId)).counter).toBe(0);
        expect((await keyRow(account.keyId)).lastUsedAt).toBeNull();
      }
      // The live key still opens the console with its own handle.
      expect((await signInKey(h, live.auth, live.credentialId)).me.handle).toBe(live.handle);
    });

    test("whatever the codec or the library refuses is staff_key_invalid, never a passkey code; an expired challenge is challenge_expired", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { user, keyId, auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      const key = challengeKey(h.deps.config.authHmacKey);
      const verify = (response: AuthenticationResponseJSON) => failure(signInVerify(h.deps, { response }, { ...h.ctx, requestId: `req-${randomUUID()}` }));
      const assert = (options: Parameters<typeof staffAssertion>[3] = {}) => staffAssertion(h, auth, credentialId, options);

      const used = await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 1 });
      const cases: [string, AuthenticationResponseJSON][] = [
        ["a spent challenge", auth.get({ credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge: JSON.parse(Buffer.from(used.response.response.clientDataJSON, "base64url").toString()).challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: 2 })],
        ["the app's sign-in challenge", await assert({ challenge: issueChallenge(key, "signin", h.clock.now()), counter: 3 })],
        ["a staff registration challenge", await assert({ challenge: issueChallenge(key, "staff_register", h.clock.now(), randomUUID()), counter: 4 })],
        ["a staff sign-in challenge bound to something", await assert({ challenge: issueChallenge(key, "staff_signin", h.clock.now(), randomUUID()), counter: 5 })],
        ["a forged challenge", await assert({ challenge: randomBytes(58).toString("base64url"), counter: 6 })],
        ["not a challenge at all", await assert({ challenge: "x", counter: 7 })],
        ["the app's relying party", await assert({ rpId: "localhost", counter: 8 })],
        ["the app's origin", await assert({ origin: APP_ORIGIN, counter: 9 })],
        ["a bad signature", badSignature(await assert({ counter: 10 }))],
        ["a bad signature that also reports no UV", badSignature(await assert({ counter: 11, flags: NO_UV }))],
      ];
      for (const [label, response] of cases) {
        const err = await verify(response);
        expect([label, err.code, err.status]).toEqual([label, "staff_key_invalid", 401]);
        expect(err.code, label).not.toMatch(/^passkey_/);
      }
      // None of them touched the key or opened a session; the key's counter is the one good sign-in's.
      expect((await keyRow(keyId)).counter).toBe(1);
      expect(await sessionsOf(user.id)).toHaveLength(1);

      // An expired challenge is the shared code the console answers by starting over.
      const late = await assert({ counter: 12 });
      h.clock.advance(10 * MINUTE);
      expect((await verify(late)).code).toBe("challenge_expired");
      expect((await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 13 })).me.role).toBe("moderator");
    });
  });

  describe("user verification and device binding, after the signature", () => {
    test("an assertion without UV is staff_key_not_user_verified, one reporting BE, backed up or not, staff_key_not_device_bound; none moves the counter or opens a session", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { user, keyId, auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      const before = await head();
      const cases: [SoftFlags, string, number][] = [
        [NO_UV, "staff_key_not_user_verified", 403],
        [SYNCABLE, "staff_key_not_device_bound", 403],
        [SYNCED, "staff_key_not_device_bound", 403],
        [BACKED_UP_ONLY, "staff_key_invalid", 401],
      ];
      for (const [flags, code, status] of cases) {
        const err = await failure(signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { flags, counter: 5 }));
        expect([JSON.stringify(flags), err.code, err.status]).toEqual([JSON.stringify(flags), code, status]);
      }
      expect(await keyRow(keyId)).toMatchObject({ counter: 0, lastUsedAt: null, revokedAt: null });
      expect(await sessionsOf(user.id)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await head()).toEqual(before);
      // The counter the refused assertions reported is still ahead of the stored one.
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 5 });
    });
  });

  describe("a counter that goes backwards", () => {
    test("revokes the key and marks it suspect, revokes every live staff session it opened, records it last in one transaction, mails staff_key_suspect and answers staff_key_suspended", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { user, keyId, auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      const red = await enrolKey(h, auth, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id)).token, { name: "Red key" });
      const first = await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 5 });
      const second = await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 6 });
      const onRed = await signInKey(h, auth, red.credentialId, { counter: 1 });
      // A session the key opened that has already ended stays as it was.
      const ended = new Date(h.clock.ms() - MINUTE);
      await authDb.update(staffSessions).set({ revokedAt: ended }).where(eq(staffSessions.id, sha256Hex(first.token)));
      const third = await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 7 });
      h.mailer.sent.length = 0;
      const before = await head();
      const now = h.clock.now();

      const err = await failure(signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 7 }));
      expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["staff_key_suspended", 403]);

      expect(await keyRow(keyId)).toMatchObject({ revokedAt: now, suspectAt: now, counter: 7 });
      expect(await keyRow(red.key.id)).toMatchObject({ revokedAt: null, suspectAt: null });
      const byId = new Map((await sessionsOf(user.id)).map((s) => [s.id, s.revokedAt]));
      expect(byId.get(sha256Hex(first.token))).toEqual(ended);
      expect(byId.get(sha256Hex(second.token))).toEqual(now);
      expect(byId.get(sha256Hex(third.token))).toEqual(now);
      expect(byId.get(sha256Hex(onRed.token))).toBeNull();
      expect(byId.size).toBe(4);

      const regression = (await staffEvents(user.id)).filter((e) => e.type === "staff_key_counter_regression");
      expect(regression.map((e) => e.metadata)).toEqual([{ keyId, sessionsRevoked: 2, via: "sign_in" }]);
      const written = await rowsAfter(before.seq);
      expect(written.map((r) => [r.action, r.actorId, r.targetType, r.targetId, r.keyId, r.metadata])).toEqual([
        ["staff_key_counter_regression", user.id, "staff_key", keyId, null, { keyId, sessionsRevoked: 2, via: "sign_in" }],
      ]);
      // One transaction: the key, the revoked sessions, the event and the audit row, which its last statement wrote.
      const [rows] = await migrateDb.execute<{ key: string; sessions: string; event: string; audit: string; eventCmin: string; auditCmin: string }>(sql`select
        (select xmin::text from auth.staff_keys where id = ${keyId}) as key,
        (select string_agg(distinct xmin::text, ',') from auth.staff_sessions where id in (${sha256Hex(second.token)}, ${sha256Hex(third.token)})) as sessions,
        (select xmin::text from auth.auth_events where user_id = ${user.id} and type = 'staff_key_counter_regression') as event,
        (select xmin::text from public.audit_log where id = ${written[0]!.id}) as audit,
        (select cmin::text from auth.auth_events where user_id = ${user.id} and type = 'staff_key_counter_regression') as "eventCmin",
        (select cmin::text from public.audit_log where id = ${written[0]!.id}) as "auditCmin"`);
      expect(new Set([rows!.key, rows!.sessions, rows!.event, rows!.audit]).size).toBe(1);
      expect(Number(rows!.auditCmin)).toBeGreaterThan(Number(rows!.eventCmin));

      // Never passkey_suspect, whose remedy names the app's Security screen.
      expect(h.mailer.sent).toEqual([{ to: user.email, template: "staff_key_suspect", data: { name: "Blue key" } }]);
      // The key opens nothing more, whatever counter it reports; the account's other key still does.
      expect((await failure(signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 100 }))).code).toBe("staff_key_invalid");
      expect((await signInKey(h, auth, red.credentialId, { counter: 2 })).me.role).toBe("moderator");
    });

    test("a counter that stays at a non-zero value is a regression too", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { keyId, auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 3 });
      expect((await failure(signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 2 }))).code).toBe("staff_key_suspended");
      expect((await keyRow(keyId)).suspectAt).not.toBeNull();
    });
  });

  describe("limits", () => {
    test("per IP, 20 attempts an hour, counted before anything else: the 21st is rate_limited and spends no challenge", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      const stranger = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const junk = stranger.create({ rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge: randomBytes(58).toString("base64url"), origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, userHandle: randomBytes(32), flags: DEVICE_BOUND });
      for (let i = 0; i < STAFF_SIGNIN_PER_IP_PER_HOUR; i++) expect((await failure(signInKey(h, stranger, junk.id))).code).toBe("staff_key_invalid");
      const response = await staffAssertion(h, auth, credentialId);
      const limited = await failure(signInVerify(h.deps, { response }, { ...h.ctx, requestId: "req-limited" }));
      expect([limited.code, limited.status, limited.retryAfterSeconds]).toEqual(["rate_limited", 429, 3600]);
      // The same answer from another address: its challenge was never spent.
      const signed = await signInVerify(h.deps, { response }, { ...h.ctx, ipHash: randomToken(), requestId: "req-other-ip" });
      expect(signed.me.role).toBe("moderator");
      // An hour later the address may try again.
      h.clock.advance(HOUR);
      expect((await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 2 })).me.role).toBe("moderator");
    });

    test("per key, 10 an hour, counted only after the signature and the flags: ten unsigned answers and refused flags leave the owner able to sign in", { timeout: 90_000 }, async () => {
      const h = harness();
      const { auth, credentialId } = await staffWithKey(h);
      const elsewhere = () => randomToken();
      // Someone who knows the key's credential id but not its private key, from as many addresses as they like.
      for (let i = 0; i < STAFF_SIGNIN_PER_KEY_PER_HOUR + 2; i++) {
        const forged = badSignature(await staffAssertion(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 50 }));
        expect((await failure(signInVerify(h.deps, { response: forged }, { ...h.ctx, ipHash: elsewhere(), requestId: `req-forged-${i}` }))).code).toBe("staff_key_invalid");
      }
      // Assertions the key really signed but that the flags refuse are not counted either.
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) expect((await failure(signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { flags: NO_UV, ipHash: elsewhere() }))).code).toBe("staff_key_not_user_verified");
      // The owner signs in ten times within the hour; the eleventh is refused.
      for (let i = 1; i <= STAFF_SIGNIN_PER_KEY_PER_HOUR; i++) await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: i, ipHash: elsewhere() });
      const limited = await failure(signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 11, ipHash: elsewhere() }));
      expect([limited.code, limited.status]).toEqual(["rate_limited", 429]);
      h.clock.advance(HOUR);
      await signInKey(h, auth, credentialId, { counter: 12, ipHash: elsewhere() });
    });
  });

  describe("relying parties", () => {
    test("a personal passkey's assertion made for the console's relying party is refused at the app's sign-in on the relying-party check, leaving the passkey as it was", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
      // The relying parties apart, as in production: the app's localhost, the console's console.localhost.
      const h = harness();
      const account = await onboardedUser(h, repo);
      const phone = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const registration = (await registerOptions(h.deps, account.session, { label: "ada" })).options;
      // Device-bound and user-verifying, so nothing but where the assertion was made for can refuse it.
      const personal = phone.create({ rpId: "localhost", challenge: registration.challenge, origin: APP_ORIGIN, userHandle: Buffer.from(registration.user.id, "base64url"), flags: DEVICE_BOUND });
      await registerVerify(h.deps, account.session, { response: personal });
      const stored = async () => (await migrateDb.select().from(passkeys).where(eq(passkeys.credentialId, personal.id)))[0]!;
      const before = await stored();
      expect(before).toMatchObject({ counter: 0, lastUsedAt: null, suspectAt: null });
      /** The app's passkey sign-in with an assertion the phone signs for this relying party ID from this origin. */
      const passkeySignIn = async (rpId: string, origin: string, counter: number) => {
        const { options } = await passkeySignInOptions(h.deps, h.ctx);
        const response = phone.get({ credentialId: personal.id, rpId, challenge: options.challenge, origin, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter });
        return passkeySignInVerify(h.deps, { deviceId: account.device.deviceId, platform: "web", response }, h.ctx);
      };

      // As a browser on the console's page makes it, carrying the console's origin too, which the library checks first; then
      // from the app's own origin, which passes, so that only the relying party ID in the authenticator data can refuse it.
      for (const [label, origin] of [
        ["from the console's origin", TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN],
        ["from the app's origin", APP_ORIGIN],
      ] as const) {
        const err = await failure(passkeySignIn(TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, origin, 5));
        expect([label, err.code, err.status]).toEqual([label, "passkey_invalid", 401]);
      }
      // Refused before the passkey's use is recorded: its counter, last use and suspect mark are untouched.
      expect(await stored()).toEqual(before);
      // The same passkey, origin and counter with the app's relying party ID sign in, so the ID alone refused the one above.
      expect((await passkeySignIn("localhost", APP_ORIGIN, 5)).kind).toBe("session");
      expect((await stored()).counter).toBe(5);
    });

    test("a key enrolled for the console at another address with the same relying party ID opens nothing at this one: staff_key_invalid before the signature, writing nothing", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      // The console moved from port 8091 to 8090 and kept its relying party ID, so the browser still offers the key; its
      // assertion names the new origin, which the running configuration accepts. The key records the old one, against
      // which audit-verify would judge every confirmation it made here, and refuse each one for good.
      const MOVED_FROM = "http://console.localhost:8091";
      const before = flowHarness(repo, { console: { origin: MOVED_FROM, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID } });
      const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo);
      await before.deps.profiles.create({ id: user.id, handle: `s_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`, displayName: "Staff" });
      const auth = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const enrolled = await enrolKey(before, auth, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id, { origin: MOVED_FROM })).token);
      expect(await keyRow(enrolled.key.id)).toMatchObject({ origin: MOVED_FROM, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID });

      const moved = harness();
      const err = await failure(signInKey(moved, auth, enrolled.credentialId, { counter: 1 }));
      expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["staff_key_invalid", 401]);
      // The same one answer as an unknown key, before the signature: nothing opened, nothing recorded.
      expect(await sessionsOf(user.id)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await keyRow(enrolled.key.id)).toMatchObject({ counter: 0, lastUsedAt: null, revokedAt: null });
      // The key opens the console at the address it was enrolled for.
      expect((await signInKey(before, auth, enrolled.credentialId, { counter: 2 })).me.role).toBe("moderator");
    });

    test("with both relying party IDs localhost (development), a personal passkey offered at the console's sign-in is refused by the tables alone", { timeout: 60_000 }, async () => {
      // The development configuration: the console at http://localhost:8090, its relying party ID the app's.
      const h = flowHarness(repo, { console: { origin: "http://localhost:8090", rpId: "localhost" } });
      const account = await onboardedUser(h, repo);
      await h.deps.profiles.create({ id: account.user.id, handle: `s_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`, displayName: "Staff" });
      const phone = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const personalOptions = (await registerOptions(h.deps, account.session, { label: "ada" })).options;
      // A device-bound, user-verifying personal passkey: its flags would pass, so only the lookup can refuse it.
      const personal = phone.create({ rpId: "localhost", challenge: personalOptions.challenge, origin: APP_ORIGIN, userHandle: Buffer.from(personalOptions.user.id, "base64url"), flags: DEVICE_BOUND });
      await registerVerify(h.deps, account.session, { response: personal });
      await authDb.update(users).set({ role: "moderator" }).where(eq(users.id, account.user.id));
      const securityKey = new SoftAuthenticator();
      const staff = await enrolKey(h, securityKey, (await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, account.user.id, { origin: "http://localhost:8090", rpId: "localhost" })).token);

      // The browser offers the personal passkey on the console's page: the right relying party, origin and user handle.
      const offered = await staffAssertion(h, phone, personal.id, { counter: 1 });
      const err = await failure(signInVerify(h.deps, { response: offered }, { ...h.ctx, requestId: "req-personal" }));
      expect([err.code, err.status]).toEqual(["staff_key_invalid", 401]);
      expect(await sessionsOf(account.user.id)).toEqual([]);
      const [stored] = await migrateDb.select().from(passkeys).where(eq(passkeys.credentialId, personal.id));
      expect(stored).toMatchObject({ counter: 0, lastUsedAt: null, suspectAt: null });
      // The account's staff key opens the console there.
      expect((await signInKey(h, securityKey, staff.credentialId)).me.role).toBe("moderator");
    });
  });
});

import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { closeDb, createDb } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { ROUTE_KINDS } from "../../src/moderation/decide";
import { updateLine } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { itemStatus } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { dueRedactions, insertAction, insertDecision, lateErasures, noticeItems, pendingOutcomeLines } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { changeHandle } from "../../src/social/flows/profile-edit";
import { closeDecisions, deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, actionsOf, anAccount, appealOf, decisionParams, ground, intake, refusal, removeFixtures, rowCounts, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rejection, socialHarness, type SocialHarness } from "./social-harness";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Every test commits decisions confirmed with a real key, each a round of the step-up flow: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 240_000 });

/** A handle nobody holds: lower-case, as the flows store a chosen one. */
const newHandle = () => `rh_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
/** The placeholder decision_actions_apply gives: the prefix and the first 12 hex digits of the sha256 of the measure's id as text. */
const placeholderOf = (actionId: string) => `retired_${createHash("sha256").update(actionId, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 12)}`;

/**
 * The retirement of a handle and its reversal through the routes (3e design, sections 6.2, 7.10 and 7.11; section 12.1,
 * invariant 15 and row 24 for a retirement). Each decision is confirmed as the console confirms one, with a staff key on
 * the software authenticator, and recorded by the moderation module's own decide and review, which the staff routes
 * run. The handle change and onboarding are the social module's flow and the profile store, on the API's pool, so a
 * refusal is the one a person meets; a write that skips them is made as korbat_api, which the trigger refuses. What the
 * file commits is removed in the end, and its last test holds it to that.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the retirement of a handle and its reversal", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let s: SocialHarness;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let reviewer: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** The profiles this file made, removed with everything they hold at the end. */
  const made: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    s = socialHarness(apiDb);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    reviewer = await world.staff("moderator");
    // Read once the staff profiles exist: the world removes them when it closes, after the last test.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 240_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await closeDecisions();
      await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await closeDb(apiDb);
    }
  }, 240_000);

  const store = () => createProfileStore(apiDb);
  async function account() {
    const profile = await newProfile(apiDb);
    made.push(profile.id);
    return profile;
  }
  /** The account's case, opened by a signed-in report under R4 that names it by this handle: the case and the report. */
  async function reportedAccount(subjectId: string, named: string) {
    const reporter = await account();
    const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R4"), anAccount(subjectId, named));
    return { caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, intakeId: recorded.intakeId };
  }
  /** A confirmed decision through the route's code: its id. */
  async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  /** A final retirement under R4 by the moderator, with what else the decision holds. */
  const retire = (caseId: string, also: DecisionInput["actions"] = [], more: Partial<DecisionInput> = {}) =>
    decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("retire_handle"), ...(also ?? [])], ...more });
  const profileRow = async (id: string) =>
    (await apiDb.execute<{ handle: string; display_name: string; handle_changed_at: string | null }>(sql`select handle, display_name, handle_changed_at::text from profiles where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
  const historyRow = async (handle: string) =>

  const retirementRow = async (decisionId: string) => (await actionsOf(apiDb, decisionId)).find((a) => a.kind === "retire_handle")!;

  test("the routes take the retirement and its reversal, and since Task 5 every kind of the ledger (7.1 item 2)", () => {
    expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has("retire_handle")).toBe(true);
    expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has("unretire_handle")).toBe(true);

    // 3f Task 3: but disable_by_order, which only the effect of an order writes (POST /api/staff/orders/:order/effect);
    // its reversal, reinstate_by_order, is a route kind.
    expect([...ACTION_KINDS].filter((kind) => !ROUTE_KINDS.has(kind))).toEqual(["disable_by_order"]);
    expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has("reinstate_by_order")).toBe(true);

  test("invariant 15: a retirement swaps the handle for the placeholder made from the measure's id and clears the change time; the handle is refused to everyone, its former holder included, and the new handle is chosen at once", async () => {
    const subject = await account();

    // handle_history yet: the retirement writes it first.

    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: judged })).handle).toBe(judged);
    expect(await historyRow(judged)).toBeNull();
    const { caseId, intakeId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, judged);
    // A signed-in notice of illegal content about the same account joins the case: its sender is mailed the outcome.
    const noticer = await account();

    expect(notice.items[0]!.caseId).toBe(caseId);
    const caseRead = () => world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(admin.session, caseId);

    expect(after.standing).toMatchObject({ snapshotHandleRetired: true });

    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: judged.toUpperCase() }))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: judged, displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: judged.toUpperCase(), displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });

    expect(await s.repo.changeHandle(subject.id, judged, new Date())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });

  test("the retirement is stored first beside a reset of the display name, which then copies the placeholder; a retirement that is not its decision's first row is refused", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    const { caseId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);

  test("the reversal, while the profile holds the placeholder: a review of the appeal gives the handle back, clears the retirement and the change time", async () => {
    const subject = await account();

    const subject = await account();

    const decisionId = await retire(caseId);

    const stranger = await account();
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: subject.handle }))).toBe("handle_taken");
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: subject.handle })).handle).toBe(subject.handle);

  });

  test("no_effect: already when the snapshot's handle is retired, deleted for a deleted account; neither touches the profile", async () => {
    // Two reports in one open case, the second arriving before anything changed: one snapshot. The first retirement answers
    // only the first report, so the case stays open, and the second answers the other with the same snapshot.
    const subject = await account();
    const first = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    const second = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    expect(second.caseId).toBe(first.caseId);
    const retiring = await retire(first.caseId, [], { throughSeq: 1 });
    const placeholder = placeholderOf((await retirementRow(retiring)).id);
    const again = await retire(first.caseId);
    expect((await retirementRow(again)).no_effect).toBe("already");
    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle).toBe(placeholder);
    const already = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, again))!.statement;
    expect(already.measures[0]).toMatchObject({ handle: subject.handle, noEffect: "already", placeholder: null });
    expect(statementParagraphs(already)[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireLead(subject.handle)} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireAlready}`);

    const gone = await account();
    const goneCase = await reportedAccount(gone.id, gone.handle);
    await apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone.id}::uuid`);
    const onDeleted = await retire(goneCase.caseId);
    expect((await retirementRow(onDeleted)).no_effect).toBe("deleted");
    expect((await profileRow(gone.id)).handle).toBe(gone.handle);
    expect(await historyRow(gone.handle)).toBeNull();
    expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(apiDb, onDeleted))!.statement)[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireLead(gone.handle)} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedAccount}`);
  });

  test("row 24: a retirement that cites R4 is final for months and never meets the R4 redaction: no candidate, no erasure, never counted as late", async () => {
    // The built text of the retention job and of the overview: REDACTABLE names exactly 3c's four kinds.
    const source = readFileSync(path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../../src/moderation/repo.ts"), "utf8");
    const redactable = source.slice(source.indexOf("const REDACTABLE = sql`"), source.indexOf("`;", source.indexOf("const REDACTABLE = sql`")));
    expect(redactable).toContain("m.kind in ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name')");
    const subject = await account();
    const decisionId = await retire((await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle)).caseId);
    const periods = { intakeDays: 30, statementMonths: 12, draftHours: 24, accessLogMonths: 12 };
    await rolledBack(world.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const late = (await lateErasures(tx, periods)).redactions;
      // Final for its author long ago, as only the migrator can make it here.
      await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = informed_at - interval '7 months', decided_at = decided_at - interval '7 months' where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
      const [final] = await tx.execute<{ final: boolean }>(sql`select public.decision_final_at(${decisionId}::uuid) < now() - interval '1 day' as final`);
      expect(final!.final).toBe(true);
      expect(await dueRedactions(tx)).not.toContain(decisionId);
      expect((await lateErasures(tx, periods)).redactions).toBe(late);
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${decisionId}::uuid)`)))).toBe("invalid_decision");
    });
    // The handle stays retired: refusing it needs it (6.7).
    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: true });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  }, 120_000);
});

  async function postCase(tx: DbTx, authorId: string, minutes: number | null, rule: RuleId = "R1") {

  const activeStrikes = async (tx: DbTx, accountId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from active_strikes where account_id = ${accountId}::uuid`))[0]!.n;

  async function rawRows(tx: DbTx, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput, rows: { kind: ActionKind; mediaId?: string | null; days?: number | null; announced?: boolean }[]) {

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the constants and the enum

  test("standing_rules() holds the contracts' STANDING_RULES, name by name, and action_kind the contracts' 24 kinds in order", async () => {
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.standing_rules()`);
    const camel = (name: string) => name.replace(/_([a-z])/g, (_m, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
    const read = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row!).map(([name, value]) => [camel(name), Array.isArray(value) ? value : Number(value)]));
    expect(read).toEqual({ ...STANDING_RULES, ladderDays: [...STANDING_RULES.ladderDays] });
    const values = await apiDb.execute<{ value: string }>(sql`select unnest(enum_range(null::action_kind))::text as value`);
    // 3f: the migration orders adds an order's measure and its reversal after them, and since Task 3 they are the last two of ACTION_KINDS.

      await inWorld(async (tx) => {

  test("no measure of 3e reaches a staff account: each of the six is refused staff_target (invariant 13)", async () => {

  describe("the ladder is the database's (invariant 6)", () => {
    test("an announced suspension needs three active strikes, takes the rung's days at most, cites the newest strike's rule, and rests on the strikes, forced", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const strikes = [await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0), await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 1)];
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
        strikes.push(await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 2));

        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[0] + 1, true)]))).toMatch(/^days: at most 3 on the basis strikes/);
        // Taken at once, a step of the ladder fits no row.
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);

        expect([...(row.rests_on as string[])].sort()).toEqual([...strikes].sort());

        const [d] = await tx.execute<{ ok: boolean }>(

        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(1);

        expect((await decisionRow(tx, decision)).needs_admin).toBe(false);
      });
    });

    test("what the database forces is the database's: the API role cannot change a ledger row afterwards", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes);
        const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);

  /** The case of a decision. */
  const caseOfDecision = async (tx: DbTx, decisionId: string) => (await tx.execute<{ case_id: string }>(sql`select case_id from decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`))[0]!.case_id;

  describe("a suspension ends by derivation when its basis breaks, and one stands at a time (invariants 7 and 8)", () => {
    test("overruling one of three strikes clears the columns in that transaction, answers the waiting reply, and leaves no kept answer possible", async () => {

        expect(reply).toEqual({ on_time: true, answered_by: null });

        // One strike overruled with its whole finding: fewer than three stand, so the basis breaks now.

        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });

        expect(basis!.broken).not.toBeNull();
        expect((await tx.execute<{ answered_by: string | null }>(sql`select answered_by from suspension_replies where action_id = ${suspend.id}::uuid`))[0]!.answered_by).toBe(correction);
        // No reply is left to answer: a kept correction of the suspension is refused.
        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, announcing), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: announcing, outcome: "kept", actions: [] }))).toBe("invalid_decision");
      });
    });

    test("a reversed R5 decision ends the threat suspension at once that rests on it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const threat = await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0, "R5");
        const suspension = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 30, false)]);
        expect(await rowOf(tx, suspension, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "threat", rests_on: [threat], days: 30, announced: false });
        const running = await columns(tx, account.id);
        expect(running.from).not.toBeNull();
        expect(running.until).not.toBeNull();
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, threat), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: threat, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
      });
    });

    test("standing_conflict while one stands, one with no start included; accepted after a lift; replaced only for an announced one not started", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes);
        const announcing = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]))).toBe("standing_conflict");
        // A lift signed replaced: the announced suspension had not started, so it is a withdrawal for another measure. Only an
        // admin withdraws (3e design, sections 7.6 step 12 and 8.7; the review's access5): a moderator's is admin_required.
        expect(
          await refusal(decideIn(tx, mod, await caseOfDecision(tx, announcing), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: announcing, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true })),
        ).toBe("admin_required");
        const withdrawal = await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, announcing), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: announcing, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true });
        expect(await rowOf(tx, withdrawal, "lift_suspension")).toMatchObject({ replaced: true });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
        // A measure at once that runs: its lift cannot be a withdrawal.
        const threat = await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 3, "R5");
        const atOnce = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 7, false)]);
        expect(await rowOf(tx, atOnce, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "threat", rests_on: [threat] });
        const atOnceCase = await caseOfDecision(tx, atOnce);
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, atOnceCase, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: atOnce, actions: [act("lift_suspension")], replaced: true }))).toMatch(/^replaced: /);
        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, atOnceCase, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: atOnce, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] }))).toBeNull();
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 9: measures at once, on the closed list

  test("a reporter is told that nothing changed only when nothing did: a reset that changed nothing beside a suspension at once that did is a measure that changed something", async () => {
    // 3e's review (access4, people4): the status line and the mail line read "It was already not shown ... nothing
    // changed now" from one expression, which looked at 3c's seven kinds only.
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const [account, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
      await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0, "R5");
      const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R5"), anAccount(account.id, account.handle));
      const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
      // The bio is empty already, so its reset changes nothing; the suspension starts at once.
      const decision = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("reset_bio"), timed("suspend", 7, false)] });
      expect((await actionsOf(tx, decision)).map((a) => [a.kind, a.no_effect])).toEqual([
        ["reset_bio", "already"],
        ["suspend", null],
      ]);
      expect((await noticeItems(tx, recorded.intakeId)).map((item) => item.noEffect)).toEqual([false]);
      // The reset alone, in another case of the account: it changed nothing, and the reporter is told so.
      const other = await intake(tx, ground.rule((await profile(tx)).id, "R1"), anAccount(account.id, account.handle));
      await decideIn(tx, admin, other.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("reset_bio")] });
      expect((await noticeItems(tx, other.intakeId)).map((item) => item.noEffect)).toEqual([true]);
    });
  });

  describe("taken at once only on the closed list, only by an admin (invariant 9)", () => {
    test("threat: accepted on a final R5 decision about a post of the account that stands; refused without one, after its reversal, and for a moderator", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
        const threat = await strikeIn(tx, account.id, 0, "R5");
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)], mod))).toBe("admin_required");
        expect(await refusal(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.threatDays, false)]))).toBeNull();
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, threat), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: threat, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
      });
    });

    test("terrorist content: a decision on the law with the keyword about a post of the account; any other measure on the law is refused", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, account.id);
        const notifier = await profile(tx);
        const postCaseId = (await intake(tx, ground.illegal(notifier.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const found = await decideIn(tx, admin, postCaseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // A decision on the law alone gives no strike.
        expect((await actionsOf(tx, found)).map((a) => a.kind)).toEqual(["remove"]);
        const onLaw = async (actions: DecisionInput["actions"], keyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" | null) => {
          const caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.illegal((await profile(tx)).id), anAccount(account.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
          return refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", categoryKeyword: keyword, actions }));
        };
        expect(await onLaw([timed("suspend", 3, true)], "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT")).toMatch(/^basis: on the law only/);
        expect(await onLaw([timed("suspend", 3, false)], null)).toMatch(/^basis: on the law only/);
        expect(await onLaw([timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.terroristDays, false)], "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT")).toBeNull();
      });
    });

    test("flood: 19 posts in the hour are no floor, 20 are; up to floodDays days", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        for (let i = 0; i < STANDING_RULES.floodPosts - 1; i++) await newPostRow(tx, account.id, { createdAt: sql`now()` });
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R6", [timed("suspend", 3, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
        await newPostRow(tx, account.id, { createdAt: sql`now()` });
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R6", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.floodDays + 1, false)]))).toMatch(/^days: at most 7 on the basis flood/);
        const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R6", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.floodDays, false)]);
        expect(await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "flood", rests_on: null });
      });
    });

    test("protective: on a seal for good of the account's images, once for that seal, never in the decision that seals, never a termination", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, account.id);
        await newImageRow(tx, account.id, postId, 0);
        // No seal: refused; a termination under R2 is never established.
        const findingR2 = async () => (await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R2"), anAccount(account.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const caseId = await findingR2();
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^basis: under R2/);
        expect(await refusal(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("terminate", null, false)] }))).toBe("ground_not_established");
        // A seal taken while deciding is not enough; a seal and a suspension in one decision are refused.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^basis: under R2/);
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media"), timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^A decision that seals/);
        // The seal for good closes the case; a new finding opens the account's next case, where the suspension is decided.
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays + 1, false)] }))).toMatch(/^days: at most 14/);
        const protective = await decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays, false)] });
        expect(await rowOf(tx, protective, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "protective", rests_on: [seal] });
        // Lifted by an admin's correction, it leaves the seal it rested on spent: a second needs a newer seal.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, protective), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: protective, actions: [act("lift_suspension")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, false)] }))).toMatch(/^basis: under R2/);
      });
    });

    test("a lifted seal ends the protective suspension that rests on it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const account = await profile(tx);
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, account.id);
        await newImageRow(tx, account.id, postId, 0);
        const findingR2 = async () => (await intake(tx, ground.finding(admin.id, "R2"), anAccount(account.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await findingR2(), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [timed("suspend", 7, false)] });
        expect((await columns(tx, account.id)).from).not.toBeNull();
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, seal), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: seal, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 11: the start

  describe("an announced suspension never starts before its earliest start, and the API role cannot move it (invariant 11)", () => {
    /** An announced suspension of a new account on three strikes, and its ledger row. */
    async function announced(tx: DbTx) {
      const account = await profile(tx);
      for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes);
      const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
      return { account, decision, row: await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend") };
    }
    const period = async (tx: DbTx, actionId: string) =>
      (await tx.execute<{ starts: string; ends: string; from_start: number; from_created: number }>(
        sql`select p.starts_at::text as starts, p.ends_at::text as ends, extract(epoch from p.starts_at - a.starts_at)::float8 as from_start,
                   extract(epoch from p.starts_at - a.created_at)::float8 as from_created
              from suspension_periods p join decision_actions a on a.id = p.action_id where p.action_id = ${actionId}::uuid`,
      ))[0];

    test("no start while the mail is pending; sent: the relay's acceptance plus the window, never before starts_at; the API role cannot move or un-send it", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const s = await announced(tx);
        expect(await period(tx, s.row.id)).toBeUndefined();
        expect(await decisionRow(tx, s.decision)).toMatchObject({ author_mail: "pending" });
        // pending to a state other than the three, and a time chosen by the API, are refused.
        const update = (set: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`update decisions set ${set} where id = ${s.decision}::uuid`)));
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail = 'none'`)).toMatch(/^42501/);
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail_at = now() - interval '1 day'`)).toMatch(/^42501/);
        // Sent, with a time in the past supplied: the database writes its own.
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail = 'sent', author_mail_at = now() - interval '30 days'`)).toBeNull();
        const [mail] = await tx.execute<{ ok: boolean }>(sql`select author_mail_at = now() as ok from decisions where id = ${s.decision}::uuid`);
        expect(mail!.ok).toBe(true);
        const p = await period(tx, s.row.id);
        expect(p!.from_start).toBe(0);
        expect(p!.from_created).toBe(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours * 3600);
        expect((await columns(tx, s.account.id)).from).not.toBeNull();
        // Never again: a second change of the state or of its time.
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail = 'failed'`)).toMatch(/^42501/);
        expect(await update(sql`author_mail_at = now() + interval '1 day'`)).toMatch(/^42501/);
      });
    });

    test("failed: the decision plus the undelivered window; a mail given up later starts at the moment it was given up, never in the past", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const s = await announced(tx);
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'failed' where id = ${s.decision}::uuid`);
        expect((await period(tx, s.row.id))!.from_created).toBe(STANDING_RULES.undeliveredHours * 3600);
      });
      // As the migrator, who alone may write a mail's time: an outcome recorded after the undelivered window is the start.
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const s = await announced(tx);
        const late = STANDING_RULES.undeliveredHours + 24;
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'failed', author_mail_at = now() + make_interval(hours => ${late}::int) where id = ${s.decision}::uuid`);
        expect((await period(tx, s.row.id))!.from_created).toBe(late * 3600);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("an on-time reply holds the start; a kept answer before starts_at starts it at starts_at, one after starts_at at the answer", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const s = await announced(tx);
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'sent' where id = ${s.decision}::uuid`);
        const caseId = await caseOfDecision(tx, s.decision);
        const drafted = await decisionParams(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: s.decision, outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into suspension_replies (action_id, account_id) values (${s.row.id}::uuid, ${s.account.id}::uuid)`);
        expect(await period(tx, s.row.id)).toBeUndefined();
        // A correction drafted before the reply is refused: the reply moved the case's version.
        expect(await refusal(decideWith(tx, admin, caseId, drafted))).toBe("case_changed");
        const kept = await decideIn(tx, admin, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: s.decision, outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
        expect(await decisionRow(tx, kept)).toMatchObject({ outcome: "kept", author_mail: "pending" });
        expect((await tx.execute<{ answered_by: string }>(sql`select answered_by from suspension_replies where action_id = ${s.row.id}::uuid`))[0]!.answered_by).toBe(kept);
        // The answer came before starts_at: the start is starts_at, never sooner for having replied.
        expect((await period(tx, s.row.id))!.from_start).toBe(0);
      });
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const s = await announced(tx);
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into suspension_replies (action_id, account_id) values (${s.row.id}::uuid, ${s.account.id}::uuid)`);
        // The answer's time moved past starts_at, as only the migrator can: the start follows it.
        const answeredAt = sql`(select starts_at + interval '5 hours' from decision_actions where id = ${s.row.id}::uuid)`;
        await tx.execute(sql`update suspension_replies set answered_by = ${s.decision}::uuid, answered_at = ${answeredAt} where action_id = ${s.row.id}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.standing_apply(${s.account.id}::uuid)`);
        expect((await period(tx, s.row.id))!.from_start).toBe(5 * 3600);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a reply is refused to another account's measure and once a reply exists", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const s = await announced(tx);
        const other = await profile(tx);
        const reply = (account: string) => refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into suspension_replies (action_id, account_id) values (${s.row.id}::uuid, ${account}::uuid)`)));
        expect(await reply(other.id)).toBe("reply_not_open");
        expect(await reply(s.account.id)).toBeNull();
        expect(await reply(s.account.id)).toBe("reply_not_open");
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- row 24: the R4 redaction never meets 3e's measures

  test("the R4 redaction's candidates name the four kinds of 3c: a suspension that cites R4 is never a candidate, however final (row 24)", async () => {
    // The built text of the retention job and of the overview: REDACTABLE names exactly the four.
    const source = readFileSync(path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../../src/moderation/repo.ts"), "utf8");
    const redactable = source.slice(source.indexOf("const REDACTABLE = sql`"), source.indexOf("`;", source.indexOf("const REDACTABLE = sql`")));
    expect(redactable).toContain("m.kind in ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name')");
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const account = await profile(tx);
      for (const minutes of [0, 1, 2]) await strikeIn(tx, account.id, minutes, "R4");
      const suspension = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R4", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
      // Final for its author long ago, as only the migrator can make it here.
      await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = informed_at - interval '7 months', decided_at = decided_at - interval '7 months' where id = ${suspension}::uuid`);
      const [final] = await tx.execute<{ final: boolean }>(sql`select public.decision_final_at(${suspension}::uuid) < now() as final`);
      expect(final!.final).toBe(true);
      expect(await dueRedactions(tx)).not.toContain(suspension);
      expect(await refusal(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${suspension}::uuid)`)))).toBe("invalid_decision");
    }, migrateDb);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- what needs the clock: committed, then moved back

  describe("over time: the rungs, a stale ladder, an old basis and a second threat (committed, with ageStandingForTest)", () => {
    let world: DeciderWorld;
    let boss: RealStaff;

    beforeAll(async () => {
      world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
      boss = await world.staff("admin");
    }, 120_000);
    afterAll(async () => {
      // closeDecisions and removeFixtures (the file's afterAll) remove the cases first; the staff profiles go last.
      await closeDecisions();
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, committed.splice(0));
      await world.close();
    }, 120_000);

    /** An account committed for good until the end of the file. */
    async function committedAccount() {
      const account = await newProfile(apiDb);
      committed.push(account.id);
      return account;
    }
    /** A committed decision on the account's case below the routes' list, by the world's admin: its id. */
    async function commitOnAccount(accountId: string, rule: RuleId, actions: DecisionInput["actions"]): Promise<string> {
      const recorded = await intake(world.moderation.deps.apiDb, ground.finding(boss.id, rule), anAccount(accountId));
      const outcome = await world.decideAs(boss, recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: rule, actions }, { allKinds: true });
      if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
      return outcome.decisionId;
    }
    /**
     * What a decision on the account's case would answer now, inside a transaction that is rolled back: null when it
     * would stand, else the refusal's detail, or "no detail: " and its code for a refusal without one.
     */
    async function wouldDecide(accountId: string, rule: RuleId, actions: DecisionInput["actions"], staff: TestStaff = admin): Promise<string | null> {
      let answer: string | null = null;
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        try {
          await onAccount(tx, accountId, rule, actions, staff);
        } catch (err) {
          const detail = (err as { detail?: string | null }).detail ?? null;
          answer = detail ?? `no detail: ${err instanceof ModerationError ? err.code : String(err)}`;
        }
      });
      return answer;
    }
    const standingOf = async (accountId: string) =>
      (await apiDb.execute<{ running: boolean; live: number }>(
        sql`select coalesce(p.suspended_from <= clock_timestamp() and clock_timestamp() < p.suspended_until, false) as running,
                   (select count(*)::int from standing_live s where s.account_id = p.id) as live
              from profiles p where p.id = ${accountId}::uuid`,
      ))[0]!;

    test("a suspension of the ladder runs from the relay's acceptance plus the window, ends by the clock, and its rung needs a newer strike", async () => {
      const account = await committedAccount();
      const strikes = await strikeForTest(apiDb, account.id, 3);
      const first = await commitOnAccount(account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
      expect(await standingOf(account.id)).toEqual({ running: false, live: 1 });
      // The relay accepted the notice, as the migrator records it here (the test's auth module sends nothing).
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'sent', author_mail_at = now() where id = ${first}::uuid`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`select public.standing_apply(${account.id}::uuid)`);
      expect(await standingOf(account.id)).toEqual({ running: false, live: 1 });
      // Eight days on: one day past the reply window, the suspension runs.
      await ageStandingForTest(migrateDb, account.id, "8 days");
      expect(await standingOf(account.id)).toEqual({ running: true, live: 1 });
      // Three more: its three days are over, and nothing was written at either moment but by ageStandingForTest.
      await ageStandingForTest(migrateDb, account.id, "3 days");
      expect(await standingOf(account.id)).toEqual({ running: false, live: 0 });
      // The strikes still count, but none is newer than the last step of the ladder: no next step.
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 7, true)])).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
      // A new strike opens the second rung: at most its days.
      strikes.push(...(await strikeForTest(apiDb, account.id, 1)));
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[1] + 1, true)])).toMatch(/^days: at most 7/);
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.ladderDays[1], true)]);
        expect((await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend")).rests_on).toEqual(strikes);
      });
    }, 240_000);

    test("a step of the ladder cites the rule of the newest strike; with the newest under R5 it is still a step, never a ground at once", async () => {
      const account = await committedAccount();
      const strikes = [...(await strikeForTest(apiDb, account.id, 2)), ...(await strikeForTest(apiDb, account.id, 1, "R5"))];
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R1", [timed("suspend", 3, true)])).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", STANDING_RULES.threatDays, true)])).toMatch(/^days: at most 3 on the basis strikes/);
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const decision = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, true)]);
        // Decided one after the other, the strikes are listed oldest first.
        expect(await rowOf(tx, decision, "suspend")).toMatchObject({ basis: "strikes", days: 3, rests_on: strikes });
      });
    }, 240_000);

    test("a threat's decision older than basis_age_days supports no suspension at once", async () => {
      const account = await committedAccount();
      await strikeForTest(apiDb, account.id, 1, "R5");
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)])).toBeNull();
      await ageStandingForTest(migrateDb, account.id, `${STANDING_RULES.basisAgeDays + 1} days`);
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 3, false)])).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
    }, 240_000);

    test("a termination at once needs a second threat, posted after the person was told of the suspension for the first, which has ended", async () => {
      const account = await committedAccount();
      const [firstThreat] = await strikeForTest(apiDb, account.id, 1, "R5");
      const suspension = await commitOnAccount(account.id, "R5", [timed("suspend", 1, false)]);
      expect(await standingOf(account.id)).toEqual({ running: true, live: 1 });
      // While it runs, no second standing measure; once it ended, none is in the way.
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R5", [timed("terminate", null, false)])).toBe("no detail: standing_conflict");
      await ageStandingForTest(migrateDb, account.id, "2 days");
      expect(await standingOf(account.id)).toEqual({ running: false, live: 0 });
      // An R5 decision about a post from before the suspension is no second threat.
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const old = await postCase(tx, account.id, null, "R5");
        await decideIn(tx, admin, old.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
        expect(await refusalDetail(onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("terminate", null, false)]))).toMatch(/^basis: none fits/);
      });
      const [secondThreat] = await strikeForTest(apiDb, account.id, 1, "R5");
      expect(await wouldDecide(account.id, "R5", [timed("terminate", null, false)], mod)).toBe("no detail: admin_required");
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const termination = await onAccount(tx, account.id, "R5", [timed("terminate", null, false)]);
        expect(await rowOf(tx, termination, "terminate")).toMatchObject({ basis: "threat_repeat", rests_on: [firstThreat, secondThreat], days: null, announced: false });
        expect((await columns(tx, account.id)).until).toBe("infinity");
        // Either threat reversed ends it by derivation.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, await caseOfDecision(tx, secondThreat!), { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: secondThreat!, actions: [act("restore")] });
        expect(await liveRows(tx, account.id)).toBe(0);
        expect(await columns(tx, account.id)).toEqual({ from: null, until: null, restricted: null });
      });
      expect(suspension).toBeTruthy();
    }, 240_000);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  }, 120_000);
});

import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, ALERT_KINDS, ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, STANDING_RULES, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, isTimeFact, outcomeWords, renderAlert, type AlertKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { noticeTime } from "../../src/auth/flows/notify";
import type { MailMessage, NoticeUpdateData, NoticeUpdateLine, TemplateName } from "../../src/mail/mailer";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS, renderMail, renderNoticeUpdate, renderTemplate } from "../../src/mail/templates";

/**
 * The mails of deciding and of the dispatch (3c design, section 7.15): the author's statement, the staff alerts for a
 * burst of decisions, for a decision that lifted the protection of reported images and for cases that wait too long, and
 * the one structured mail, the daily update of decisions on a person's reports. Each is pinned word for word.
 */
const LAST_USER = "korbat staff never ask for your password or a code, and korbat does not read replies to this email.";
const LAST_STAFF = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
const paragraphs = (text: string) => text.trimEnd().split("\n\n");
const TIME = "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC";

/** No link of any kind, and the staff mails' last sentence. */
function linkless(r: { text: string; html: string }) {
  expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
  expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
  expect(paragraphs(r.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_STAFF);
}
