```sql
           preserve = coalesce(order_correct.facts ->> 'kind', x.kind) = 'tco_removal'
     WHERE x.id = o.id;
  EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_exists';
  END;
  -- A statement of its own reads the row as it now stands.
  SELECT x.* INTO v_new FROM public.legal_orders x WHERE x.id = o.id;

  IF v_effect THEN
    -- The posts the order disabled, each with the time of the order's first decision about it.
    IF v_new.section_c AND NOT o.section_c THEN
      UPDATE public.decisions d SET informed_at = NULL, author_mail = 'none'
        FROM (SELECT i.post_id, min(od.decided_at) AS since
                FROM public.legal_order_items i JOIN public.decisions od ON od.order_item_id = i.id
               WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.post_id IS NOT NULL
               GROUP BY i.post_id) p, public.cases c
       WHERE c.id = d.case_id AND c.target_type = 'post' AND c.target_id = p.post_id AND d.decided_at >= p.since
         -- 0028: only a decision its author was told of (toldToAuthor's two halves); one that told nobody stays so.
         AND d.author_mail <> 'none' AND d.informed_at IS NOT NULL;
    END IF;
    IF o.section_c AND NOT v_new.section_c
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i JOIN public.decisions d ON d.order_item_id = i.id
                    WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND d.informed_at IS NULL) THEN
      UPDATE public.legal_orders x SET hold_ended_at = now(), hold_end_reason = 'not_ordered' WHERE x.id = o.id AND x.hold_ended_at IS NULL;
      INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, at, ground, by_staff, via)
      VALUES (o.id, 'hold_ended', clock_timestamp(), 'not_ordered', NULL, 'system');
    END IF;
    IF v_new.preserve AND NOT o.preserve THEN
      UPDATE public.legal_order_items i SET preserve_until = public.order_preserve_until(d.decided_at)
        FROM public.decisions d
       WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND d.id = i.decision_id AND i.preserve_until IS NULL
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = i.action_id);
    ELSIF o.preserve AND NOT v_new.preserve THEN
      INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, at, by_staff, via)
      SELECT o.id, i.id, 'preservation_ended', clock_timestamp(), NULL, 'system'
        FROM public.legal_order_items i
       WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.preserve_until IS NOT NULL AND i.preserve_ended_at IS NULL;
      UPDATE public.legal_order_items i SET preserve_ended_at = now()
       WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.preserve_until IS NOT NULL AND i.preserve_ended_at IS NULL;
    END IF;
    IF v_new.withhold_from_author IS DISTINCT FROM o.withhold_from_author THEN
      UPDATE public.decision_actions a SET withhold_author = v_new.withhold_from_author
        FROM public.legal_order_items i
       WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND a.id = i.action_id
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = a.id);
      SELECT array_agg(i.post_id ORDER BY i.post_id) INTO v_posts
        FROM public.legal_order_items i
       WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND i.post_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = i.action_id);
      IF v_posts IS NOT NULL THEN
        PERFORM public.moderation_apply(v_posts, true);
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, at, ground, by_staff, via)
  VALUES (o.id, 'corrected', clock_timestamp(), v_rule, order_correct.by_staff, 'console')
  RETURNING id INTO v_event;
  RETURN v_event;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 15. alert_steps(), replaced from its text in 0027_orders with the row marked 0026 in section 6.1: hold_ending. Every
-- other line is 0027's, unchanged.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."alert_steps"() RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  r record;
  v_rows integer;
  v_written integer := 0;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.order_rules();

  INSERT INTO public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, step, facts, message_id)
  SELECT 'contact_mail_escalated', 5, 'all',
         coalesce((SELECT max(o.step) + 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                    WHERE o.kind = 'contact_mail_escalated' AND o.message_id = m.id AND o.order_id IS NULL), 0),
         jsonb_build_object('receivedAt', public.alert_time(m.received_at), 'dueAt', public.alert_time(m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.hour_minutes))),
         m.id
    FROM public.contact_messages m
   WHERE NOT m.stale AND m.disposition IS NULL
     AND m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.escalate_minutes) <= v_now
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth.staff_sessions s WHERE s.created_at >= m.received_at OR s.last_used_at >= m.received_at)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                      WHERE o.kind = 'contact_mail_escalated' AND o.message_id = m.id AND o.order_id IS NULL
                        AND o.created_at >= m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.escalate_minutes))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_written := v_written + v_rows;

  INSERT INTO public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, step, facts, message_id)
  SELECT 'order_due', 5, 'all',
         coalesce((SELECT max(o.step) + 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                    WHERE o.kind = 'order_due' AND o.message_id = m.id AND o.order_id IS NULL), 0),
         -- The minutes left, rounded up and never below 0: an hour of order_rules() is hour_minutes minutes.
         jsonb_build_object('dueAt', public.alert_time(d.due_at),
                            'minutesLeft', greatest(0, ceil(extract(epoch FROM d.due_at - v_now) / extract(epoch FROM make_interval(mins => r.hour_minutes)) * r.hour_minutes))::integer),
         m.id
    FROM public.contact_messages m
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.hour_minutes) AS due_at,
            CASE WHEN m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.hour_minutes) <= v_now THEN m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.hour_minutes)
                 WHEN m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.remind_minutes) <= v_now THEN m.received_at + make_interval(mins => r.remind_minutes)
            END AS threshold) d
   WHERE NOT m.stale AND m.disposition IS NULL AND d.threshold IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                      WHERE o.kind = 'order_due' AND o.message_id = m.id AND o.order_id IS NULL AND o.created_at >= d.threshold)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_written := v_written + v_rows;

  INSERT INTO public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, step, facts)
  SELECT 'alert_test', 3, 'all',
         coalesce((SELECT max(o.step) + 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                    WHERE o.kind = 'alert_test' AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.order_id IS NULL), 0),
         jsonb_build_object('at', public.alert_time(v_now))
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                      WHERE o.kind = 'alert_test' AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.order_id IS NULL AND o.created_at >= v_now - make_interval(days => 1))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_written := v_written + v_rows;

  -- 0027 (3f design, section 6.1, the rows marked 0025): an order's steps. Its clock started again by a restart rings the
  -- phone on call again, as a message's first push, once a restart: the threshold is the restart's clock_start, so a
  -- second restart alerts again with the next free step.
  INSERT INTO public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, step, facts, order_id)
  SELECT 'contact_mail', 5, 'on_call',
         coalesce((SELECT max(o.step) + 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                    WHERE o.kind = 'contact_mail' AND o.order_id = c.order_id AND o.message_id IS NULL), 0),
         jsonb_build_object('dueAt', public.alert_time(c.deadline_at)),
         c.order_id
    FROM public.legal_order_clock c
    JOIN public.legal_orders lo ON lo.id = c.order_id
   WHERE lo.closed_at IS NULL AND NOT c.stopped AND c.clock_start IS NOT NULL AND c.items_open > 0
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_events e WHERE e.order_id = c.order_id AND e.kind IN ('grounds_ceased', 'clarification_received'))
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                      WHERE o.kind = 'contact_mail' AND o.order_id = c.order_id AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.created_at >= c.clock_start)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_written := v_written + v_rows;

  -- order_due for an order: a removal order that is not closed, whose clock runs, with an item neither disabled nor
  -- closed (one given effect in part is still due), at clock_start + remind_minutes and at the deadline, the later of the
  -- two that has passed. Its reminders end when it is given effect in full, closed, or stopped by an Annex III.
  INSERT INTO public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, step, facts, order_id)
  SELECT 'order_due', 5, 'all',
         coalesce((SELECT max(o.step) + 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                    WHERE o.kind = 'order_due' AND o.order_id = c.order_id AND o.message_id IS NULL), 0),
         -- The minutes left, rounded up and never below 0: an hour of order_rules() is hour_minutes minutes.
         jsonb_build_object('dueAt', public.alert_time(c.deadline_at),
                            'minutesLeft', greatest(0, ceil(extract(epoch FROM c.deadline_at - v_now) / extract(epoch FROM make_interval(mins => r.hour_minutes)) * r.hour_minutes))::integer,
                            'itemsOpen', c.items_open),
         c.order_id
    FROM public.legal_order_clock c
    JOIN public.legal_orders lo ON lo.id = c.order_id
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT CASE WHEN c.deadline_at <= v_now THEN c.deadline_at
                 WHEN c.clock_start + make_interval(mins => r.remind_minutes) <= v_now THEN c.clock_start + make_interval(mins => r.remind_minutes)
            END AS threshold) d
   WHERE lo.closed_at IS NULL AND NOT c.stopped AND c.clock_start IS NOT NULL AND c.items_open > 0 AND d.threshold IS NOT NULL
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                      WHERE o.kind = 'order_due' AND o.order_id = c.order_id AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.created_at >= d.threshold)
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_written := v_written + v_rows;

  -- order_unverified, daily: among the orders that are not closed and are given effect, one count for each of its three
  -- conditions: an item disabled while the order is not verified, or added after its verification; no reasons of the
  -- authority recorded; a DSA order holding a notice with no recorded end. oldestAt is the first disabling among them.
  INSERT INTO public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, step, facts)
  SELECT 'order_unverified', 5, 'all',
         coalesce((SELECT max(o.step) + 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                    WHERE o.kind = 'order_unverified' AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.order_id IS NULL), 0),
         jsonb_build_object('count', u.unverified, 'textsMissing', u.texts_missing, 'holdsOpen', u.holds_open, 'oldestAt', public.alert_time(u.oldest_at))
    FROM (SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.unverified))::integer AS unverified,
                 (count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.texts_missing))::integer AS texts_missing,
                 (count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.hold_open))::integer AS holds_open,
                 min(q.first_effect) FILTER (WHERE q.unverified OR q.texts_missing OR q.hold_open) AS oldest_at
            FROM (SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i
                                  WHERE i.order_id = lo.id AND i.disabled_at IS NOT NULL AND (lo.verified_at IS NULL OR i.added_at > lo.verified_at)) AS unverified,
                         lo.reasons IS NULL AS texts_missing,
                         (public.order_hold_until(lo.id) = 'infinity'::timestamptz
                          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i JOIN public.decisions d ON d.order_item_id = i.id
                                       WHERE i.order_id = lo.id AND d.informed_at IS NULL)) AS hold_open,
                         (SELECT min(i.disabled_at) FROM public.legal_order_items i WHERE i.order_id = lo.id) AS first_effect
                    FROM public.legal_orders lo
                   WHERE lo.closed_at IS NULL
                     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i WHERE i.order_id = lo.id AND i.disabled_at IS NOT NULL)) q) u
   WHERE u.unverified + u.texts_missing + u.holds_open > 0
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                      WHERE o.kind = 'order_unverified' AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.order_id IS NULL AND o.created_at >= v_now - make_interval(days => 1))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_written := v_written + v_rows;

  -- 0028 (3f design, section 6.1, the row marked 0026): hold_ending, daily, while an order has an untold decision whose
  -- order_hold_until is less than hold_warning_days ahead, so that whoever has the server checks the mailbox for an
  -- extension before the database releases. Facts: how many held notices, and the first end. A hold with no end
  -- ('infinity') is order_unverified's.
  INSERT INTO public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, step, facts)
  SELECT 'hold_ending', 3, 'all',
         coalesce((SELECT max(o.step) + 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                    WHERE o.kind = 'hold_ending' AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.order_id IS NULL), 0),
         jsonb_build_object('count', h.held, 'at', public.alert_time(h.first_end))
    FROM (SELECT count(*)::integer AS held, min(u.until) AS first_end
            FROM (SELECT public.order_hold_until(i.order_id) AS until
                    FROM public.decisions d JOIN public.legal_order_items i ON i.id = d.order_item_id
                   WHERE d.kind = 'order' AND d.informed_at IS NULL) u
           WHERE u.until IS NOT NULL AND u.until < 'infinity'::timestamptz AND u.until < v_now + make_interval(days => r.hold_warning_days)) h
   WHERE h.held > 0
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_outbox o
                      WHERE o.kind = 'hold_ending' AND o.message_id IS NULL AND o.order_id IS NULL AND o.created_at >= v_now - make_interval(days => 1))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_rows = ROW_COUNT;
  v_written := v_written + v_rows;

  RETURN v_written;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 16. order_notices_release(): the writer of a decision's informed_at after its insert (the only other one is
-- order_correct, which can only untell). The dispatch round calls it, every ten minutes, before it mails statements. It
-- answers how many decisions it told, in both of its steps. In this order:
--   1. The rows of the orders that have an untold order decision, FOR SHARE in id order: a hold's end, an extension and
--      a correction either commit before this reads them or wait for it.
--   2. In a statement of its own, the untold order decisions whose order holds nothing (order_hold_until is null) or
--      whose hold has ended (order_hold_until(order) <= clock_timestamp()), FOR UPDATE in id order. Each gets
--      informed_at = clock_timestamp(), read after the test, so the stored time is never before the end (now(), the
--      transaction's start, could be), and the mail pending; its item gets the event notice_released, by the system.
--   3. In a statement of its own, which runs in every call, also when step 2 told nothing: every untold decision that is
--      not an order decision (the correction of one, or a decision of korbat's own that decisions_record held), on a
--      post case whose target has no untold order decision any more, gets the same two values. So a reinstatement that
--      committed beside a release is told by the next round at the latest, and a held decision of korbat's own waits for
--      every order decision about its post, also one whose measure was lifted meanwhile, since its statement may name
--      "another decision".
-- A notice released to an account that no longer exists is set pending like any other; the mailer then has no address
-- for it and gives it up.
CREATE FUNCTION "public"."order_notices_release"() RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  r record;
  told integer := 0;
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.legal_orders o
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items i JOIN public.decisions d ON d.order_item_id = i.id
                  WHERE i.order_id = o.id AND d.kind = 'order' AND d.informed_at IS NULL)
   ORDER BY o.id FOR SHARE;
  FOR r IN
    SELECT d.id, i.id AS item_id, i.order_id
      FROM public.decisions d JOIN public.legal_order_items i ON i.id = d.order_item_id
     WHERE d.kind = 'order' AND d.informed_at IS NULL
       AND coalesce(public.order_hold_until(i.order_id) <= clock_timestamp(), true)
     ORDER BY d.id
       FOR UPDATE OF d
  LOOP
    UPDATE public.decisions x SET informed_at = clock_timestamp(), author_mail = 'pending' WHERE x.id = r.id;
    INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, at, by_staff, via)
    VALUES (r.order_id, r.item_id, 'notice_released', clock_timestamp(), NULL, 'system');
    told := told + 1;
  END LOOP;
  FOR r IN
    SELECT d.id
      FROM public.decisions d JOIN public.cases c ON c.id = d.case_id
     WHERE d.kind <> 'order' AND d.informed_at IS NULL AND c.target_type = 'post'
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decisions od JOIN public.cases oc ON oc.id = od.case_id
                        WHERE od.kind = 'order' AND od.informed_at IS NULL AND oc.target_type = 'post' AND oc.target_id = c.target_id)
     ORDER BY d.id
       FOR UPDATE OF d
  LOOP
    UPDATE public.decisions x SET informed_at = clock_timestamp(), author_mail = 'pending' WHERE x.id = r.id;
    told := told + 1;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN told;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "public"."order_notices_release"() FROM PUBLIC;--> statement-breakpoint
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "public"."order_notices_release"() TO korbat_api;
```

```json
          "for": "ALL",

            "korbat_api"
          ],
          "using": "true",
          "withCheck": "true"
        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "decisions_rule_id": {
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding'"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"received_at\" <= \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\" and \"legal_orders\".\"sent_at\" <= \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\""

          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"issued_at\" <= coalesce(\"legal_orders\".\"received_at\", \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\")"

          "value": "((\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" <> 'tco_removal' and not \"legal_orders\".\"section_c\") or \"legal_orders\".\"withhold_from_author\") and (\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" <> 'tco_removal' or \"legal_orders\".\"preserve\")"

        },
        "legal_orders_hold_end": {
          "name": "legal_orders_hold_end",
          "value": "(\"legal_orders\".\"hold_ended_at\" is null) = (\"legal_orders\".\"hold_end_reason\" is null) and \"legal_orders\".\"hold_end_reason\" in ('not_authentic', 'annulled', 'released_by_authority', 'not_ordered')"
        },
        "legal_orders_texts_len": {
```

### Replace `apps/admin/src/App.tsx` (whole file)

```tsx
import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { ApiError } from "./api";
import type { SignalApi } from "./enroll";
import { Layout, Masthead } from "./Layout";
import { describeError } from "./messages";
import { NavLink } from "./nav";
import { parseOrderId, type ConsolePath } from "./router";
import { Appeals } from "./screens/Appeals";
import { Audit } from "./screens/Audit";
import { CaseScreen } from "./screens/Case";
import { Contact } from "./screens/Contact";
import { Enroll } from "./screens/Enroll";
import { Home } from "./screens/Home";
import { Order } from "./screens/Order";
import { Orders, type Opened } from "./screens/Orders";
import { Queue } from "./screens/Queue";
import { SignIn } from "./screens/SignIn";
import { Standing } from "./screens/Standing";
import { Unavailable } from "./screens/Unavailable";
import type { ConsoleStore } from "./store";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The console's page (3a design, section 9): the screen for the address and the session. An enrolment link needs no
 * session; every other page shows sign-in in place while there is none, at its own address, and its own screen after.
 */
export function App({ store, credentials, signal }: { store: ConsoleStore; credentials: CredentialsLike; signal: SignalApi | undefined }) {
  const state = useSyncExternalStore(store.subscribe, store.get, store.get);
  const [signOutError, setSignOutError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // 3f: the order just opened, whose page shows once that it was opened (and, after "I cannot tell", what to do).
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState<{ id: string; unsure: boolean } | null>(null);
  const { api } = store;
  const { session, route } = state;

  if (session.kind === "unavailable") return <Unavailable />;

  if (route.name === "enroll") {
    return (
      <>
        <Masthead />
        <main>
          <Enroll token={route.token} api={api} credentials={credentials} signal={signal} onUnavailable={store.unavailable} />
        </main>
      </>
    );
  }

  if (session.kind !== "signed-in") {
    return (
      <>
        <Masthead />
        <main>
          {session.kind === "checking" ? <p className="quiet">Loading</p> : null}
          {session.kind === "failed" ? (
            <section className="panel">
              <p role="alert" className="error">
                {session.message}
              </p>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => void store.start()}>
                Try again
              </button>
            </section>
          ) : null}
          {session.kind === "signed-out" ? <SignIn ended={session.ended} api={api} credentials={credentials} onSignedIn={store.signedIn} onUnavailable={store.unavailable} /> : null}
        </main>
      </>
    );
  }

  const signOut = async () => {
    setSignOutError(null);
    try {
      await api.signOut({ activity: true });
      store.signedOut();
    } catch (err) {
      // A session that had already ended has shown sign-in through the 401; any other failure leaves the session as it was.
      if (!(err instanceof ApiError && err.code === "staff_session_required")) setSignOutError(describeError(err));
    }
  };

  /** An order opened from the form: its page, which says once that it was opened. */
  const onOpened = (done: Opened) => {
    const id = parseOrderId(done.view.id);
    if (id === null) return;
    setOpened({ id, unsure: done.unsure });
    store.openOrder(id);
  };

  const navigate = (path: ConsolePath) => {
    setSignOutError(null);
    store.navigate(path);
  };

  return (
    <Layout me={session.me} path={state.path} warning={state.warning} onNavigate={navigate} onSignOut={() => void signOut()} onStay={() => void store.stay()}>
      {signOutError ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {signOutError}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {route.name === "home" || route.name === "signin" ? <Home me={session.me} api={api} credentials={credentials} onOpenCase={store.openCase} onNavigate={navigate} onOpenOrder={store.openOrder} /> : null}
      {route.name === "audit" ? <Audit api={api} /> : null}
      {route.name === "queue" ? <Queue api={api} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {/* Keyed by the case: another case's page starts with nothing of this one's. */}
      {route.name === "case" ? <CaseScreen key={route.id} id={route.id} api={api} credentials={credentials} role={session.me.role} drafts={store.drafts} onOpenCase={store.openCase} onOpenOrder={store.openOrder} /> : null}
      {route.name === "appeals" ? <Appeals api={api} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {route.name === "standing" ? <Standing api={api} onOpenCase={store.openCase} /> : null}
      {route.name === "contact" ? <Contact api={api} me={session.me} onOpened={onOpened} onOpenOrder={store.openOrder} /> : null}
      {route.name === "orders" ? <Orders api={api} me={session.me} onOpenOrder={store.openOrder} onOpened={onOpened} /> : null}
      {/* Keyed by the order: another order's page starts with nothing of this one's. */}
      {route.name === "order" ? (
        <Order key={route.id} id={route.id} api={api} me={session.me} credentials={credentials} opened={opened !== null && opened.id === route.id ? { unsure: opened.unsure } : null} onOpenCase={store.openCase} />
      ) : null}
      {route.name === "unknown" ? (
        <section aria-labelledby="unknown-title">
          <h2 id="unknown-title">No such page</h2>
          <p>There is no page at this address.</p>
          <p>
            <NavLink to="/" onNavigate={navigate}>
              Go to the home page
            </NavLink>
          </p>
        </section>
      ) : null}
    </Layout>
  );
}
```

```ts
import {
  AppealsPage,
  AuditPage,
  CaseView,
  ContactPage,
  ErrorEnvelope,
  FindingResponse,
  OrderView,
  OrdersPage,
  QueuePage,
  RevealResponse,
  StaffEnrollOptionsResponse,
  StaffEnrollVerifyResponse,
  StaffKeysResponse,
  StaffMe,
  StaffOverview,
  StaffSessionsResponse,
  StaffSignInOptionsResponse,
  StaffSignInVerifyResponse,
  StaffSnapshotTaken,
  StaffStepUpOptionsResponse,
  StaffTextSaved,
  StaffTextsResponse,
  StandingLists,
  type AppealReviewRequest,
  type CaseDecisionRequest,
  type ContactCloseRequest,
  type FindingRequest,
  type IdentityRevealRequest,
  type OrderCorrectRequest,
  type OrderEffectRequest,
  type OrderEventRecordRequest,
  type OrderItemsRequest,
  type OrderOpenRequest,
  type StaffEnrollOptionsRequest,
  type StaffEnrollVerifyRequest,
  type StaffSessionRevokeRequest,
  type StaffSignInVerifyRequest,
  type StaffStepUpOptionsRequest,
  type StaffTextSaveRequest,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { z } from "zod";
import { messageFor } from "./messages";
import { isLowerUuid, type CaseId, type OrderId } from "./router";

/**
 * The console's calls to its API (3a design, sections 7 and 9). Every call goes to /api/staff/* on the console's own
 * origin, with the staff session's cookies. Each echoes the staff CSRF cookie in x-staff-csrf (the API requires it on
 * every write), sends X-Staff-Activity: 1 only when its caller says a person's action started it, and parses the answer
 * with the contracts' schema, so nothing the page shows is anything but what the contracts describe.
 */

/** The staff CSRF cookie, which the page can read and the API compares with the header; never the app's. */
export const STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
export const STAFF_CSRF_HEADER = "x-staff-csrf";
/** The mark of a request a person's action started: only such a request moves the session's idle end. */
export const STAFF_ACTIVITY_HEADER = "x-staff-activity";

/** A failed call: the API's code, or the console's own (network, invalid_answer), with the console's words for it. */
export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly code: string,
    message: string = messageFor(code),
    /** 3f: what a refusal carries beside its code: order_exists names the order that stands ({ orderId }). */
    readonly details?: unknown,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
  }
}

/** What the API client runs on: the page's fetch and cookies, or a test's. */
export interface StaffApiDeps {
  fetch(input: string, init: RequestInit): Promise<Response>;
  cookie(): string;
}

/**
 * What the store listens for. Any staff_session_required answer means the API has already cleared both staff cookies,
 * so the store shows sign-in in place; a marked request that succeeded restarts the idle timer.
 */
export interface ApiHooks {
  /**
   * `carriedStaffCookie`: the refused request carried the staff CSRF cookie. Only a sign-in sets it, for the session's
   * 12 hours, and only a sign-out or a staff_session_required answer clears it, so a request that carried it was made
   * for a session that has now ended, even when no page held that session (a reload or a new tab after an idle-out).
   */
  onSessionRequired(carriedStaffCookie: boolean): void;
  onActivity(): void;
  /**
   * Every /me answer, marked or not: the session the browser's cookie names now, which the store keeps, so a page whose
   * cookie another tab replaced (a sign-out and a sign-in there) holds the new session's handle and binds step-ups to it.
   */
  onMe(me: StaffMe): void;
}

/** A call's options: `activity` is true only when a person's action (a click, a form, opening a screen) started it. */
export interface Call {
  activity?: boolean;
}

/** The audit reader's query: newest, before a cursor, or the page whose newest row is at a place; and its one filter. */
export interface AuditQuery {
  action?: "staff_sign_in";
  cursor?: number;
  at?: number;
}

/** A cookie's value by its exact name, from a document.cookie string. */
export function readCookie(cookies: string, name: string): string | undefined {
  for (const part of cookies.split(";")) {
    const trimmed = part.trim();
    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
    if (separator > 0 && trimmed.slice(0, separator) === name) {
      try {
        return decodeURIComponent(trimmed.slice(separator + 1));
      } catch {
        return trimmed.slice(separator + 1);
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * A case answered under another case's address is no answer (3c design, section 7.5: the action is built from what the
 * page shows): the page would show one case and act on another, so nothing is built from it.
 */
function sameCase(asked: string, view: CaseView): CaseView {
  if (view.id !== asked) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_answer");
  return view;
}

/** 3f: an order answered under another order's address is no answer, as for a case. */
function sameOrder(asked: string, view: OrderView): OrderView {
  if (view.id !== asked) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_answer");
  return view;
}

export type StaffApi = ReturnType<typeof createStaffApi>;

export function createStaffApi(deps: StaffApiDeps) {
  const hooks: ApiHooks = { onSessionRequired: () => undefined, onActivity: () => undefined, onMe: () => undefined };

  /**
   * One request. `schema` parses a 2xx answer; null means the route answers 204 with no body. A non-2xx answer becomes an
   * ApiError with the envelope's code (or not_found and internal when there is none), worded by the console.
   */
  async function request<T>(method: "GET" | "POST" | "DELETE", path: string, schema: z.ZodType<T> | null, call: Call, body?: unknown): Promise<T> {
    const headers: Record<string, string> = { accept: "application/json" };
    const csrf = readCookie(deps.cookie(), STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE);
    if (csrf) headers[STAFF_CSRF_HEADER] = csrf;
    if (call.activity === true) headers[STAFF_ACTIVITY_HEADER] = "1";
    if (body !== undefined) headers["content-type"] = "application/json";

    let response: Response;
    try {
      // Same origin only, never cached, and never redirected: the staff API answers every request itself.
      response = await deps.fetch(path, {
        method,
        headers,
        body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
        credentials: "same-origin",
        cache: "no-store",
        redirect: "error",
      });
    } catch {
      throw new ApiError(0, "network");
    }

    if (!response.ok) {
      const envelope = ErrorEnvelope.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => null));
      const code = envelope.success ? envelope.data.error.code : response.status === 404 ? "not_found" : "internal";
      // The API cleared both staff cookies with this answer; the store shows sign-in in place. The cookie is gone from
      // the page by now, so what the request carried, read before it was sent, is the only record that it was there.
      if (code === "staff_session_required") hooks.onSessionRequired(Boolean(csrf));
      throw new ApiError(response.status, code, undefined, envelope.success ? envelope.data.error.details : undefined);
    }

    let value: T;
    if (schema === null) {
      value = undefined as T;
    } else {
      const parsed = schema.safeParse(await response.json().catch(() => undefined));
      if (!parsed.success) throw new ApiError(response.status, "invalid_answer");
      value = parsed.data;
    }
    // Only a marked success restarts the idle timer. A refused request moved nothing; one that did move the idle end but
    // failed later, or whose answer the schemas refused, only makes the timer read /me early, and it follows the answer.
    if (call.activity === true) hooks.onActivity();
    return value;
  }

  const query = (q: AuditQuery): string => {
    // Fixed order, numbers only: nothing a person typed reaches the address unchecked.
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (q.action !== undefined) params.set("action", q.action);
    if (q.cursor !== undefined) params.set("cursor", String(q.cursor));
    if (q.at !== undefined) params.set("at", String(q.at));
    const text = params.toString();
    return text === "" ? "" : `?${text}`;
  };

  return {
    hooks,
    me: async (call: Call = {}) => {
      const me = await request("GET", "/api/staff/me", StaffMe, call);
      hooks.onMe(me);
      return me;
    },
    sessions: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/sessions", StaffSessionsResponse, call),
    keys: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/keys", StaffKeysResponse, call),
    audit: (q: AuditQuery, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/audit${query(q)}`, AuditPage, call),
    signOut: (call: Call = {}) => request<void>("POST", "/api/staff/signout", null, call),
    signInOptions: (call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/options", StaffSignInOptionsResponse, call),
    signInVerify: (body: StaffSignInVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/signin/verify", StaffSignInVerifyResponse, call, body),
    enrollOptions: (body: StaffEnrollOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/options", StaffEnrollOptionsResponse, call, body),
    enrollVerify: (body: StaffEnrollVerifyRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/enroll/verify", StaffEnrollVerifyResponse, call, body),
    stepUpOptions: (body: StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/step-up/options", StaffStepUpOptionsResponse, call, body),
    /** The handle must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    revokeSession: (handle: string, body: StaffSessionRevokeRequest, call: Call = {}) =>
      request<void>("DELETE", `/api/staff/sessions/${encodeURIComponent(handle)}`, null, call, body),

    // Moderation cases (3c design, section 7.3). A case's address is built from a checked id; every other value goes in
    // a body or, for the queue's cursor, is one the API itself handed out, encoded.
    overview: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/overview", StaffOverview, call),
    /** A page of the queue. Its refreshes carry no mark: they are the page's own, never its person's. */
    queue: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/queue${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, QueuePage, call),
    caseView: async (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => sameCase(id, await request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}`, CaseView, call)),
    takeSnapshot: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/snapshots`, StaffSnapshotTaken, call, {}),
    saveText: (id: CaseId, body: StaffTextSaveRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextSaved, call, body),
    texts: (id: CaseId, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/cases/${id}/texts`, StaffTextsResponse, call),
    openFinding: (body: FindingRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/findings", FindingResponse, call, body),
    /**
     * A decision on a case, with the key's confirmation: the case must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up
     * confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the case as it now stands, and it is that case's.
     */
    decide: async (caseId: string, body: CaseDecisionRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/cases/${caseId}/decisions`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3e: the Standing screen's four lists. */
    standing: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/standing", StandingLists, call),
    /** A page of the pending appeals, newest first. The cursor is one the API itself handed out, encoded. */
    appeals: (cursor: string | null, call: Call = {}) => request("GET", `/api/staff/appeals${cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`}`, AppealsPage, call),
    /**
     * The review of the appeal of a decision, with the key's confirmation: the decision must already be the lower-case
     * uuid the step-up confirmed, since it is the action's target. The answer is the decision's case as it now stands,
     * and it must be the case of the page that asked.
     */
    review: async (caseId: string, decisionId: string, body: AppealReviewRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(caseId) || !isLowerUuid(decisionId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameCase(caseId, await request("POST", `/api/staff/decisions/${decisionId}/review`, CaseView, call, body));
    },
    /**
     * 3f: a page of the messages at the contact point, newest first, all or only those nobody has handled. The cursor is
     * one the API itself handed out, encoded.
     */
    contact: (cursor: string | null, open: boolean, call: Call = {}) => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (cursor !== null) params.set("cursor", cursor);
      if (open) params.set("open", "1");
      const text = params.toString();
      return request("GET", `/api/staff/contact${text === "" ? "" : `?${text}`}`, ContactPage, call);
    },
    /** 3f: closes a message as what it was. Its id must be a lower-case uuid; the route answers 204. */
    closeContact: async (messageId: string, body: ContactCloseRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(messageId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request<void>("POST", `/api/staff/contact/${messageId}/close`, null, call, body);
    },
    /** 3f: the orders not closed and those closed in the last 30 days. */
    orders: (call: Call = {}) => request("GET", "/api/staff/orders", OrdersPage, call),
    /** 3f: one order. An answer about another order than the one asked is no answer. */
    order: async (id: OrderId, call: Call = {}) => sameOrder(id, await request("GET", `/api/staff/orders/${id}`, OrderView, call)),
    /** 3f: opens an order, with or without a message, without a key. */
    openOrder: (body: OrderOpenRequest, call: Call = {}) => request("POST", "/api/staff/orders", OrderView, call, body),
    /** 3f: more links for an order, without a key. */
    addOrderItems: async (id: OrderId, body: OrderItemsRequest, call: Call = {}) => sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/items`, OrderView, call, body)),
    /** 3f: a clock event, a closing, a reopening or an extension; the order's id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    recordOrderEvent: async (id: string, body: OrderEventRecordRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/events`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3f Task 3: "Disable for an order"; the order's id must be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed. */
    effectOrder: async (id: string, body: OrderEffectRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/effect`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /** 3f: a correction of what the order shows, with the step-up only under the rule admin. */
    correctOrder: async (id: string, body: OrderCorrectRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(id)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return sameOrder(id, await request("POST", `/api/staff/orders/${id}/correct`, OrderView, call, body));
    },
    /** The item must already be the lower-case uuid the step-up confirmed: it is the action's target. */
    reveal: async (itemId: string, body: IdentityRevealRequest, call: Call = {}) => {
      if (!isLowerUuid(itemId)) throw new ApiError(0, "invalid_request");
      return request("POST", `/api/staff/items/${itemId}/reveal`, RevealResponse, call, body);
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
// ---------------------------------------------------------------- what a case holds

/** The items no decision has answered yet. */
const unanswered = (view: CaseView): CaseItem[] => view.items.filter((item) => item.outcome === null);

/** The unanswered suspect items: reports and findings of child sexual abuse material that still wait for an admin. */
export const suspectOpen = (view: CaseView): CaseItem[] => unanswered(view).filter((item) => item.suspect);

/** Whether a final decision on the case would be an admin's: it holds an unanswered suspect item or one citing R5. */
export function finalNeedsAdmin(view: CaseView): boolean {
  return unanswered(view).some((item) => item.suspect || item.ruleId === "R5");
}

/** The kinds of decision offered: none on a closed case, and to someone who is no admin only "While deciding" where the final decision needs one. */
export function kindsOffered(view: CaseView, role: StaffRole): ("interim" | "final")[] {
  if (view.closedAt !== null) return [];
  return finalNeedsAdmin(view) && role !== "admin" ? ["interim"] : ["interim", "final"];
}

/**

 * suspect item, the newest of those, so that the reports on other grounds that arrived after it stay open and are judged
 * with the images once the freeze has ended.

export function throughSeqOf(view: CaseView): number {
  const suspect = suspectOpen(view);
  return Math.max(0, ...(suspect.length > 0 ? suspect : view.items).map((item) => item.seq));
}

/** The unanswered items a final decision made now would leave open: those that arrived after the newest unanswered suspect item. */
export function leftOpen(view: CaseView): CaseItem[] {
  const through = throughSeqOf(view);
  return unanswered(view).filter((item) => item.seq > through);
}

/** The items a decision of this kind considers: a final one those it answers, one taken while deciding every unanswered item. */
function considered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): CaseItem[] {
  const through = throughSeqOf(view);
  return unanswered(view).filter((item) => kind === "interim" || item.seq <= through);
}

/** Whether the ground of the law is offered: a considered item must allege illegality. */
export const lawOffered = (view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): boolean => considered(view, kind).some((item) => item.allegesIllegal);

/** The outcomes offered: a decision taken while deciding restricts; a final one restricts or finds no breach, or, where an item alleges illegality, that it is not evident. */
export function outcomesOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): CaseDraft["outcome"][] {
  if (kind === "interim") return ["restricted"];
  return lawOffered(view, "final") ? ["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident"] : ["restricted", "no_violation"];
}

/**
 * The outcomes the composer lists from the start: those of every kind this person may decide. Someone who may only decide
 * "While deciding" sees the restriction alone; anyone who may decide the case sees No breach, and Illegality not evident
 * where an item alleges illegality, before a kind is chosen.
 */
export function outcomesListed(view: CaseView, role: StaffRole): CaseDraft["outcome"][] {
  return kindsOffered(view, role).includes("final") ? outcomesOffered(view, "final") : ["restricted"];
}

/**
 * The measures this target and kind allow, but the seal, which has a control of its own: offered whatever the target's
 * level, but for one the database always refuses. A second withhold of the post while deciding, while this case's own
 * withhold taken while deciding is in force, is such a one; the page says instead that the case hides the post already.
 */
export function measuresOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): MeasureKind[] {
  // 3e: an account case's final decision may also retire the handle (8.3); its other standing measures come with their tasks.
  const targets = view.target.type === "post" ? ["post", "image"] : ["display_name", "bio", "handle"];
  return MEASURE_KINDS.filter((measure) => measure !== "seal_media" && MEASURES[measure][kind] && targets.includes(MEASURES[measure].target) && !(kind === "interim" && measure === "withhold" && hiddenWhileDeciding(view)));
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.3): whether "Retire the handle" is open. It is greyed with [retire.none] while the profile holds a
 * placeholder: there is no handle to retire, and the database would retire the placeholder of a fresh snapshot.
 */
export const retireOpen = (view: CaseView): boolean => view.target.type === "account" && !(view.target.handle !== null && isRetiredPlaceholder(view.target.handle.toLowerCase()));

/** The handle the newest shown snapshot copied, in lower case as the database retires it; null when no snapshot shows one. */
const snapshotHandle = (view: CaseView): string | null => {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  return newest && !newest.withheld && newest.handle !== null ? newest.handle.toLowerCase() : null;
};

/** [retire.moved]: the profile's handle now differs from the one the newest snapshot copied, which is the one a retirement names. */
export function retireMoved(view: CaseView): boolean {
  const copied = snapshotHandle(view);
  return view.target.type === "account" && copied !== null && view.target.handle !== null && view.target.handle.toLowerCase() !== copied;
}

/**
 * What the preview prints for a retirement's placeholder. The database makes it from the measure's id, which does not
 * exist before the decision is recorded, so the preview prints the prefix and twelve x in place of the hex digits: the
 * placeholder's length and form, and plainly not one the author could meet.
 */
export const PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER = `${RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX}${"x".repeat(12)}`;

/** Whether this case hides its post while it is decided: a withhold taken while deciding is in force. */
export const hiddenWhileDeciding = (view: CaseView): boolean => interimInForce(view).some(({ action }) => action.kind === "withhold");

/**
 * The images an image measure of this kind can name: those of the newest shown snapshot, but, while deciding, not an
 * image a withhold of this case taken while deciding already holds back, which the database refuses to withhold twice.
 */
export function imagesOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final", measure: MeasureKind): string[] {
  const held = kind === "interim" && measure === "withhold_media" ? new Set(interimInForce(view).filter(({ action }) => action.kind === "withhold_media").map(({ action }) => action.mediaId)) : new Set<string | null>();
  return snapshotImages(view).filter((image) => !held.has(image));
}

/** Whether the seal is offered: on a case with an unanswered suspect item that reaches an image; while deciding to anyone eligible, for good to an admin. */
export function sealOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final", role: StaffRole): boolean {
  return suspectOpen(view).length > 0 && (view.suspicion?.reach.images ?? 0) > 0 && (kind === "interim" || role === "admin");
}

/** The images the newest shown snapshot lists, by id: what an image measure can name. */
export function snapshotImages(view: CaseView): string[] {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  return newest && !newest.withheld ? (newest.media ?? []).map((image) => image.id) : [];
}

/**
 * Whether a measure would change nothing now, as far as the page can tell: the post is deleted or already not shown,
 * the image already held back by a measure of this case, the field already the placeholder, the account deleted. The
 * database decides when the measure is recorded; this is what the composer says beside it and what the preview shows.
 * `standing` is the kind of the decision the measure would belong to, which a seal's answer turns on, and so does what
 * the decision ends first. The database ends what was done while deciding before it writes a final decision's measures:
 * every such measure when the decision closes the case, and a seal taken while deciding when it answers the suspect
 * items. What ends then holds nothing back: a post that only this case's withhold hid is visible again, and the measure
 * changes what everyone sees.
 */
export function noEffectOf(view: CaseView, action: DecisionActionParams, standing: "interim" | "final" = "interim"): "already" | "deleted" | null {
  const { target } = view;
  const closes = standing === "final" && leftOpen(view).length === 0;
  const ending = new Set(standing === "final" ? interimInForce(view).filter(({ action: held }) => (held.kind === "seal_media" ? suspectOpen(view).length > 0 : closes)).map(({ action: held }) => held.id) : []);
  const spec = MEASURES[action.kind];
  if (spec.lifts !== null) return null;
  if (action.kind === "seal_media") {
    // A seal on a deleted target changes nothing anyone sees. On a post, neither does one whose images a seal of this case
    // of at least its standing already holds: any seal for one taken while deciding, a seal for good for one for good. On
    // an account a second seal may cover images posted since, which the page cannot tell: it says nothing there.
    if (target.type === "account") return target.deleted ? "deleted" : null;
    if (target.state === "deleted_by_author") return "deleted";
    const held = view.decisions.filter((decided) => decided.actions.some((other) => other.kind === "seal_media" && other.inForce));
    return held.some((decided) => standing === "interim" || decided.kind === "final") ? "already" : null;
  }
  if (target.type === "account") {
    if (target.deleted) return "deleted";
    // 3e: a retirement changes nothing when the newest snapshot's handle is retired already, which the case answer says.
    if (action.kind === "retire_handle") return view.standing?.snapshotHandleRetired ? "already" : null;
    if (action.kind === "reset_display_name") return target.displayName !== null && target.displayName === target.handle ? "already" : null;
    return action.kind === "reset_bio" && target.bio === "" ? "already" : null;
  }
  if (target.state === "deleted_by_author") return "deleted";
  // A post is withheld only by a withhold taken while deciding, and a target has one open case: by this case's own, which
  // a final decision that closes the case ends.
  const level = closes && target.level === "withheld" ? "visible" : target.level;
  if (action.kind === "withhold") return level !== null && level !== "visible" ? "already" : null;
  if (action.kind === "remove") return level === "removed" ? "already" : null;
  // An image measure: the post is not shown, or a measure in force of this case already holds the image back at least as far.
  if (level !== null && level !== "visible") return "already";
  const held = view.decisions.flatMap((decided) => decided.actions).filter((held) => held.inForce && !ending.has(held.id) && (held.kind === "seal_media" || held.mediaId === action.mediaId));
  const strong = held.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media" || measure.kind === "remove_media");
  return strong || (action.kind === "withhold_media" && held.some((measure) => measure.kind === "withhold_media")) ? "already" : null;
}

/**
 * The targets whose measures a correction or a review lifts one by one, each with its own reversal (3c's). A strike falls
 * only with its whole finding: the console adds its overruling to a full reversal (overruleOf) and never offers it alone.
 * A retirement is given back with its own reversal (Task 2, 8.7), (Task 3) a suspension or a termination is lifted with
 * lift_suspension, and (Task 5) a warning about reporting or a restriction of it with lift_reporting: the first two share
 * the target `account` with the strike, so they are named by kind, and the reporting measures with them.
 */
const ONE_BY_ONE: readonly MeasureTarget[] = ["post", "image", "images", "display_name", "bio", "handle"];
const ONE_BY_ONE_KINDS: readonly ActionKind[] = ["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"];

/** Whether a decision's action is a measure that a correction or a review lifts one by one. */
const liftsOneByOne = (action: { kind: ActionKind }): boolean =>
  MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null && (ONE_BY_ONE.includes(MEASURES[action.kind].target) || ONE_BY_ONE_KINDS.includes(action.kind));

/** The strike a decision gave that stands (no overruling reversed it): what a full reversal of that decision overrules. */
export const standingStrikeOf = (decision: CaseDecision): CaseDecisionAction | undefined => decision.actions.find((action) => action.kind === "strike" && action.inForce);

/** The overruling a reversal of a decision carries: one when it reverses the decision whole and the decision's strike stands. */
function overruleOf(decision: CaseDecision | undefined, reversesWhole: boolean): DecisionActionParams[] {
  return decision && reversesWhole && standingStrikeOf(decision) ? [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }] : [];
}

/**
 * The strike line under "Restrict" (3e design, section 8.2), by its key in STANDING_WORDS.strike, or null where the page
 * shows none: on an account case, and for an outcome that restricts nothing. It is not a choice: "due" is exactly when the
 * console signs a strike, and the database refuses any other list (strike_mismatch). A decision answers a report of child
 * sexual abuse material when it considers an unanswered suspect item, as a final decision considers every one.
 */
export type StrikeLine = "due" | "interim" | "law" | "r2" | "already" | "before";
export function strikeLine(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): StrikeLine | null {
  if (view.strikeDue === null || (draft.kind !== "interim" && draft.kind !== "final") || draft.outcome !== "restricted") return null;
  if (draft.kind === "interim") return "interim";
  if (draft.ground === "illegal") return "law";
  if (draft.ruleId === "R2" || suspectOpen(view).length > 0) return "r2";
  if (view.strikeDue.due) return "due";
  return view.strikeDue.why === "already_struck" ? "already" : "before";
}

/** The strike a decision's params carry: one exactly when the strike line says it is due. */
const strikeOf = (view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): DecisionActionParams[] => (strikeLine(view, draft) === "due" ? [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] : []);

/** A day, in milliseconds: a strike counts STANDING_RULES.strikeDays of them from its decision. */
const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * The strikes the author would have with this one, for the preview's sentence: the band's lower bound plus this strike.
 * The page reads the author's standing in bands (D 8), so for "3 or more" it says 4; the statement the author gets holds
 * the database's count.
 */
const ACTIVE_THEN: Record<NonNullable<CaseView["authorStanding"]>["activeStrikes"], number> = { "0": 1, "1": 2, "2": 3, "3_or_more": 4 };

/** Whether a suspension or termination that stands rests on the reviewed decision's strike: [review.rests]. */
export const strikeCarriesStanding = (decision: CaseDecision | undefined): boolean => (decision ? (standingStrikeOf(decision)?.restedOnBy ?? []).length > 0 : false);

/** The reversal that lifts a measure. */
function reversalOf(action: { kind: ActionKind; mediaId: string | null }): DecisionActionParams {
  // 3f: an order's measure is lifted only by its own reversal, which a reinstatement holds alone.
  if (action.kind === "disable_by_order") return { kind: "reinstate_by_order", mediaId: null };
  const target = MEASURES[action.kind].target;
  if (target === "post") return { kind: "restore", mediaId: null };
  if (target === "image") return { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: action.mediaId };
  if (target === "images") return { kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null };
  if (target === "handle") return { kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null };
  if (action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate") return { kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null };
  if (target === "reporting") return { kind: "lift_reporting", mediaId: null };
  return { kind: target === "display_name" ? "restore_display_name" : "restore_bio", mediaId: null };
}

/** The measures taken while deciding that are in force, each with the decision that holds it. */
function interimInForce(view: CaseView): { decision: CaseDecision; action: CaseDecisionAction }[] {
  return view.decisions.filter((decided) => decided.kind === "interim").flatMap((decision) => decision.actions.filter((action) => action.inForce && MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null).map((action) => ({ decision, action })));
}

/** The withholds taken while deciding that a final decision which leaves the case open may lift: "Lift" beside each. */
export function liftable(view: CaseView): DecisionActionParams[] {
  return interimInForce(view)
    .filter(({ action }) => action.kind === "withhold" || action.kind === "withhold_media")
    .map(({ action }) => reversalOf(action));
}

/** The measure a reversal of a final decision's draft lifts, for its label. */
export const liftedKind = (reversal: DecisionActionParams): MeasureKind => (reversal.kind === "restore_media" ? "withhold_media" : "withhold");

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e: a suspension at once (design, section 8.3)

/** The four grounds of a suspension at once, in the composer's order. The termination at once is Task 4's. */
export type AtOnceKey = "threat" | "terrorist" | "flood" | "protective";
export const AT_ONCE_ORDER: readonly AtOnceKey[] = ["threat", "terrorist", "flood", "protective"];

/** The most days of a suspension at once on each ground, from STANDING_RULES. */
export const AT_ONCE_DAYS: Record<AtOnceKey, number> = {
  threat: STANDING_RULES.threatDays,
  terrorist: STANDING_RULES.terroristDays,
  flood: STANDING_RULES.floodDays,
  protective: STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays,
};

/**
 * The ground a draft's rule or law selects (decision_actions_check's table): R5 a threat, R6 a flood, R2 a protective
 * suspension, the law with the terrorist-content mark terrorist content; any other rule, or the law without the mark,
 * none ([atOnce.other]).
 */
export function atOnceGroundOf(draft: Pick<CaseDraft, "ground" | "ruleId" | "terrorist">): AtOnceKey | null {
  if (draft.ground === "illegal") return draft.terrorist ? "terrorist" : null;
  return draft.ruleId === "R5" ? "threat" : draft.ruleId === "R6" ? "flood" : draft.ruleId === "R2" ? "protective" : null;
}

/** Why "Suspend at once" is greyed, by its key in STANDING_WORDS: a standing measure is live, the person is no admin, the rule allows none, a report waits, or the ground's facts are not there now. */
export type AtOnceClosed = "conflict" | "admin" | "other" | "reportsFirst" | "noSeal" | "unmet";

/**
 * Whether "Suspend at once" is open for this draft on this case, and on which ground, or why not; null where the control
 * is not shown at all: on a post case, while deciding, or for an outcome that restricts nothing. The case answer's
 * standing says what the database would accept now; the database decides at the commit.
 */
export function atOnceState(
  view: CaseView,
  role: StaffRole,
  draft: Pick<CaseDraft, "kind" | "outcome" | "ground" | "ruleId" | "terrorist">,
): { open: true; ground: AtOnceKey } | { open: false; why: AtOnceClosed; ground: AtOnceKey | null } | null {
  if (view.target.type !== "account" || view.standing === null || draft.kind !== "final" || draft.outcome !== "restricted") return null;
  const ground = atOnceGroundOf(draft);
  if (view.standing.live) return { open: false, why: "conflict", ground };
  if (role !== "admin") return { open: false, why: "admin", ground };
  if (ground === null) return { open: false, why: "other", ground };
  // A protective suspension answers findings only: a report that waits in the case is decided first.
  if (ground === "protective" && view.standing.openReports) return { open: false, why: "reportsFirst", ground };
  if (!view.standing.atOnce.includes(ground)) return { open: false, why: ground === "protective" ? "noSeal" : "unmet", ground };
  return { open: true, ground };
}

/** The suspension taken at once a draft holds, if any (an announced one is Task 4's control). */
export const suspensionOf = (draft: CaseDraft): DecisionActionParams | undefined => draft.actions.find((action) => action.kind === "suspend" && action.announced === false);

/** A placeholder of a draft filled in, each by a function, so that no character of a value is read as a pattern. */
const filled = (text: string, values: Record<string, string>): string => Object.entries(values).reduce((out, [key, value]) => out.split(`{${key}}`).join(value), text);

/**
 * The draft once "Suspend at once" is chosen with these days: the suspension taken at once beside the draft's other
 * measures, and, when its facts or its reason are still empty, W.5's drafts for the ground, filled from the case answer as
 * this page read it (a flood's count and interval, the day of the seal for good). The moderator may edit them.
 */
export function withAtOnce(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, ground: AtOnceKey, days: number): CaseDraft {
  const standing = view.standing;
  // At most one suspension or termination in a decision: choosing this one puts any other away.
  const actions = [...draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "suspend" && action.kind !== "terminate"), { kind: "suspend" as const, mediaId: null, days, announced: false }];
  const facts =
    ground === "flood"
      ? filled(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.flood, { posts: String(standing?.flood.posts ?? 0), from: standing?.flood.from ?? "", to: standing?.flood.to ?? "" })
      : ground === "protective"
        ? filled(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.protective, { sealedOn: standing?.seal?.decidedOn ?? "" })
        : STANDING_DRAFTS.facts[ground];
  const written = { ...draft.written };
  if (normalised(written.facts) === "") written.facts = facts;
  if (ground === "protective" && normalised(written.reason) === "") written.reason = STANDING_DRAFTS.reason.protective;
  return { ...draft, actions, written };
}

/** A suspension at once as the preview renders it: what the database will fix, as far as the page can tell now. */
function previewSuspension(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, action: DecisionActionParams, noEffect: "already" | "deleted" | null, now: Date) {
  const ground = atOnceGroundOf(draft);
  const days = action.days ?? 1;
  const rested = ground === null || ground === "flood" ? null : (view.standing?.basisDecidedAt[ground] ?? now.toISOString());
  return {
    kind: "suspend" as MeasureKind,
    mediaId: null,
    noEffect,
    sealed: null,
    announced: false,
    days,
    basis: ground,
    earliestStart: now.toISOString(),
    endsAt: new Date(now.getTime() + days * DAY_MS).toISOString(),
    restsOn: rested === null ? null : [{ decidedAt: rested, ruleId: ground === "threat" ? ("R5" as RuleId) : null, postCreatedAt: null }],
  };
}

/** Where a standing measure's period stood, as the case answer reads it now, in the statement's three states: what the preview of its lift prints. */
function periodNow(action: CaseDecisionAction): { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null } {
  const period = action.period;
  if (period === null || period.startsAt === null || period.state === "unfixed" || period.state === "announced" || period.state === "held" || period.state === "never") return { state: "not_started", startedAt: null, endedAt: null };
  if (period.state === "running") return { state: "running", startedAt: period.startsAt, endedAt: null };
  return { state: "ended", startedAt: period.startsAt, endedAt: period.endsAt };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 4: announced measures, termination, replies

/** The three controls of a standing measure that Task 4 builds (8.3): announce a suspension, announce a termination, terminate at once. */
export type StandingControl = "announce" | "announceTerminate" | "terminateAtOnce";

/** Why such a control is greyed, by its key in STANDING_WORDS: a measure is live, a report waits, too few strikes, no new strike, not the ladder's end, no admin, no second threat, R2. */
export type StandingClosed = "conflict" | "reportsFirst" | "short" | "stale" | "notYet" | "admin" | "noRepeat" | "r2";

/**
 * Whether a control is open for this draft on this case, or why not; null where it is not shown: on a post case, while
 * deciding, for an outcome that restricts nothing, and on the law (a measure of the ladder cites the newest strike's rule,
 * and a termination at once R5). The case answer's standing says what the database would accept now; it decides at the
 * commit. The two announced measures answer findings only, so a report that waits in the case greys them.
 */
export function standingControlState(view: CaseView, role: StaffRole, draft: Pick<CaseDraft, "kind" | "outcome" | "ground" | "ruleId">, control: StandingControl): { open: true } | { open: false; why: StandingClosed } | null {
  const standing = view.standing;
  if (view.target.type !== "account" || standing === null || draft.kind !== "final" || draft.outcome !== "restricted" || draft.ground !== "incompatible") return null;
  if (standing.live) return { open: false, why: "conflict" };
  if (control === "announce") {
    if (standing.openReports) return { open: false, why: "reportsFirst" };
    if (standing.activeStrikes < STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes) return { open: false, why: "short" };
    if (standing.maxDays === null) return { open: false, why: "stale" };
    return { open: true };
  }
  if (role !== "admin") return { open: false, why: "admin" };
  if (control === "announceTerminate") {
    if (standing.openReports) return { open: false, why: "reportsFirst" };
    return standing.mayTerminate ? { open: true } : { open: false, why: "notYet" };
  }
  if (draft.ruleId === "R2") return { open: false, why: "r2" };
  return draft.ruleId === "R5" && standing.atOnce.includes("threat_repeat") ? { open: true } : { open: false, why: "noRepeat" };
}

/** The standing measure a draft holds, if any: a suspension or a termination, announced or at once. */
export const standingMeasureOf = (draft: CaseDraft): DecisionActionParams | undefined => draft.actions.find((action) => action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate");

/** Whether an action is the measure a control adds. */
export const ofControl = (action: DecisionActionParams, control: StandingControl): boolean =>
  control === "announce" ? action.kind === "suspend" && action.announced === true : control === "announceTerminate" ? action.kind === "terminate" && action.announced === true : action.kind === "terminate" && action.announced === false;

/**
 * The draft once a control is chosen: its measure beside the draft's other measures, and never beside another suspension
 * or termination (at most one of the four can be chosen); for a measure of the ladder the newest strike's rule, which the
 * composer sets ([suspend.rule]); and, when the facts are still empty, W.5's draft, filled from the case answer as this
 * page read it. The moderator may edit them and writes the reason.
 */
export function withStanding(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, control: StandingControl, days: number | null): CaseDraft {
  const standing = view.standing;
  const measure: DecisionActionParams =
    control === "announce" ? { kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: days ?? 1, announced: true } : { kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: control === "announceTerminate" };
  const actions = [...draft.actions.filter((action) => action.kind !== "suspend" && action.kind !== "terminate"), measure];
  const ladder = control !== "terminateAtOnce" && standing?.ladderRule ? standing.ladderRule : draft.ruleId;
  const facts =
    control === "announce"
      ? filled(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.strikes, { activeStrikes: String(standing?.activeStrikes ?? 0) })
      : control === "announceTerminate"
        ? filled(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.ladder_end, {
            n: String(standing?.suspensionsInYear ?? 0),
            ladderMemoryDays: String(STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays),
            day: standing?.lastSuspendedOn ?? "",
            activeStrikes: String(standing?.activeStrikes ?? 0),
          })
        : STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.threat_repeat;
  const written = { ...draft.written };
  if (normalised(written.facts) === "") written.facts = facts;
  return { ...draft, ruleId: ladder, category: ladder === draft.ruleId ? draft.category : RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[ladder], actions, written };
}

/** Whether a standing measure a draft holds is still what its control offers now, with days within the rung. */
function standingOffered(view: CaseView, role: StaffRole, draft: Pick<CaseDraft, "kind" | "outcome" | "ground" | "ruleId">, action: DecisionActionParams): boolean | null {
  for (const control of ["announce", "announceTerminate", "terminateAtOnce"] as const) {
    if (!ofControl(action, control)) continue;
    if (standingControlState(view, role, draft, control)?.open !== true) return false;
    // A measure of the ladder cites the newest strike's rule; a suspension's days are at most the rung.
    if (control !== "terminateAtOnce" && draft.ruleId !== view.standing?.ladderRule) return false;
    if (control === "announce") return typeof action.days === "number" && action.days >= STANDING_DAYS.min && action.days <= (view.standing?.maxDays ?? 0);
    return true;
  }
  return null;
}

/** An announced suspension or termination, or a termination at once, as the preview renders it: what the database will fix, as far as the page can tell now. */
function previewStanding(view: CaseView, action: DecisionActionParams, noEffect: "already" | "deleted" | null, now: Date) {
  const standing = view.standing;
  if (action.announced === true) {
    return {
      kind: action.kind as MeasureKind,
      mediaId: null,
      noEffect,
      sealed: null,
      announced: true,
      days: action.kind === "suspend" ? (action.days ?? 1) : null,
      basis: action.kind === "suspend" ? ("strikes" as const) : ("ladder_end" as const),
      earliestStart: new Date(now.getTime() + STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      endsAt: null,
      // The account's active strikes as the page read them: the database lists the same, with the posts they were given for.
```
